commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The God of all goodness did not disdain to be circumcised!
He offered Himself as a saving sign and example for us all.
He made the law, and He obeyed his own commands.
He fulfilled the words of the prophets concerning Himself.
He holds the world in his hands, yet is bound in swaddling clothes.
Let us glorify Him!

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Robed in the vestments of bishop,
you preached the gospel of the kingdom with gladness.
You poured out streams of true teaching for the Church,
illumined by your words,
we have learned how to glorify one Godhead:
Father almighty, divine Word, and Holy Spirit,
three Persons undivided.
Pray to Him, Father Basil,
to enlighten and save our souls!

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Your very name means "the royal one."
You led Christ's royal people in wisdom and knowledge.
The King of kings and the Lord of all,
the Son, of one essence with the Father,
adorned you with the crown of Hs kingdom.
Pray to Him, Father Basil,
to enlighten and save our souls!

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The Savior was willing to be wrapped in swaddling clothes for the sake of mankind!
He was eight days old, on his Mother's side,
but eternal on the side of his Father!
He did not disdain the circumcision of his flesh.
Faithful, let us cry to Him:
You are our God; have mercy on us!

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You dwell with the hosts of heaven;
you imitated their way of life on earth.
You lived with mankind like an earthly angel.
Now pray for us, who delight in your theology.
May Christ our God save us from the darkness of unbelief.
May He enlighten and save our souls!
Circumcision: "Lord I Call..."                                   page two

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Most blessed Basil,
you were filled with heavenly grace.
Your theology exposes the errors of false teachers.
You are the pride of pastors,
the cornerstone of bishops,
the example of fathers.
You possess favor with Christ:
Pray that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Most blessed Basil,
you served Christ's Church like a busy honeybee!
Armed with divine zeal,
you stung the blasphemers and wounded the heretics!
You stored the souls of the faithful in the hive of heaven.
Now that you rest in the green pastures of God,
remember all of us
as you stand before the holy Trinity.

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Holy Father Basil,
you acquired the virtues of all the saints:
the meekness of Moses, Elijah's zeal,
the faith of Peter, John's theological eloquence.
You cry with Paul the apostle:
Who is weak, and I am not weak?
Who is made to fall, and I do not burn in indignation?
Now you dwell with them all in heaven.
Pray that our souls may be saved.

commemoration.title: The Circumcision of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Basil, you revealed noble truths;
you studied the nature of created things.
You understood that all things will pass away;
that God alone is eternal.
He is transcendent in essence, the Creator of all.
As your longing for Him increased,
you abandoned desire for temporal things.
Pray that we may be filled with longing for God!
Circumcision: Apostikha (continued)             page two

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Christ is made manifest!  God is revealed,
as David clearly foretold of old.
He comes to his servant, seeking Baptism.
Be filled with joy, river Jordan!
Dance, earth and seas; hills and mountains!
Exult, hearts of men,
for a great light is coming upon you!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Great are your mysteries, Christ our God!
You have given us the holy monk Seraphim to be a light for us,
a strong defender against the enemy,
intercessor before God for monastics and all the Orthodox faithful,
his own monastery's strength and boast.
For now he intercedes with You, Lord,
asking for our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Faithful, let us celebrate the prefeast of Christ's Theophany!
let us sing hymns to honor the noble Baptism of our God.
For He wills to approach the Forerunner in the flesh.
As a Man He asks for the Baptism of salvation:
The regeneration of all those who accept Him in faith
and become partakers of the Spirit!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Most glorious wonder!
An athlete in piety appears at Sarov:
He has become a fervent intercessor with God for us!
Rejoice, monks of Sarov who possess the relics of the holy monk:
Rejoice, Orthodox faithful!
You possess the most holy Seraphim as your defender in affliction!
Cry out to him:  Rejoice, light of the Russian land!
You quenched the darkness of the enemy,
and entreat the Lord to grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Most glorious wonder!
Behold, in the monastery of Sarov a firm pillar of goodness:
The blessed Seraphim appears in truth to us.
Therefore the assemblies of those who are wise in God cry out, exulting in Spirit:
Saint, and Father Seraphim,
entreat the Lord to grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You are the river of peace and valley of paradise,
all-powerful Lord!
How can a river receive You naked, in its course,
Who mantled the heavens with clouds?
You shall strip the evil enemy naked,
clothing mankind with immortality!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Holy Father Seraphim,
who can worthily praise your wondrous life?
What tongue can tell of your struggles in the wilderness?
The vigils, the fasting, the isolation and silence, the ceaseless prayer?
Truly you are the pride of ascetics!
A powerful intercessor before God!
Rejoice, example of monks!
Rejoice, haven for those in torment!
Pray to the Lord that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Behold, the light of the faithful,
see, our Atonement descends into the river's streams
that He may wash away man's filth and corruption,
refashioning us, who had been broken to pieces.

commemoration.title: Eve of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Prepare, River Jordan!
Behold, Christ is coming to be baptized by John in You!
Rejoice, barren wilderness!
Dance in gladness, hills and mountains!
Eternal Life is coming to reclaim Adam.
Forerunner, call out with the voice of one who cries:
Prepare the ways of the Lord!  Make straight His paths!

commemoration.title: Feast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The hosts of angels were filled with fear,
as they saw our Deliverer baptized by a servant
and receiving witness through the coming of the Spirit.
The Father's voice was heard from on high:
He on whom the Forerunner lays his hand is My beloved Son,
in Whom I am well pleased.
Christ our God, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Feast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The streams of the Jordan received You, the fountain,
and the Comforter descended in the form of a dove.
He who bowed the heavens, bowed His head,
and the clay cried out to the One Who formed him:
Why do You command me what is beyond my power?
for I need to be baptized by You!
Sinless One, Christ our God, Glory to You!

commemoration.title: Feast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Wishing to save mankind gone astray,
You did not disdain to clothe Yourself in the form of a servant.
For it was fitting that You, as Master and God,
take our nature upon Yourself for our sake.
You, Deliverer, have been baptized in the flesh,
making us worthy of forgiveness.
Therefore, we cry out to You:
Christ our God and Benefactor, Glory to You!

commemoration.title: Feast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The Forerunner beheld our Enlightenment,
Who enlightens all mankind,
draw near to be baptized.
He rejoiced in soul while his hand trembled.
He showed Him to the people, saying:
Behold, the Redeemer of Israel, who sets us free from corruption.
Sinless One, Christ our God, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Feast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You bowed Your head before the Forerunner,
and crushed the heads of the serpents.
You descended into the waters and gave light to all things,
that they may glorify You, Savior,
the Enlightenment of our souls.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
When the Forerunner beheld You, Christ,
drawing near to him to ask for baptism,
he cried out in trembling:
Why do You ask me for what is beyond my strength?
How shall I touch You with my hand, all-powerful Lord,
for You hold all things with Your hand?
But instead baptize me, Your servant!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
This day I have appeared as a complete Man;
unapproachable by nature, I have become approachable to you.
Rich, I have willingly made myself poor,
that what has grown poor I may make rich with incorruption and deliverance.
Draw near and baptize Him Who is not subject to corruption,
and Who delivers the world from decay.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
I am constrained on every side, said the Forerunner to the Creator,
and cannot tell which way to go.
Bountiful Lord, You are a stream flowing with nourishment:
How then shall the flowing streams receive You,  Word,
Who come to pour forth salvation on all who honor Your holy Epiphany!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Light in the flesh and Forerunner of the Savior,
offspring of a barren mother.
and friend of the One born of a Virgin,
you have worshipped Him by leaping in the womb,
and have baptized him in the waters of the Jordan.
We entreat you to intercede with Him, prophet,
that we may escape from the mighty tempests to come!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The hosts of angels were filled with fear,
as they saw our Deliverer baptized by a servant
and receiving witness through the coming of the Spirit.
The Father's voice was heard from on high:
He on whom the Forerunner lays his hand, the same is my beloved Son,
in whom I am well pleased.
Christ our God, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The streams of the Jordan received You, the fountain,
and the Comforter descended in the form of a dove.
He Who bowed the heavens, bowed His head,
and the clay cried aloud to the One Who formed him:
Why do You command of me what lies beyond my power?
For I have need to be baptized of You.
Sinless One, Christ our God, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The Forerunner beheld our enlightenment,
Who enlightens all men,
draw near to be baptized.
He rejoiced in soul while his hand trembled.
He showed Him to the people, saying:
Behold, the Redeemer of Israel, Who sets us free from corruption.
Sinless One, Christ our God, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
He who covers the heaven with clouds
is Himself covered today by the streams of Jordan;
He who takes away the sin of the world
is cleansed, that I may be made clean.
The only-begotten Son of the most high Father
receives from above the testimony of the consubstantial Spirit.
Let us cry aloud to Him:
Christ our God, You have made Yourself manifest and saved us! Glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
My Jesus, You are Yourself the radiant light,
enlightening all mankind.
You were baptized in the streams of Jordan,
Light, one in essence with the Father of lights,
in You all creation shines brightly, and cries to You,
Blessed is our God made manifest!  Glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Come, let us purify our senses!
Let us behold the fullness of divine glory in the flesh!
Let us see Christ baptized, fighting the enemy's deceit!
Let us sing praises to His sinless head, crying out:
Blessed is our God made manifest!  Glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Seeing You, Christ our God,
draw near to him in the river Jordan,
John said:  Why have You, the undefiled one,
come to Your servant, Lord?
In whose name shall I baptize You?
Of the Father?  But You bear Him in Yourself.
Of the Son?  But You are Yourself this Son made flesh.
Of the Holy Spirit?
But You know that through Your own mouth You give Him to the faithful.
O God, You have appeared!  have mercy on us.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
My Jesus, You are the fountain of life.
In the river Jordan You give us to drink of Your compassion!
By Your thirst, You have refreshed us, Lover of mankind.
We drink from Your fountain of light and incorruption, singing to You:
Blessed is our God made manifest!  Glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Lord, You were covered as Man by the streams of the Jordan,
yet the Spirit descended from on high and bore witness to You!
The voice of the Father proclaimed You as His beloved Son,
made manifest to grant our souls great mercy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Lord, You were born in these last days, assuming the form of a Servant,
yet as the changeless One, You were begotten from the Father before all time!
It was Your will to renew Your image, Creator,
for You were baptized granting incorruption to our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Lord, You came as Man to John at the Jordan,
yet You did not abandon Your throne at the right hand of the Father!
It was Your will to be baptized for us,
to free us from bondage to the stranger,
as the compassionate Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Today the Maker of heaven and earth
comes in the flesh to the Jordan.
He who is sinless asks for baptism,
that He may cleanse the world from the error of the enemy.
He who is Master of all is baptized by a servant,
and He gives mankind cleansing through water.
Let us cry aloud to him:
O God You have appeared to us! Glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The Father declared You His beloved Son;
the Spirit descended from on high to bear witness to You.
Thus was made manifest the mystery of the Trinity
by Your baptism in the Jordan, O Christ.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You drew near to the waters;
no one can touch You; yet You bowed Your head to the Forerunner!
You sanctified the world
releasing it from slavery to the enemy
by Your baptism, sinless One.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Gregory of Nyssa,
you were adorned with wise words and valiant deeds.
You gladden the faithful with your God-proclaiming voice;
you enlighten us with knowledge
explaining the unity of the Trinity.
You defeated alien teachings with true doctrine;
you established the faith with strength!
Now you stand before Christ with His bodiless servants:
Pray that He may grant peace and great mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Righteous Father, holy Gregory:
flute played by the breath of the Paraclete,
filled with the clear melody of godliness,
candlestick enlightening many with divine light,
herald of truth, foundation of theology,
fountain of heavenly doctrine,
torrent of teaching sweet as honey,
lyre, playing songs written by God,
gladdening the hearts of the faithful!
Wise one, pray without ceasing to Christ,
Who was baptized in the streams of Jordan for the renewal of the world,
that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Righteous Father, all praised Gregory,
battle axe hewing down the assaults of heresy!
Two-edged sword of the Paraclete,
dagger piercing the heart of false doctrine,
fire consuming the brushwood of error,
fan skillful to separate the chaff of vanities from the kernel of doctrine,
rule measuring the way to salvation with precision!
Pray without ceasing to Christ,
Who was baptized in the streams of Jordan for the renewal of the world,
that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Righteous Father, blessed Gregory,
your lips flow with gracious words
drawn from the divine fountain of salvation freely given:
Words of prayer, which you interpret for all!
Guide, leading us in the straight path of righteousness:
You were adorned with the graces of contemplation;
you shone with the radiance of the uncreated Trinity.
Unconquered one, pray without ceasing to Christ,
Who was baptized in the streams of Jordan for the renewal of the world,
that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Let all creation,
now set free from bondage,
sing a new song to Christ
Who shone from the Virgin,
and was baptized in the Jordan today!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
God-revealing Gregory,
you passed your life in godliness.
You made your actions radiant through contemplation,
you desired divine wisdom for your love;
you were enriched with graces flowing from the Spirit!
Your words drip with sweetness, like honey from the comb,
you gladden the Church of God with your divine thoughts!
Now you gaze upon the Lord in heaven:
Never cease to pray for us who honor your memory.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Righteous Father, God-bearing Theodosius,
you obtained your great desire: the cleansing of your soul.
The grace of the all-holy Spirit dwelt within you as pure light;
you were made beautiful by His working.
Now you glorify Christ ceaselessly:
He is one Son, in two natures;
He was baptized by the hand of the Forerunner,
and the voice of the Father testified to Him.
Pray to Him, beseech Him, holy one,
to grant the world peace, unity, and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Righteous Father, God-bearing Theodosius,
you have been made worthy of a blessed life!
Through purity and self-denial you won the life on high,
now you rejoice with the angels!
You see Christ and glorify Him ceaselessly!
He wondrously took flesh from a virgin;
He was baptized in the Jordan, drowning all our sins.
Pray to Him, beseech Him, holy one,
to grant the world peace, unity, and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Righteous Father,
you were a city of the living God.
The streams of a river made glad the temple of your soul;
that river has Jordan for its source:
It flows to the ends of the earth,
watering it with the holy Word of Christ our God!
Beseech Him, all-blessed Theodosius,
that He may save our souls.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Righteous Father, God-bearing Theodosius,
you struggled valiantly in this fleeting life:
In song, in vigils and fasting you became an example to your disciples.
Now you dance with the angels and glorify Christ ceaselessly!
He is God from God, the Word of God, our Redeemer;
He bowed His head beneath the Forerunner's hand,
and sanctified the nature of the waters.
Pray to Him, beseech Him, holy one,
to grant the Church peace, unity, and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The Lord said to the Forerunner:
behold, how else can I wear your image,
the image which I myself have formed?
I must humble myself in a manner beyond understanding:
Why is this so strange, my friend?
If I bow my head beneath your hand,
as one of your fellow men,
and have the waters cover my nakedness,
I shall accomplish My will!
In My compassion,
I shall clothe the naked with immortality!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
We honor you, Theodosius, our Father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Conversor with the angels,
companion of the venerable and righteous ones!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Seeing You, the Creator, naked in the waters, asking to be baptized,
the whole created order was struck with confusion and fear!
The Forerunner was paralyzed, and dared not approach You!
The sea fled, and the Jordan was driven back!
The mountains skipped like lambs, beholding You!
The host of angels surrounding You cried out:
Wonder!  the Savior is stripped naked,
in His desire to clothe, to save, and to refashion mankind!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
The glorious Hermylus and the divinely wise Stratonicus,
the wondrous pair who confessed the uncreated Trinity,
after many wounds and tortures
vanquished the falsehood of idolatry!
Crowned with wreaths of victory,
they pray that peace and great mercy may be granted to the ends of the earth!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
As a servant of the Word, martyr Hermylus,
chosen by the Holy Spirit,
with the streams of your blood you stained the vesture of the priesthood
indeed making it more sacred and splendid.
Now you have passed over to the spiritual kingdom,
becoming a most fervent intercessor for those who honor you.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You struggled greatly, O saints,
valiantly enduring barbaric invasions.
You earnestly rendered up your souls through the sword!
Crowned with the wreaths of martyrs. you fittingly dwell with the angels!
Great was your endurance, and greater still your gifts!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You studied the law of the Lord day and night, venerable fathers
and were counted worthy to be grated into the Tree of Life;
the fruit of your suffering has budded forth wreaths of victory.
Since you have boldness before God, the Judge of the contest,
ask for us cleansing and great mercy.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You endured the blows of a hammer at the command of the tyrant;
you were thrown into a basket and drowned in the water.
You both received a blessed end,
wisely strangling the exceedingly crafty foe!
Now you dwell with joy in the heavens,
praying for all, most valiant athletes!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
You reached the life of the angels through the pains of the ascetic life,
enslaving the body through abstinence, venerable fathers,
you made it subject to your spirit,
become doers of the commandments of the Lord!
You preserved the original beauty of your countenance,
completing struggles if asceticism with the sweat of fasting.
Since you are adorned with double crowns,
pray earnestly to the Savior that we may be saved!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
John the prophet,
receive the world's Redeemer!
As His chosen servant,
baptize the Creator
for the regeneration of mankind!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Theophany of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Today the armies of angels are amazed,
seeing You stand naked in Jordan's waters, Savior,
bowing Your pure head to be baptized by John!
By Your voluntary poverty
You have filled the universe with riches!
O Lord, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul of Thebes

value.text:
You rejected the world and all that is in it,
taking up the Gospel, venerable one.
You followed Christ evangelically,
living secretly in a hut as in a garden of paradise.
By your wholly strict manner of life
you choked the serpent, the slayer of mankind.
Therefore as you dwell in the heavens, blessed John,
pray for great mercy for our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul of Thebes

value.text:
You ever held the holy Gospel in your hands
and became its fulfiller, Father.
You turned from the possessions of your parents
and perfected your whole life through tears and poverty.
Therefore, venerable John,
you now delight in the consolation of God, all-blessed one
and in never-ending gladness!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul of Thebes

value.text:
You were wounded by the love of Christ
whose ineffable poverty you loved.
You conceived of a strange life and undertaking, Father:
You endured affliction and oppression
as a homeless pauper at your parents gate!
Therefore you were filled with spiritual gifts
and have inherited the wealth of heaven that cannot be taken away!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul of Thebes

value.text:
At the command of God, you rejoiced, O Father,
as you fled the beauties of the world.
You preferred the difficult and narrow path of affliction
to the broader way.
Therefore you were clothed in the image of God
and received the care of souls, divinely blessed one,
for your avoidance and denial of pleasures.

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul of Thebes

value.text:
The sound of your teachings has gone out into all the earth,
venerable Father!
Therefore you have found the reward of your labors in the heavens.
You destroyed the hosts of demons
and reached the ranks of angels whose life you blamelessly followed!
Since you have boldness before Christ our God,
entreat peace for our souls!

commemoration.title: Veneration of the Precious Chains of the Holy and All-Glorious Apostle Peter

value.text:
Bound to the Lord, you were imprisoned in a dungeon.
Thus you bound falsehood, Apostle.
Therefore we honor you with love
and kiss your chains with faith.
From them we draw healing of body and salvation of our souls.
We fittingly praise you,
God-seer and conversor with the angels.

commemoration.title: Veneration of the Precious Chains of the Holy and All-Glorious Apostle Peter

value.text:
Those who are bound by ignorance,
receive understanding through you.
The peoples of the gentiles who first were scattered,
were shown to you in an image let down from on high
as a sheet containing every living creature.
Therefore, Apostle, every generation glorifies you,
venerating the chains which you bore with diligence for Christ!

commemoration.title: Veneration of the Precious Chains of the Holy and All-Glorious Apostle Peter

value.text:
Today Peter, the rock of faith,
the foundation of the church,
appoints his precious chains for the devotion of our souls.
Come and let us kiss them,
crowning him with songs of praise and chanting:
Rejoice, fervent champion of the faith,
for with ardent knowledge and great boldness
you confessed Christ, the Son of God!
Rejoice, joy of the universe,
keeper of the keys of the kingdom of heaven,
for you give grace to those who honor you with love
and venerate your precious chains with longing!
As you stand before the throne of Christ, the King of all,
ever pray for us who celebrate your memory!

commemoration.title: Veneration of the Precious Chains of the Holy and All-Glorious Apostle Peter

value.text:
The One Whom you denied at His condemnation,
you hymned when He rose from the dead.
You preached Him to the ends of the earth, Apostle,
as the God and Man Who in His great goodness
entered into fellowship with mankind!
Therefore, we bless you with love, all-glorious Peter,
venerating the chains which you bore with diligence for Christ!

commemoration.title: Veneration of the Precious Chains of the Holy and All-Glorious Apostle Peter

value.text:
Peter, the rock of faith,
the fervent intercessor,
again lifts us up together for a spiritual feast,
setting before us his precious chains
as provision for a costly banquet
that our infirmities may be healed and our sorrows consoled,
and the storm-tossed ships of our life brought to harbor.
Come, let us kiss them, and entreat Christ Who glorified him,
saying: By his prayers, O Christ, save our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable and God-bearing Father Anthony the Great

value.text:
Anthony, pure in heart and soul;
an earthly angel, a heavenly man!
A teacher of chastity, a clear measure of abstinence!
Now you live with your Master, blessed saint.
As with the angels, all holy monastics and martyrs,
you offer Him unceasing praise
set free from sin and danger those who ever keep your holy memory.

commemoration.title: Venerable and God-bearing Father Anthony the Great
Venerable and God-bearing Father Anthony the Great

value.text:
Burning with divine love and radiant with the Spirit,
your soul rose to desire truly infinite love!
You despised flesh and blood, and lived apart from the world,
yet you were united to it by great silence and abstinence.
Therefore you were fulfilled as you desired,
and as a star radiant with blessings, Anthony, you illumine our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable and God-bearing Father Anthony the Great

value.text:
You set your mind as master over the disturbing passions,
keeping the image unharmed through the ascetic life.
Thus you rose into the perfect likeness,
for bravely curbing nature,
you hastened to subject what is lower to that which is above:
You made the body servant to the Spirit.
Therefore you were revealed as the chief of those living the monastic life,
a citizen of the desert, a master teaching those who hasten to you,
a perfect example of virtue.
Now the image has been broken, Anthony,
and in heaven you behold in purity the holy Trinity,
as you pray with boldness for those who honor you with faith and love!

commemoration.title: Venerable and God-bearing Father Anthony the Great

value.text:
We honor you, Anthony our Father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Conversor with the angels,
companion of Paul of Thebes!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!
St. Anthony: Apostikha                                    page two

commemoration.title: Venerable and God-bearing Father Anthony the Great

value.text:
Rejoice, Anthony,
as you dwell on high with the angelic choirs!
For you truly learned their virtue, blessed saint.
You lived on earth, and appeared as a clear, undefiled image;
like a glass which received the brilliant lights of the Holy Spirit.
Thus enlightened, you saw what was to come:
Taught by the divine manifestations of the light of Christ, you foretold all things!
Entreat Him to grant our souls great mercy.

commemoration.title: Saint Athanasius the Great, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
Cyril, using the staff of your teachings,
you chased the spiritual wolves from the Church.
You encircled her with the retaining wall of your words,
presenting her to Christ with unblemished doctrine.
Beseech Him to deliver us now from persecution and corruption
as we celebrate your honorable memory.

commemoration.title: Saint Athanasius the Great, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
By the fire of your teachings, wise one,
the dry wood and chaff of heresy is burned away.
The host of the impious are drowned;
the faithless sink in the abyss of your teachings.
By your doctrine, blessed Cyril,
every member of the believing Church is adorned,
and with a mighty voice honors you.

commemoration.title: Saint Athanasius the Great, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
The lightning-flash of your teaching
enlightens those in darkness.
You chase away all false doctrine.
You bore the brunt of battle for the faith,
Athanasius, uncompromised rock!
True shepherd and unshaken fortress of Christ's holy Church!
Therefore we assemble in your honor,
rejoicing to magnify you, all-praised one!

commemoration.title: Saint Athanasius the Great, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
Cyril, by the eloquence of your words,
the whole Church is adorned with piety.
Honoring the fruits your teaching has borne,
she glorifies your memory,
leader of the right-believing Fathers,
who defended the all-holy Theotokos as a champion at the council!
Sts. Athanasius & Cyril: Lord I Call...                        page two

commemoration.title: Saint Athanasius the Great, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
You braved dangers and patiently suffered persecution,
righteous Athanasius, divine orator.
You exposed the wicked lies of Arius and his followers;
you proclaimed the doctrine of the true faith:
the Son and Spirit are one essence with the Father,
most blessed priest!

commemoration.title: Saint Athanasius the Great, Archbishop of Alexandria
Saint Athanasius the Great, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
Athanasius, named immortal
stands with us in the Church again
teaching us to adore the Trinity,
filling us with the understanding of God
and praying that our souls may be saved.

commemoration.title: Venerable Macarius the Great of Egypt

value.text:
You denied yourself every pleasure,
divinely-wise one:
You pummeled your body and embittered your senses
through labors of hardship and abstinence,
through long-suffering in temptations and patience in adversities.
In their place you have received unending joy,
everlasting delight and ineffable glory!

commemoration.title: Venerable Macarius the Great of Egypt

value.text:
Rejoice, Egypt!  You blossomed forth a great protector:
Macarius, the blessed!
He shone with the wisdom of the Holy Spirit,
transcending all asceticism with his virtuous way of life.
We offer him as mediator, beseeching him
that he may intercede with Christ that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Macarius the Great of Egypt

value.text:
You completed the course of ascetic life without wavering,
and you kept the faith, Father!
Thus you gained a crown of righteousness prepared for you by Christ,
Who grants the prizes of victory,
bestowing the gifts and rewards of labors.
Pray now, God-bearing one, that we also may run this course!

commemoration.title: Venerable Macarius the Great of Egypt

value.text:
Reaching out, inspired one,
for blessedness surpassing thought,
you took abstinence for luxury;
poverty for wealth,
lack of possessions as true abundance
and humility for glory!
As you intended, you reached your heart's desire, Macarius:
Now you dwell in the mansions of the saints!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
Christ found you to be a clear mirror of divine revelations.
He enlightened you with the radiant splendor of His light.
He filled you with divine gifts, Father.
You were revealed to be a source flowing with healings,
a feeder of the hungry,
watering with rains the desire of those who thirst.
Looking upon souls as pledges, wise one,
by your teaching, you helped them towards God.
Entreat Him that He may save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
Your angelic life shone with vision and activity
as a standard and excellent model of virtue
for those who desire to worship God in perfection!
Your divinely-wise teaching, Euthymius,
taught all to worship the Trinity,
that Christ is known to be One in two natures
and that the councils were equal in number to Christ's four Gospels.
Entreat Him that He may save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
As another Samuel, Father Euthymius,
you were dedicated to God from your mother's womb.
Indeed, you were fittingly called by your name,
for you are good courage to all believers,
a foundation and pillar of the monastic way,
a sanctified temple of the Holy Spirit.
Pray for us who honor you,
that we may be granted great mercy!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
How can we not wonder
at your mystical childbearing, exalted Mother?
For without receiving the touch of man,
you gave birth to a Son in the flesh, immaculate Virgin!
The Son born of the Father before eternity
was born of you at the fullness of time, honored lady!
He underwent no mingling, no change, no division,
but preserved the fullness of each nature.
Entreat Him to save the souls, Lady and Virgin and Mother
of those who confess you in the orthodox manner
to be the Theotokos!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
A heavenly angel was sent beforehand
to announce your birth, Father Euthymius.
Like John, you came from the womb of a barren woman
and you showed yourself to be his follower.
You were a homeless one who spurned possessions,
sharing his way of life.
Like the Baptist, you sustained yourself in the mountains,
shining forth with boundless miracles!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
You were sanctified from your mother's womb
when the eye of Him who sees all things
perceived your purpose and desire
ever leading towards higher things.
Most blessed one, He declared you to be a gift of God,
the namesake of good courage.
He loosed the sorrow of your parents.
You advanced from infancy pleasing God, our Benefactor.
Beseech Him that He may save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
You brought forth fruit from barrenness,
Father Euthymius.
You were shown to have many children indeed,
for the desert that once was trackless
was filled with monastics, your spiritual offspring.
Pray now that our souls may be granted peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
You shared in the sufferings of Him who was stretched upon the Cross,
Father Euthymius.
Through asceticism you conformed yourself indeed
to His resurrection and glory!
Entreat Him now that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
You excelled in your life, Father Euthymius,
and your faith was truly Orthodox.
Through activity you reached the highest vision
and became a dwelling of wisdom.
You worshipped Christ in two natures as one of the Trinity.
Pray to Him on our behalf!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
Rejoice, venerable Father,
for you are the cause of good courage for the Church!
By your birth all the assaults of heretics
were repelled by the providence of God!
Therefore He named you Euthymius, or good courage.
You filled the ranks of heavenly beings with joy by the brilliance of your life!
Now as you make your dwelling with them, filled with light,
and enjoy the most blessed and divine radiance,
entreat Christ that He may grant our souls great mercy.

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
Made firm by the staff of the Cross,
you dried up the sea of iniquity.
Spiritually watered by the stream of divine sweetness
and the rivers of paradise,
you revealed springs of salvation in the desert!
You were watered like a palm tree with streams of the divine Spirit.
You hastened to the heights of heaven, venerable one,
showing yourself a fiery pillar of light-bearing radiance.
Therefore, divinely wise one,
entreat Christ that He may grant great our souls mercy!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
You have passed over indeed with joy and gladness of soul
to the wonderful tabernacle, the house of God.
There, most blessed Father,
you listen to the beautiful voices,
the sweet hymns and ineffable delight of those who keep the feast.
You share in their beauty, Euthymius.
This alone you desired as you crucified your flesh
and you reached it, adorned with the righteousness of God.
Entreat Christ that He may grant the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the Great

value.text:
You gave your eyes no sleep, righteous Father,
nor your eyelids slumber,
until you freed your soul and body of passions.
You prepared yourself to be the dwelling of the Holy Spirit,
for you became the companion of the consubstantial Trinity,
for Christ Who alone shows us the Father, came to live in you,
all-praised Euthymius.
Pray to Him that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Maximus the Confessor

value.text:
Your tongue became as the pen of a ready scribe,
sharpened by the spirit, Father Maximus,
inscribing the writing of divine virtues with grace upon the tablets of our hearts,
and the incarnation of Christ
Who willed to be made manifest to all mankind in two Essences and one Person!

commemoration.title: Venerable Maximus the Confessor

value.text:
The One Who was well-pleased to become man in his compassion;
Who is comprehended in two wills and energies,
you proclaimed to all, blessed Maximus!
You stopped the gaping mouths of the most evil ones,
who through the wantonness of the devil who contrives all wickedness,
wrongly proclaimed Christ with only one will and one energy.

commemoration.title: Venerable Maximus the Confessor

value.text:
By the strength of your doctrines
you choked the evil-minded Pyrrhus.
He spoke vain and foolish things, Father Maximus!
You underwent persecutions and sorrows, blessed one:
You were badly beaten, and your tongue cut out;
your divine hand which you raised to God, was cut off,
yet with it you had written the most sublime doctrines, righteous one!

commemoration.title: Venerable Maximus the Confessor

value.text:
The proclamation of your deeds has gone out into all the earth
righteous Father Maximus!
Therefore you have found the reward of your labors in the heavens.
You destroyed the ranks of demons;
you attained the heights of angels whose life you followed blamelessly!
Since you have boldness before Christ our God,
pray that peace may be granted to our souls.

commemoration.title: Apostle Timothy of the Seventy

value.text:
You were manifestly illumined by the rays of the Spirit,
divinely revealed Timothy!
You were shown to be a shining beacon,
passing over all the earth and enlightening it with grace.
Ever pray now that our souls may be granted peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Apostle Timothy of the Seventy

value.text:
Most blessed Anastasius,
you are the boast of martyrs!
You achieved great victories over falsehood!
You bear in your name a standard of renown:
You are raised up everywhere as a faithful conqueror!
Raise up now from falls in sin
those who honor your memory with faith!

commemoration.title: Apostle Timothy of the Seventy

value.text:
Divinely wise Timothy,
you drank of the river of sweetness.
Following Christ, with godly wisdom,
you gave drink to those who fervently desire the understanding of God.
Now you have joyously departed to Him,
contemplating the all-radiant glory of the Trinity,
and infinitely powerful peace.

commemoration.title: Apostle Timothy of the Seventy

value.text:
You were forechosen by God to be the disciple of the wise Paul,
learning divine things.
You lived in goodness and preserved the faith in purity
even to the shedding of your blood!
You were shown to be a faithful bishop, apostle Timothy.
You denounced the idolators,
and wounded by clubs and stones,
you received the crown of martyrdom!
Therefore, most blessed one,
pray for us who celebrate your most honored memory with faith!

commemoration.title: Apostle Timothy of the Seventy

value.text:
You placed yourself in submission to Paul,
conversing with the Spirit through writing.
You became wholly radiant with light,
a generous husbandman and earnest favorite of the Lord.
You lived in chastity and piety,
divinely wise Timothy,
and have been given crowns of victory as a legitimate athlete!

commemoration.title: Apostle Timothy of the Seventy

value.text:
Come, people, let us hymn the apostle Timothy,
the lamp of the faith who shone out to spread the Gospel.
Let us cry out to him:
Rejoice, beautiful root of faith, adopted son of the divine Paul!
Rejoice, honored master of the virtues,
wise mouth of the Word!
Rejoice, harp sounding forth the music of God
to the ends of the earth!
Rejoice, pillar of faith and ground of the church!

commemoration.title: Apostle Timothy of the Seventy

value.text:
You magnified the power of the precious cross, O Christ,
in Judea and Babylon:
Through it, the people came to know the feast of your life-creating Resurrection.
Now the all-praised and glorious athlete Anastasius,
a martyr of countless miracles,
has freed them from the captivity of idolatry's madness.
Together with the angels, he prays for our souls.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Clement, Bishop of Ancyra, and Martyr Agathangelus

value.text:
Among priests, the martyr Clement was glorious!
Through long testing through torture,
he was granted ever to receive sweetness and divine riches
among the blessed.
He anointed many for the contest by his own example,
and subdued the flesh that his mind might be above death.
Faithful, let us cry out to him:
Glorious martyr, by your prayers to the Lord,
release us from our chronic passions
and by your prayers, deliver us from evils!

commemoration.title: Venerable Xenia of Rome, and her two female servants

value.text:
You hastened to the godly haven,
calmly passing through the waves of the storm of life.
You steered the ship of your soul without foundering
through the bitterness of pleasures, most honored one,
loaded with spiritual cargo!

commemoration.title: Venerable Xenia of Rome, and her two female servants

value.text:
First, you transformed your love:
You made yourself faithful by the higher action of your mind.
You departed from the crookedness of pleasure's vanity
and becoming a stranger, blessed one,
you rightly walked by the hard ascent of virtue.

commemoration.title: Venerable Xenia of Rome, and her two female servants

value.text:
You became a stranger in godly emulation
of Him Who for our sake came from on high to raise up the fallen.
Unknown, you lived among your relatives, wise one!
You ever pray to God, Xenia, on behalf of the faithful.

commemoration.title: Blessed Xenia of St. Petersburg

value.text:
Who can declare the strength of your soul, manly Xenia!
You went out to battle the prince of darkness and this world!
You were called Andrew, and nothing frightened or alarmed you.
You endured hunger, cold and nakedness,
crying out with the Apostle:
I can do all things in Christ Who strengthens me!
Therefore Christ Who set the contest crowned you!

commemoration.title: Blessed Xenia of St. Petersburg

value.text:
You loved the heavenly homeland, blessed Xenia!
You were truly a stranger on earth,
wandering in this life as in a foreign land.
Now that you dwell in the house of the heavenly Father,
taking sweet delight in the Master’s hospitality in the chambers on high!
Do not forget us who faithfully celebrate your memory.
Deliver us from our many misfortunes
and remember us before the throne of the Lord of glory!

commemoration.title: Blessed Xenia of St. Petersburg

value.text:
As a wise virgin in the midnight of your life, glorious Xenia,
you went out to meet Christ your Bridegroom,
carrying a lamb burning with the love of God.
Called a fool by the world, you were filled with wisdom beyond this world.
Therefore give the oil of mercy which you richly acquired
to us who celebrate your memory in faith,
pouring drops of it upon our wounds!

commemoration.title: Blessed Xenia of St. Petersburg

value.text:
Behold now the blessed Xenia,
calling us together for her festival.
She cries out with the voice of the Church: Children and friends, why do you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Why are you troubled in vain?
Behold me, who counted everything as refuse
and gained freedom from every loss!
Follow me, therefore, just as I followed Christ,
and do not set you hearts on riches which quickly pass away,
that when the time comes you may dwell with me
in the chambers of unending joy!

commemoration.title: New Martyrs and Confessors of Russia

value.text:
You wisely turned from the hostile and treacherous flesh,
and mounting the heaven-bound chariot, Father Gregory,
you were drawn by the virtues as by four horses!
You soared aloft into ineffable beauty!
Now as you delight in it,
grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: New Martyrs and Confessors of Russia

value.text:
Through grace you were a faithful mediator between God and men.
Now, as you brought Christ, mercifully turned toward us, Father Gregory,
by your bold prayers, never cease to pray to Him, venerable one,
that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: New Martyrs and Confessors of Russia

value.text:
The grave, the means of forgetfulness,
did not close your mouth, Father Gregory,
for you have been revealed as the voice of theology,
declaring now to the whole world the teachings of the faith!
Pray that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Let us joyfully sing the praises of Chrysostom,
the golden trumpet, the divinely-inspired organ,
the inexhaustible sea of doctrine,
the pillar of the Church, the heavenly mind,
the abyss of wisdom, the gilded vase.
He pours forth sweet streams of dogma like honey
for the refreshment of the world.

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Let us worthily honor John Chrysostom,
he is the ever-shining star
illumining all nations with the rays of true teaching.
He is the preacher of repentance;
the golden sponge wiping away the despair of sadness.
His words are a refreshing dew
reviving hearts which are worn by sin.

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
With joyful hymns let us praise Chrysostom:
an earthly angel and a heavenly man.
He is a sweet and well-tuned harp,
a treasury of virtues; an immovable rock,
a model of the faithful, an imitator of the martyrs,
a dweller with the holy angels,
and a companion of the apostles.

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Grace is poured out on your lips, holy Father Chrysostom.
The Lord anointed you to be a priest of His people,
to feed His flock in holiness and justice.
Armed with the sword of strength, you cut off the confusion of error:
Cease not to pray for peace for the world
and salvation for our souls.

commemoration.title: Venerable Ephraim the Syrian

value.text:
Wisely turning from the burdens of this life,
ever-memorable Ephraim,
you reached the desert through your love of silence.
by that same love, you were lifted up to God!
You shone brightly on the world bringing words of life to men!
Therefore do not cease to strengthen us by your prayers, venerable Father,
and deliver our souls from the harm of the alien.

commemoration.title: Venerable Ephraim the Syrian

value.text:
You beheld the good things of paradise
and delighted richly in the incorruptible gardens blooming there!
You yourself blossomed forth divine reason to the world.
Venerable one, as we commune with this in spiritual love,
let us also spiritually grow in our souls.

commemoration.title: Venerable Ephraim the Syrian

value.text:
You surrounded the flesh with the protection of abstinence, Father,
and with prayer and vigil,
you mortified the movement of the passions.
Therefore the power of the Spirit dwelt within you,
revealing you spiritually to be a universal lamp.

commemoration.title: Venerable Ephraim the Syrian

value.text:
You watered your bed with tears, as the prophet said,
and sought repentance through the lessons of life.
You showed us through your words the fear of judgment by deeds!
As we gather together in honor of your memory, all-blessed one,
we celebrate the most glorious deeds you did alone in the Lord,
ever-memorable Ephraim!
Therefore we pray that you will intercede with Christ for our souls!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Hieromartyr Ignatius, the Godbearer and Bishop of Antioch

value.text:
Most wise bearer of God,
your relics were given to your city in a holy way.
They were hallowed in splendor by your suffering,
illumining us with grace by their return.
They have become the cause of our solemn feast,
filling with gladness inspired by God
and delighting with sweet fragrance
those who honor you with devotion!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Hieromartyr Ignatius, the Godbearer and Bishop of Antioch

value.text:
God-bearing Ignatius,
you soared on high to Christ Whom you desired.
You have received the reward of the holy ministry of Christ's Gospel
which you fulfilled in the shedding of your blood.
Therefore, as the wheat of the immortal Husbandman,
you were ground by the teeth of wild beasts
and were revealed to be sweet bread for Him.
Pray for us, blessed athlete!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Hieromartyr Ignatius, the Godbearer and Bishop of Antioch

value.text:
Before, you shone from the east upon the lands of the west
more brightly than the morning star.
Now, in the return of your divine relics,
you have spread beams of light upon the earth from the evening sky.
You entreat Christ to deliver from corruption and misfortune
those who celebrate your most honored memory with faith!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Hieromartyr Ignatius, the Godbearer and Bishop of Antioch

value.text:
You were the last successor of John the Theologian
and you followed in his steps!
You rose from the east, but appeared in the west,
illumining all with the lighting flashes of godly preaching.
There you departed from the world, most wise one,
shining out to God, crowned with the splendor of grace!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Hieromartyr Ignatius, the Godbearer and Bishop of Antioch

value.text:
Blessed Ignatius,
your soul was strong and firm as a stone.
You cried out with great longing to Him Who loves you:
It is not a material fire burning within me,
but the voice of the living water which dwells within my heart.
It continually cries: come to the Father!
Therefore in your desire to be with Christ
and being inflamed with the Holy Spirit,
you urged the beasts speedily to take you from this world
and send you to Christ Whom you desired.
Pray to Him that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Let us honor the instruments of grace worthily:
John, Basil and Gregory,
the harps of the Spirit, the resounding trumpets of preaching,
awesome and clear in tone,
thundering from the heights to declare the glory of God to the ends of the earth!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Let us worthily honor the three champions:
the bulwarks of devotion,
the three apostles added to the twelve,
rivers overflowing with living water from Eden
flooding the face of the earth with life-bearing and divine streams.
They have formed the faith as the elements form creation!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Let us who follow their teachings
praise the instruments of the Holy Spirit with hymns:
They are the trumpets of truth, the words of orators!
Let us entreat them, for they are bold before the Lord,
that he may always grant forgiveness to us all
and great peace to the whole world!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
With what wreaths of praise
shall we crown the teachers?
In separate bodies, they were united in spirit:
God-bearing intercessors, equal in number to the Trinity,
ministers and lights who illumine the universe,
pillars of the Church, whom Christ our merciful God,
crowns with wreaths of victorious glory!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
With what wreaths of praise
shall we crown Chrysostom, together with Basil and Gregory?
Precious vessels of the Spirit, champions of the pure faith,
pillars of the Church and strength of the faithful,
consolation for sinners,
springs overflowing with water
from which we drink for the delight of our souls,
asking forgiveness of sins and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
With what beautiful hymns
shall we crown the God-bearing and heavenly initiates?
Preachers of the mysteries,
leading theologians of the Orthodox Faith:
Basil, manifest in holiness,
godly and divinely spoken Gregory,
John of the golden tongue,
whom the Trinity, the greatly merciful Lord, has fittingly glorified.

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
With what words of praise
shall we proclaim the holy hierarchs?
Equals to the apostles in grace and the honor of spiritual gifts,
destroyers of impiety,
saviors and guides in word and deed,
earthly angels and heavenly men,
Christ-like shepherds in the faith,
whom Christ, the greatly merciful Lord of glory, has honored!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
There are no tongues or words
in which their voices are not heard, he says;
for the proclamation of the godly and wise teachers
has gone out through all the earth and the sea of creation!
Therefore, through their divine precepts,
great things are gathered and assembled
into one true doctrine for the ends of the earth!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Let us praise with worthy hymns
the foundation of the faith:
The godly and watchful mind,
the radiant rivers of golden streams and the shining beacons,
the champions of the Trinity,
the vessels of the grace of the Spirit,
the unshakable pillars and the strength of the Church!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Thrice-blessed Basil,
divinely wise Gregory,
most golden and all-honored John,
you were instruments of the Spirit,
trumpets of divine thunder,
lightning flashes of preaching,
most radiant beacons, shining with the golden light of God!
Pray to Christ that He may save those who honor you!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Today, the souls of mortals are raised up from earthly things!
Today, on the commemoration of the saints, they become heavenly!
The gates of heaven are opened
and the words of the Master are spoken to us!
Words proclaim the Word
And tongues sing hymns to His wonders!
We cry out to the Savior:
Glory to You, Christ our God,
for through them peace has been given to the faithful!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Today let us fittingly gather to praise
the spiritual initiates of the mysteries,
the trumpets of God and reflections of his glory:
Basil the Great, the divine Gregory of fiery inspiration
and John, the truly golden-mouthed.
They pour out streams of golden teachings on us!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs: Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian, and John Chrysostom

value.text:
Today, Christ is carried in the sanctuary as an Infant;
today, He Who gave the law to Moses becomes subject to the law!
The armies of angels marveled,
seeing Him Who holds all things
carried in the arms of an elderly man!
Filled with reverence, Simeon cried out, rejoicing:
Savior, now let me depart from this fleeting life
to a rest that never grows old,
for I have seen You and I rejoice!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cyrus and John, and those with them

value.text:
You brightly illumine the whole universe
with the radiance of your miracles
like brilliant lamps made worthy of heaven by grace,
set there like stars, Cyrus and John
because of the virtues of your perfect lives!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cyrus and John, and those with them

value.text:
You have indeed received the skill from God
to heal the passions of soul and body.
Martyrs of the Lord, you heal all supernaturally,
not by the cure of human medicine,
but by divine inspiration!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cyrus and John, and those with them

value.text:
The pair of martyrs, miracle-working Cyrus and John,
shine on us today, curing our spiritual infirmities.
They both, as equal to the angels, bring healing.
They lived until the end as if with one life
and were joined to Christ by their martyred blood!
Both, having appeared to the gathered soldiers,
have been enrolled as citizens of the heavenly armies.
Therefore they grant healings and pray for the souls
of those of us who celebrate their memory with faith!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cyrus and John, and those with them

value.text:
Assembly of the faithful,
let us gather today!
Let us crown Cyrus and John with hymns!
They are soldiers of grace who grant it abundantly to those who ask!
They have been revealed to all, in various ways,
as brilliant physicians who pray for our souls.

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee Beginning of the Lenten Triodion

value.text:
Let us now offer to Christ the praise of the prefeast,
glorifying His condescension!
For He is brought as an Infant in the Virgin's arms.
He comes to lie in the arms of Simeon
who prophesies to all mankind
that as Benefactor and Lord He makes their nature divine!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
The most splendid bridal-chamber,
the all-honorable tabernacle,
the holy and spacious temple
bears the Lord within the chambers of the Temple.
She betroths Him beforehand to His honored Church.
She prays to Him that those who fittingly glorify her as the Theotokos
may be delivered from corruption and dangers.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
The honored temple prepares to receive within herself
the Lord who comes as an Infant.
With grace she spiritually illumines the faithful and God-loving assembly.
She cries out: You are my glory, my boast and the adornment of my fullness,
Word who became an Infant in the flesh for my sake!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Publican and the Pharisee Beginning of the Lenten Triodion

value.text:
Today Simeon receives in his arms
the Lord of glory whom Moses saw of old on Sinai
when in the cloud and darkness he was given the tables of the law.
This is He Who has spoken through the prophets!
He is the Creator of the law!
This is He Whom David foretold:
He is fearful to all, yet shows us great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
Let the gate of heaven be opened today,
for the unoriginate Word of the Father
has made a beginning in time without forsaking His divinity!
As a Babe forty days old,
He is of His own will brought by the Virgin His Mother,
as an offering in the Temple of the law.
The Elder received Him in his arms,
crying as a servant to his Master:
Let me depart for my eyes have seen Your salvation!
Glory to You, Lord, for You have come into the world to save mankind!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
Come, let us also go to meet Christ with divine songs!
Let us receive Him whose salvation Simeon saw.
This is the One Whom David announced;
this is He whose words the prophets spoke!
For our sakes He has taken flesh and speaks to us in the law.
Let us worship Him!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
Simeon, tell us Whom you bear in your arms,
that you rejoice so greatly in the Temple?
To Whom do you shout and cry aloud:
Now I am set free for I have seen my Savior?
This is the One Who was born of a Virgin;
this is He, the Word, and God of God!
For our sakes He has taken flesh and saved mankind.
Let us worship Him!   (3 Times)

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
Simeon, receive Him Whom Moses once beheld in darkness,
granting the law on Sinai.
He has now become a Babe subject to the law,
yet this is the One Who spoke through the law!
This is He Whose voice was heard in the prophets!
For our sakes He has taken flesh and saved mankind.
Let us worship Him!  (3 Times)

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
The ancient of days, Who gave Moses the law on Sinai in former times,
today appears as a Child.
As Maker of the law, He fulfills the law!
He is brought into the Temple according to the law,
and given over to the Elder.
Simeon the righteous receives Him.
Beholding the fulfillment of the divine order now brought to pass,
rejoicing aloud, he cries:
My eyes have seen the mystery hidden from the ages
made manifest in these latter days,
the Light that disperses the foolishness of the faithless gentiles,
and the glory of the newly-chosen Israel!
Therefore let Your servant depart from the bonds of this flesh
to the life filled with wonder that knows no age or end,
for You grant the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
Simeon now receives below in his earthly arms
the One Whom the ministers entreat with trembling in the heavenly liturgy on high.
He proclaims the union of God with mankind.
He sees the heavenly God as mortal Man!
He prepares to withdraw from earthly things,
and raises his cry in joy:
Glory to You, Lord, for You have revealed to those in darkness
the Light that knows no evening!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
Today He Who once gave the law to Moses on Sinai
submits Himself to the commandments of the law,
for our sakes, becoming as we are in His compassion.
Now the God of purity as a holy Child has opened a pure womb,
and as God, He is brought as an offering to Himself,
setting us free from the curse of the law,
and granting Light to our souls!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
The same Tone (By Germanus)
Today Simeon takes in his arms the Lord of glory
Whom Moses saw of old in the darkness
when he received the tables of the law on Mount Sinai.
This is He Who speaks through the prophets;
He is the Creator of the law!
This is He Whom David announced;
He is fearful to all, yet great and abundant in mercy!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
The unwedded Mother has brought into the Temple
the One Who shone forth before the ages from the Father.
In these latter times He was born from a Virgin womb.
He gave the law on Mount Sinai,
yet He makes Himself obedient to the commandment of the law.
She has brought Him to the priest and righteous Elder
whose appointed lot it was to see Christ the Lord.
Simeon, receiving Him in his arms, rejoiced greatly and cried aloud:
This is God co-eternal with the Father, the Redeemer of our souls!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
The Theotokos Mary carried in her arms
the One Who is borne aloft upon the chariot of the cherubim,
and praised in song by the seraphim.
The Giver of the law Who fulfills the commandment of the law
was made flesh of the unwedded one.
She gave Him into the arms of the priest and Elder.
Holding the Life he asked to be released from life, saying:
Now, Master, let me depart to declare to Adam,
that I have seen the pre-eternal God and Savior of the world,
Who was made a Babe without undergoing change!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
Zion, adorn your bridal chamber and welcome Christ the King!
Salute Mary, the heavenly gate, fashioned as a throne of the cherubim!
She carries the King of glory!
The Virgin is a cloud of light:
She has borne in the flesh the Son begotten before the morning star.
Simeon, taking Him in his arms, proclaimed to the peoples:
This is the Lord of life and death; the Savior of the world!

commemoration.title: The Meeting of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the Temple

value.text:
He Who is borne on high by the cherubim
and praised in hymns by the seraphim
is brought today according to the law into the holy Temple
and rests in the arms of the Elder as on a throne.
From Joseph He receives gifts fitting for God:
A pair of doves, a symbol of the spotless Church
and of the newly chosen people of the gentiles,
and two young pigeons,
for He is the originator of the two covenants, both old and new.
Simeon, now granted the fulfillment of the prophesies concerning himself,
blesses the Virgin and Theotokos Mary.
He foretells in figures the passion of her Son.
From Him he begs release, crying aloud:
Now let me depart, Master, as You have promised me,
for I have seen the pre-eternal Light!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Our Redeemer, the Creator of all,
is carried to the Temple by His Virgin Mother.
The Elder received Him, crying out with joy:
Now Your servant may depart, O good One,
according to Your word, in peace.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Simeon received in his arms from the Virgin
our Savior, begotten before all ages.
He cried: Behold, the ends of the earth are enlightened by Your glory!
Now Your servant may depart, O good one,
for I have seen You, and am at peace.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Divinely-inspired Anna and the all-blessed Simeon,
resplendent in prophecy and blameless before the law,
welcomed the Giver of the law manifested as an infant for our sake.
Seeing Him, they worshipped Him! Let us joyfully celebrate their memory today,glorifying Jesus the Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Simeon, you bear the Savior in your arms;
He was born in these last times to save the human race.
Joyfully you cry aloud:
Behold the nations' Light and Israel's glory!
Lord, now let Your servant depart in peace,
as You have commanded!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
All-righteous, perfect, praiseworthy and divinely-inspired Elder,
when the only perfect God had come in the body to justify the world
you took Him in your hands and were released from the body, crying out to him:
Now let your servant depart in peace, Lover of mankind,
for today I have seen you!   Young in spirit but agéd in body, Simeon,
you received a divine promise
that you would not see death until you had beheld as a newborn child,
the Maker, the preexisting God of all,
He Who is before the ages, yet humbled Himself by assuming flesh!
When you saw Him, you leaped for joy!
Begging released from the flesh,
you were translated, rejoicing, to the mansions of God!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Let us now celebrate the saving grace of God’s ineffable manifestation:
for Christ God, Who without change became a Babe through the Virgin Mary
is borne by His Mother into the temple of God the Father
and Simeon receives Him, embracing Him in his arms!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
The Creator of all, our Redeemer,
is carried into the temple by His Virgin Mother.
The elder, receiving Him, cried out with joy:
Now let Your servant depart in peace, Good One, as You have willed!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Simeon, taking from the Virgin in his arms,
The One Who was begotten before all ages,
cried out: I have beheld, Savior, the light of Your glory,
that shines upon the ends of the earth!
Now let Your servant depart in peace, Good One,
for I have seen You today!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Simeon, taking in his arms the Savior,
Who was born in the fullness of time for the salvation of mankind,
cried out rejoicing: I have seen the Light of the gentiles;
the glory of Israel!
Now let me depart from all here, according to Your word,
as You have said, for You alone are God!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
Let us praise the most holy Photius with Godly hymns:
He is the instrument of grace,
the harp of the spirit,
the immovable pillar of the divine faith,
the champion of true worship,
the great teacher, glorious and holy hierarch,
the confirmation of the Church,
the most splendid contender for the Lord!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
With one voice, all Orthodox,
let us praise Photius with sacred hymns:
He is the first enthroned among the patriarchs,
an orator of fiery spirit,
a teacher of the whole world,
the godly primate of Constantinople,
a brilliant bishop,
the most excellent pastor of the Church of Christ!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
You were driven from your flock by an evil command, glorious one,
and shared in sorrows and tribulations for the faith.
Most steadfast Photius, illustrious bishop,
confirmation of the Church and immovable pillar!
Therefore we all fervently honor you as a teacher of the Orthodox Faith
and an expounder of the mysteries, ever-memorable one!

commemoration.title: Saint Photius, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
Come, all faithful!
Let us praise the most wondrous Photius in faith,
the holy bishop and friend of the Lord!
Filled with the teaching of the apostles,
and revealed as a dwelling of the holy spirit by his virtuous life,
he drove the wolves away from the universal Church with true teaching!
Splendidly setting forth the orthodox faith,
he was shown to be a pillar and champion of piety.
Now as he stands after his death yet closer to Christ,
he ever prays for our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
The ancient of days, become a Babe in the flesh,
was carried into the Temple by His Mother the Virgin,
fulfilling the ordinance of His Own law.
Receiving Him, Simeon said:
Now let Your servant depart in peace,
according to Your word, Holy One!
For my eyes have seen Your salvation!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
The great Parthenius, the namesake of Virginity,
the beacon of Lampsacus,
the radiant morning star of miracles,
calls us all together by his memorial
that we who sing hymns to Christ the Savior
may keep the spiritual feast!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple
Afterfeast of the Meeting of our Lord in the Temple

value.text:
You bore God within yourself from childhood
by the fire of your prayers, all-blessed and wise one!
You burned up legions of the demons
and guided the flock of Lampsacus.
Casting down the temples of idols,
you renewed yourself for God!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Prodigal Son

value.text:
You were shown to be an earthly angel,
having heavenly companions while yet on earth!
You were a beholder of heavenly visions,
a spiritual beacon and a radiant light,
a fruitful olive tree, as proclaimed by the psalm,
which in a godly way pours oil upon the righteous.
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Prodigal Son

value.text:
You enjoyed the deification you desired,
partaking clearly of everlasting delight.
You behold ineffable glory,
adorned with crowns of beauty as a most true prophet of God!
Pray for those who earnestly sing hymns to you, God-pleaser,
that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Prodigal Son

value.text:
You possessed a life equal to that of the angels
and plainly conversed with them, divinely manifest one.
You illumined your mind with things beyond understanding:
The purity of wonderful images,
the revelation of great mysteries,
prophetic proclamation and spiritual renewal!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Blaise, Bishop of Sebaste

value.text:
You were a good tutor of children
and a teacher of true worship.
By the divine power of your godly words,
you led the God-loving women to the struggle of martyrdom,
supporting them in strength for Christ!
Together with them you finished well the course of your sufferings,
rejoicing with splendor in the bridal chamber of heaven,
adorned with a double crown of divine glory.
You ever pray with them that peace and great mercy be granted to us!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Blaise, Bishop of Sebaste

value.text:
With the drops of your blood, martyr Blaise,
you wove a beautiful robe for the Church
embroidered by your well-anointed fingers
and dyed with your manifold sufferings.
She wears it as a beautiful bride
singing hymns to Christ the Bridegroom!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Blaise, Bishop of Sebaste

value.text:
The height of the virtues and foundation of the faithful,
the glory of bishops and boast of the martyrs,
summons all the faithful to his holy memorial with splendor
