that they may sing to him as a victor who glorified God on earth!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Blaise, Bishop of Sebaste

value.text:
You were moved by a vision of Christ,
the Angel of great counsel,
as you beheld the evil assembly, wise martyr.
You went at once to the tribunal.
You took the trophies of victory in your hand!
Now you dwell in the heavens, all-holy one.

commemoration.title: Saint Meletius, Archbishop of Antioch

value.text:
Blessed and holy bishop Meletius,
having studied the law of the Lord,
you showed yourself to be a tree standing by the waters of discipline,
as it is written,
bringing forth the fruits of the virtues,
through the grace of Him Who sanctified your holy soul,
making you a vessel of spiritual waters.

commemoration.title: Saint Meletius, Archbishop of Antioch

value.text:
You taught wisely, most wise one, about the incorporeal Word,
Who is equally unoriginate with the Father.
He united Himself in Person to the flesh.
His activity is twofold:
Through both the natures of which He is comprised and in which He is seen.
Yet His Essence is undivided and known in both natures!

commemoration.title: Saint Meletius, Archbishop of Antioch

value.text:
As it is written in the scriptures, most wise Meletius,
your face was adorned like the turtledoves.
You loved abstinence, and fasting from food.
You desired the spiritual nourishment which Christ gave to you
when you undertook your many labors.
You displayed a burning zeal,
suffering tribulation for the sake of the faith!

commemoration.title: Saints Martinian, Zoe, and Photina of Caesarea in Palestine

value.text:
Come, let us crown the athlete of Christ with hymns:
He is the lamb of the orthodox
grazing with the lilies of the field
and the full-grown blossoms of the paradise of God!
He has openly revealed to the world the beauty of purity,
the sacrifice of faith, the glory of abstinence.
Therefore he has received the unfading crown of the kingdom.

commemoration.title: Saints Martinian, Zoe, and Photina of Caesarea in Palestine

value.text:
Martinian, blessed of God,
you had the fire of the divine Spirit within your heart.
You burned up the image of an impure woman
and wounded the enemy with his own sword!
You did not receive any injury yourself,
but put the evil one to shame and ridicule!

commemoration.title: Saints Martinian, Zoe, and Photina of Caesarea in Palestine

value.text:
Rejoice, honored and most wondrous boast of Palestine!
You have shone on us like an all-radiant sun!
Burning up the power of the enemy,
you consumed your members with ardor, blessed one.
In the mountains, the deserts and on islands,
the evil one brought every temptation before you:
Wise one, even on a rock in the middle of the sea he tested you!
Never cease to pray unfailingly to Christ, thrice-blessed Martinian,
for us who keep your memory with faith!

commemoration.title: Saints Martinian, Zoe, and Photina of Caesarea in Palestine

value.text:
You lit a material fire, all-blessed one,
against the attacks of the enemy.
You acquired continual remembrance of the eternal fire,
completely putting out the burning of pleasures!
You set your feet upon a rock, venerable one,
where you built a house for yourself.
As a pilgrim through many lands,
you received a crown for your endurance!

commemoration.title: Venerable Auxentius of Bithynia

value.text:
Most blessed and venerable Father Auxentius,
the pure wisdom of the Holy Spirit lived within your heart,
showing you to be an enemy of the spirits of wickedness.
You were awesome; a healer of hidden illnesses.
Therefore, since you have boldness before God, the Lover of mankind,
by your unceasing prayers, free us from passions of soul and body!

commemoration.title: Venerable Auxentius of Bithynia

value.text:
You cleansed yourself in mind
and were enriched with the grace of healings and miracles.
You shook off the weakness of the passions
together with the darkness and triple attacks of the flesh.
You fashioned splendid spiritual armor,
shining forth from the ranks of monastics!
Entreat the Lover of mankind for those who praise you!

commemoration.title: Venerable Auxentius of Bithynia

value.text:
You increased the talent given to you, all-wise one.
You thoroughly worked the soil of your soul.
You sowed it with tears, Father, reaping with joy.
You truly harvested abundant joy and consolation!
Therefore, God-bearing Auxentius,
since you have boldness before the Master,
entreat Him for those who praise you!

commemoration.title: Venerable Auxentius of Bithynia

value.text:
You put forth more effort in the ascetic life,
receiving from God an outpouring of spiritual gifts
to heal infirmities and drive out demons,
most blessed Auxentius!
You were faithful to the calling of Christ,
filled with divine grace and the power of the Spirit.
Openly guided by Him, you have reached a calm haven.

commemoration.title: Sunday of Meatfare of the Last Judgment

value.text:
Today we celebrate with hymns
the holy memory of the divine apostle Onesimus!
He was a martyr for God, adopted by Him
through grace for the sake of the faith.
He was begotten by the faith of Paul:
Let us all praise him!

commemoration.title: Sunday of Meatfare of the Last Judgment

value.text:
You became a disciple of the Word
in thanks to the divine and most praised preacher and apostle Paul.
Thrice-blessed Onesimus,
you received three times a double crown from Christ:
You were adorned as priest and preacher,
and as an athlete, all-praised one!

commemoration.title: Sunday of Meatfare of the Last Judgment

value.text:
You were profitable indeed, Onesimus!
You escaped by nature the slavery of delusion.
You became, wise one, a child of God,
through grace, the Holy Spirit and faith in Christ.
You joined the divine and all-praised disciples of Paul.

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (Recruit)

value.text:
Christ has given you to the world as a rich gift, O Theodore,
for He is God our benefactor
Who received the gift of your precious blood offered to Him,
shed for His sake with the zeal of piety!
Now you stand before Him with prayers and boldness, martyr:
Save all those who turn to you!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (Recruit)

value.text:
You are a strong pillar against the assaults of enemies;
an invincible champion of those who praise you,
a speedy aid, a fervent advocate,
a quick deliverer and helper.
You are a most powerful intercessor,
saving all those who entreat you in faith, blessed Theodore!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (Recruit)

value.text:
Theodore, you have revealed to the world
the gift of sanctification and the richness of divine life!
For Christ has glorified your memory, wise one.
Therefore, we the faithful rejoice together,
singing hymns to the struggle of your sufferings!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (Recruit)

value.text:
You possessed a torrent of sweetness
and the water of remission of sins.
You were a most true witness to the merciful Christ!
Deliver me from the torrent of my sins;
calm the troubled waters for me,
still the tempest of temptations,
guide me to the calm haven on high,
rightly blessed Theodore!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Theodore the Tyro (Recruit)

value.text:
By prayer you armed yourself with the courage of a martyr,
athlete of Christ!
You allied yourself mystically with His power,
struggling to offer rational sacrifice to God.
You laid low the godlessness of idolatry and the threats of torturers,
despising tortures and the passing fire.
How great the gifts of God in both reality and name!
By your prayers, save those who celebrate your memory from all misfortune!

commemoration.title: Saint Leo the Great, Pope of Rome

value.text:
What shall we name you, God-inspired one?
Head of the Orthodox Church of Christ?
Eye of piety, clearly seeing hearts with spiritual understanding,
pouring out the word of life to all the ends of the earth?
Divinely inscribed scroll of the true faith?
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Leo the Great, Pope of Rome

value.text:
What shall we now call you, wondrous one?
Preacher of the truth and firm foundation?
Senior among the honored council?
Excellent rule of teachings, possessing the measure of correction?
The one who cut down the division of Nestorius and the confusion of Eutyches
with divinely-wrought revelations?

commemoration.title: Saint Leo the Great, Pope of Rome

value.text:
What shall we now call you, marvelous one?
Prince and ruler in spiritual splendor,
exercising mastery over the passions of the body?
Vessel of divine mercy; dwelling of perfect love?
Loving pastor, awaiting the repentance of sinners?
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Apostles of the Seventy Archippus  and Philemon, and Martyr Apphia

value.text:
With the light of his preaching,
Archippus illumined the people and delivered them from the darkness of unbelief!
He suffered and he trampled down the enemy,
hastening to the never fading radiance.
Now he rejoices with the angels:
Through his prayers, Master, grant great mercy to all.

commemoration.title: Apostles of the Seventy Archippus  and Philemon, and Martyr Apphia

value.text:
You sanctified the earth, divinely-wise martyr,
with the divine streams of your blood.
By your wounds you wounded a host of evil demons.
You ever pour forth healings,
healing the most serious sufferings.
Therefore, in your prayers, blessed one,
ask that great mercy be granted to all!

commemoration.title: Apostles of the Seventy Archippus  and Philemon, and Martyr Apphia

value.text:
You were dragged and pierced, blessed one,
and attacked by all sorts of cruel torture.
You did not deny Christ or worship the idols.
Therefore, you received a crown
and you pray that great mercy be granted to all!

commemoration.title: Saint Leo, Bishop of Catania in Sicily

value.text:
The Church of Christ contains you as a living pillar, Leo,
and a proclaimer of the true teachings of the Word.
She ever remains unshaken,
beholding the truth and glorifying the Lord, the Master of all,
Who has glorified you!

commemoration.title: Saint Leo, Bishop of Catania in Sicily

value.text:
Lord, You revealed the holy bishop
as a sharp sword against the ungodly,
fighting, Word, for Your Orthodox faith;
cutting down false teachings!
Thus, Master, you increased good teaching in the world!

commemoration.title: Saint Leo, Bishop of Catania in Sicily

value.text:
You revealed Your bishop in the world, Lord,
to be a succesesor to the apostles in word and deed!
He was a preacher of true doctrine,
therefore You made him an instructor of hierarchs
and a partaker of Your incorruptible glory!

commemoration.title: Venerable Timothy of Symbola in Bithynia

value.text:
Possessing a heavenly life,
you were truly ordained by God to serve as a priest!
With a pure mind you offered up the sacrifice to Him.
You endured misfortunes and sufferings, blessed one,
for the sake of godly preaching and steadfast truth
which you confirmed by your words,
openly denouncing the senseless one!

commemoration.title: Venerable Timothy of Symbola in Bithynia

value.text:
Most-blessed, God-bearer Eustathius,
wielding the staff of your words,
all-sacred shepherd,
you preserved the rational flock of God
unharmed from all types of wolves!
Therefore the good Shepherd led you to the fold of heaven
where the souls of the elect and the righteous abide!

commemoration.title: Venerable Timothy of Symbola in Bithynia

value.text:
All-sacred Eustathius,
with bolts of sacred teaching,
you openly set ablaze the tinder of Arius' blasphemy:
He said that the Son is not equal to the Father!
You enlighten the hearts of those who celebrate your memorial with faith,
strengthening them with truth!

commemoration.title: Sunday of Cheesefare: Expulsion of Adam from Paradise

value.text:
Putting off the garments of mortality, glorious martyrs,
through varied kinds of torture,
you clothed yourselves in the divine vesture of incorruption
and now you dwell in the heavens!
You ever stand before the throne of God,
divinely blessed and all-radiant ones.
Therefore we celebrate your most splendid memory with faith,
and we kiss the shrine of your relics with reverence.

commemoration.title: Sunday of Cheesefare: Expulsion of Adam from Paradise

value.text:
Healing from illness is given by God
to those who approach the meager dust of the bodies of the passionbearers.
They pour forth a spring of miracles:
Draw near, and let us draw forth health of soul and body.
Let us cry out with thanksgiving and say:
Savior of the world, the long-suffering One
for Whose sake the honored athletes suffered,
by their prayers, remove us from all harm!

commemoration.title: Sunday of Cheesefare: Expulsion of Adam from Paradise

value.text:
You were indeed victorious, martyrs!
For many years your relics were hidden in the earth.
Now you have been revealed as a treasure of great value,
enriching the Church of Christ.
You are carried in the hands of a wise bishop,
brought with honor into the Church of God,
given to those who ask, for their health and benefit;
for the enlightenment and aid of those who accept you as the beloved faithful of God!

commemoration.title: First and second finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist of the Lord, John

value.text:
The head of the Forerunner is made manifest.
Once it was concealed in an earthen vessel;
now it is openly given up from the depths of the earth,
pouring forth streams of healing.
For he washed in the waters the head of the One
Who even now covers the chambers of the firmament with waters
and rains down divine forgiveness for mankind!
Then let us bless this truly praiseworthy head
and joyfully celebrate its finding,
entreating Christ to grant our souls great mercy!

commemoration.title: First and second finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist of the Lord, John

value.text:
A treasury of divine gifts,
your head, Forerunner, guarded by God,
has risen from the depths of the earth!
As we faithfully receive it and venerate it, glorious one,
we are made rich through you, Baptist of Christ,
with marvelous wonders and remission of sins!

commemoration.title: First and second finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist of the Lord, John

value.text:
The head which proclaimed the Lamb of God Who appeared in the flesh
declared to all the ways of saving repentance with divine precepts,
before it had denounced the transgression of Herod
and therefore was severed from its body.
It was concealed for a time
and has risen to us as a shining sun,
crying out: Repent and with compunction of soul submit to the Lord
Who grants the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: First and second finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist of the Lord, John

value.text:
Rejoice, holy and light-bearing head,
venerated by the angels!
Of old, you were cut off by the sword,
for you had cut through the shame of impurity with incisive reproofs!
Like a fountain refreshing the faithful with wonders,
you declared the saving coming of the Savior,
and perceived the coming of the Spirit,
Who took up His abode in you,
as you stood between the grace of the old and new covenants.
Entreat Christ God to grant our souls great mercy!

commemoration.title: First and second finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner, and Baptist of the Lord, John

value.text:
Your head, all-praised John,
the all-revered shrine of divine thoughts,
has shone forth today from the secret places of the earth.
From your mother's womb it clearly foresaw the mystery of ineffable being
and has made the whole earth fragrant,
pouring forth the sweet oil of sanctification,
spiritually preaching the way of repentance,
and entreating the Savior of all on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Tarasius, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
You that love the things of God, honoring those of the Spirit,
come today and let us behold the banquet
of the sweet savor of abstinence
which Tarasius, the godly host, by his immaterial virtues,
has prepared for us in spirit.
Let us all cry out eagerly:
We entreat you, pray that we may obtain forgiveness of our sins!

commemoration.title: Saint Tarasius, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
You received everything of Christ
and the blessedness of giving alms in love for the poor.
Pouring forth alms upon them richly,
you received the mercy of the promise,
for mercy will cry out to be praised at the judgment.
Therefore you departed to life!
We beseech you, pray that we may obtain forgiveness of our sins!

commemoration.title: Saint Tarasius, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
You revealed the faith to the whole world in truth,
wise and eminent father,
you wrote it in stone, shaking off the dirt of heresy,
establishing the beauty of the Church,
as you followed the teachings of the apostles of Christ.
Together with them we all cry out to you:
Rightly-praised father, pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Porphyrius, Bishop of Gaza

value.text:
As of old, God saved the three youths from the fire by His angel,
so now He has saved three youths by you!
They had been dragged down into a pit.
God bore them up as in a basket,
overshadowing them with the light of a cloud
which formed three crosses on their bodies,
reproving those who opposed you, Porphyrius!

commemoration.title: Saint Porphyrius, Bishop of Gaza

value.text:
Who can worthily sing hymns to your temptations and pains,
your misfortunes and tribulations, Porphyrius,
your struggles for the faith!
For you showed that you have great boldness before God.
Therefore, we entreat you for the sake of that boldness,
pray on our behalf to the Lord that we may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Porphyrius, Bishop of Gaza

value.text:
Venerable father Porphyrius,
you took the Cross of Christ upon your shoulder,
abandoning all and reaching the desert.
Armed with fasting and prayers,
you battled with the ruler of this world.
Therefore as a temple of the Spirit of God,
you cast him down together with carnal mindedness.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
As the archangel Raphael guided Tobit in a foreign land long ago,
Bishop Raphael kept his flock on the true path in a land far from their homes.
Always imitating the Good Shepherd, he fed his many sheep
from a table which the Lord prepared in the presence of their enemies.
So now, as we are fed by his teaching and example,
we pray that he will continue to intercede for us with Christ our God!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn
Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
Let all the choirs of Orthodox Christians in America
sing hymns in honor of the holy bishop Raphael!
By birth an Arab, fed by streams of Greek theology,
he was consecrated by the Church of Russia, which had adopted us all.
True to his name, he brings God’s healing to us
as we celebrate his holy memory.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
Holy father Raphael, you embodied the love of Christ from your youth.
You were sent to America, son of Antioch, as an apostle to the lost sheep of Syria.
Without concern for your own comfort, you labored night and day,
traversing the continent, never pausing to rest.
As you have boldness before Christ our God, entreat Him to save our souls.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
In you, good shepherd Raphael
the faithful found sustenance for their souls and protection from their foes.
Keeping your eyes not on obstacles but on the prize from above,
you counted earthly gain as loss:
You imitated Christ by laying down your life for your flock!
As you have boldness before Christ our God, entreat Him to save our souls.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
Your children praise you as a wise hierarch of the Church in America,
who unified the faithful from every land,
defending the oppressed and guarding the Faith!
You held the high and humble in equal esteem,
treating all with Christ’s own gentleness.
Now as you stand among the saints, holy father Raphael,
never cease to intercede for us with Christ our God!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
Holy father Raphael,
You worked as a good shepherd,
searching far and near for your lost sheep.
Binding their wounds in love as their father in the Spirit,
you carried them to Christ on your own shoulders.
As you have boldness before Christ our God, entreat Him to save our souls.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
Today a great festival shines like the sun over the whole world,
as we celebrate the memory of the holy bishop Raphael,
the apostle to the lost sheep of North America!
Let us rejoice on this festal day and cry out to him:
Rejoice, new Moses, who led your people into the Promised Land!
Rejoice, new Elijah, who bequeathed a double portion of your spirit to us!
Rejoice, new Ezra, who built a temple of God in our midst!
Rejoice, new apostle of Christ our God, drawing us closer to Him!
As you stand among the saints before the throne of God,
never cease to intercede for us who honor you!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Raphael, Bishop of Brooklyn

value.text:
Holy hierarch Raphael,
who can describe your many toils?
Who can count the hardships you endured?
As a shepherd of Christ’s rational flock
pray that He may preserve His Church in peace!

commemoration.title: 1st Saturday of Great Lent: The Miracle of the Boiled Wheat

value.text:
You cut off all love of pleasure, divine one,
thus freeing your body from slavery.
You harrowed your senses with the struggles of abstinence:
Through the terrible conditions in which you lived,
the endurance of temptations and evil situations.
Therefore you have received unending delight,
everlasting sweetness and ineffable joy!

commemoration.title: 1st Saturday of Great Lent: The Miracle of the Boiled Wheat

value.text:
You desired blessedness past understanding,
so you reckoned abstinence as your food,
poverty to be your wealth,
lack of acquisitiveness as abundant possessions,
and humility as glory, wondrous one!
Therefore you received your desire
in accordance with your understanding:
You abide in the tabernacles of the saints, Basil!

commemoration.title: 1st Saturday of Great Lent: The Miracle of the Boiled Wheat

value.text:
You steadfastly completed the course of abstinence and kept the faith!
Therefore you have been adorned with the crown of righteousness
which Christ has prepared for you, Father,
rewarding you in accordance with your worth
and granting you honors and rewards for your struggles.
Divinely inspired one, beseech Him to save our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Eudokia of Heliopolis

value.text:
You received the divine seed, divinely blessed one,
in the furrows of your heart as in rich soil.
You brought forth indeed the grain of martyrdom,
producing the harvest a hundredfold.
You stored it up in the granaries of divine reason
through the power of the spirit who transformed you,
working in you a greater change through grace,
all-praised Evdokia!

commemoration.title: Martyr Eudokia of Heliopolis

value.text:
You raised the dead, glorious Evdokia,
through your life-creating words,
having first mortified the passions of your body
with the pangs of abstinence.
Having completed your course of martyrdom with the aid of the Spirit
you now live with the martyrs in heaven,
and you pray for all who hymn you in faith.

commemoration.title: Martyr Eudokia of Heliopolis

value.text:
You first cast down the rebellion of the flesh through fasting;
then you destroyed the wiles of the enemy through martyrdom!
You triumphed over him, blessed Evdokia!
Therefore, Jesus has crowned you for your two-fold struggle,
as the Lover of mankind and the Savior of our souls!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Theodotus, Bishop of Cyrenia

value.text:
Although you were stretched out on a tree
and cruelly beaten with thongs of leather,
shut up in prison, your feet inhumanly pierced with nails
and placed on a fiery bier,
you revealed yourself, wondrous one, to be unchanged:
Glorifying Him Who strengthened you in all things,
bishop and martyr Theodotus!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Theodotus, Bishop of Cyrenia

value.text:
You revealed yourself, most glorious one,
to be a most holy priest,
the foundation of the Church, an unshakeable pillar,
a most true and God-given wonderworker!
You became a most radiant lamp,
having acquired the life-giver Jesus
like the tree of life in the middle of Paradise,
bishop and martyr Theodotus!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Theodotus, Bishop of Cyrenia

value.text:
You strangled the enemy with the thongs of your struggle,
and overthrew his power!
You took courage, most brilliant one
and now wearing the crown of victory,
you live in the kingdom of heaven.
You have been counted worthy of enlightenment
and the beauty of those who feast!
You pray that those who honor you may be saved,
Theodotus, glory of martyrs!

commemoration.title: Venerable Gerasimus of the Jordan

value.text:
Divinely wise Father Gerasimus,
you united yourself to God
through prayer, intercession and great abstinence!
You remained impervious to the wiles of the enemy,
showing yourself a servant of the Almighty!
Therefore we honor you;
we faithfully celebrate your divine memory with great joy
as we praise you!

commemoration.title: Venerable Gerasimus of the Jordan

value.text:
Divinely blessed one,
you submitted to the command of God who beholds everything,
receiving grace from Him to work miracles:
You drove away evil spirits
and tamed wild beasts by the purity of your mind!
Therefore we honor you
and fittingly celebrate your godly memory with faith!

commemoration.title: Venerable Gerasimus of the Jordan

value.text:
Venerable Father Gerasimus,
you were steadfast in the faith!
You sought God in the deserts, caves and mountains,
finding him as you desired.
You were strengthened by steadfastness of soul and lofty wisdom,
leading a multitude of saved monastics to God!

commemoration.title: Martyr Conon of Isauria

value.text:
Unfading and divine radiance,
light-bearing brilliance of the commandments of God,
ever-memorable athlete,
most excellent of martyrs!
You have dispelled the gloom of darkness like a brilliant star!
You are a good offering, blessed one;
an unblemished sacrifice.
therefore, ever entreat Christ that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Conon of Isauria

value.text:
Proclaimer of the truth:
You revealed yourself to be a sword-wielding enemy of ungodliness.
You cut off the head of the enemy with your suffering, all-wise one.
You clearly proclaimed the commandment of God,
saying good things to the untaught people.
Co-dweller with the martyrs, Conon,
entreat the Savior that He may deliver from the passions
Your servants who honor You with hymns!

commemoration.title: Martyr Conon of Isauria

value.text:
What a good change the Lord of our fathers made in you
by the right hand of the Most High!
Most glorious athlete,
you were revealed to be a fruit blossoming from the root of unbelief.
Most blessed and all-praised Conon,
you had Christ as your most excellent Commander,
as you mightily overthrew the hordes of demons!

commemoration.title: 42 Martyrs of Ammoria in Phrygia

value.text:
Noble and victorious martyrs,
you were revealed in the final times
as unwaning stars in the Church's honored firmament.
You illumined all beneath the sun, all-praised ones,
with the splendor of your sufferings,
destroying the darkness of deception!
Therefore we celebrate your radiant and sacred suffering in faith,
enriched by your intercession.

commemoration.title: 42 Martyrs of Ammoria in Phrygia

value.text:
Let us shout the praise of Constantine,
Basoes and Callistus,
Theodore and Theophilus,
and the rest of the divine company of athletes,
for they sacrificed themselves with joy,
electing to die for the Life of all.
Now they rest in the city of the living God,
entreating that on the day of judgment,
we may find remission of sins and complete deliverance.

commemoration.title: 42 Martyrs of Ammoria in Phrygia

value.text:
O Martyrs of Christ,
you were bound after a summary arrest
and shut up in prison for a lengthy time.
You were divine preservers of the faith,
who refused to submit to his evil commands.
Therefore the infamous beast was enraged and slew you with the sword.
Now you have joyfully inherited higher things,
joining yourselves to the Kingdom,
all-glorious two and forty!

commemoration.title: 2nd Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
You were unvanquished martyrs,
heavenly-minded fathers!
All-praised hierarchs and beacons of the universe,
immovable pillars of the church of God,
and a foundation of its teachings,
instructors of the righteous and destroyers of falsehood,
light-bearing guides for our souls,
fellow citizens with the angels,
and champions of the Trinity!

commemoration.title: 2nd Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
Let the glorious Ephraim be blessed with divine speeches
together with the divinely wise Basil,
the great Capito, the godly Agathadorus,
Elpidius, Aetherius and the glorious Eugene:
For they lived righteously and suffered in a holy way.
They were revealed to be inhabitants of the Kingdom of heaven!

commemoration.title: 2nd Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
Having slain fleshly knowledge with ascetic labors,
by invoking the name of God,
the glorious Basil raised up a man from the dead!
The most holy shepherd, Capito,
was seen unconsumed while he stood and rejoiced in the midst of the fire!
By their supplications, Lover of mankind,
grant us the means of atonement and Your great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint Theophylactus, Bishop of Nicomedia

value.text:
Father Theophylact,
divine guardians watched over you and preserved you unharmed.
You were revealed to be an unshaken pillar of the Church,
undaunted by the trials of heretical snares!
Pray for us now that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Theophylactus, Bishop of Nicomedia

value.text:
You departed the earth, Father Theophylact,
hastening on high, blessed one, to heaven.
For the exile you endured for Christ,
you were blessed to live in the heavenly mansions.
Beseech Him now that He may grant peace and great mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Theophylactus, Bishop of Nicomedia

value.text:
Blessed father Theophylact,
you visibly beheld God with understanding!
You delighted in Him through a greater union,
you were deified by partaking of Him!
You received with rejoicing the blessed One Whom alone you desired,
most honored hierarch,
and now you make your dwelling with the angels!

commemoration.title: Saint Sophronius, Patriarch of Jerusalem

value.text:
Your mouth thundered forth the teachings of theology,
all-blessed Sophronius!
You clearly expounded the theology of the unoriginate Father,
the co-eternal Son
and the equally everlasting Holy Spirit:
The Trinity in unity and unity in Trinity;
one God in essence!

commemoration.title: Saint Sophronius, Patriarch of Jerusalem

value.text:
You wisely taught that the Word is equally unoriginate with the Father,
most wise one;
that though incorporeal, He united flesh to His Person,
without change or confusion;
that His actions are two-fold,
for both natures from which He acts and is beheld
are revealed as contained, one in the other,
for He is One, undivided in Essence.

commemoration.title: Saint Sophronius, Patriarch of Jerusalem

value.text:
You were called Sophronius by divine foreknowledge:
A name meaning chastity.
You were righteous and chaste in your deeds,
courageous and wise.
As a most eminent administrator,
you were crowned nobly with natural virtues of both soul and body
and you grew in them with steadfastness.

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory Dialogus, Pope of Rome

value.text:
You were arrayed in the vestments of a bishop,
thrice-blessed one:
You entered the holy of holies,
with pure lips, like an angel, sending up praise to your Master!
As the godly shepherd of Rome,
enlightened with deifying splendor,
you taught the faithful the theology of the faith,
divinely radiant Gregory:
teacher of the church
and initiate of the mysteries of the grace of God!

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory Dialogus, Pope of Rome

value.text:
From Christ you received the helm of the church of Rome,
Bishop Gregory of great renown.
You piloted its ship to the haven of salvation!
Through the teaching of your divinely wise words,
you saved it from the tempests of the enemy!
Since therefore you have boldness before the Lord,
earnestly ask of Him peace for the world and salvation for our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory Dialogus, Pope of Rome

value.text:
Ever cleaving to the Lord,
and united to the divine fire in purity, hierarch,
you set down the liturgy of the presanctified gifts,
thus sanctifying the faithful during the days of the fast;
rescuing them from the snares of the enemy.
You guided them into the fold of heaven,
revealing yourself to be a pillar of fire
through the splendor of your piety
and the brightness of your divine teachings,
God-bearing Father Gregory!

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory Dialogus, Pope of Rome

value.text:
Holy Gregory,
you preserved blamelessly the bishop's holy anointing.
By the grace of Christ you caused its gifts to increase like talents,
in all things you were well pleasing to the only Lord of glory:
in love and meekness, in ardor of faith,
in compassion and prayer.
Thus, divinely eloquent one, in the meadow of salvation,
you faithfully shepherded the reason-endowed flock of Christ.

commemoration.title: Venerable Theophanes the Confessor of Sigriane

value.text:
Divinely-wise Father Theophanes,
named for the Theophany of Christ,
you followed in His life-bearing steps,
forsaking all the beauties of life.
You directed your gaze towards Him Whom you desired
You were deified by beauty and a divine inclination towards Him,
in excellent perfection, greatly venerated one.

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory Dialogus, Pope of Rome

value.text:
Today your divine memorial, most honored one,
shines forth like the sun to the ends of the earth,
joyfully enlightening all the faithful with mystical splendors!
We assemble to honor it with holy psalms and hymns,
entreating you to beseech Christ, divinely glorious one,
on behalf of those who sing your praises.

commemoration.title: Venerable Theophanes the Confessor of Sigriane

value.text:
The Bestower of good things has indeed richly granted to you
rewards for your labors, imparting power, most blessed one,
to expel demons and heal afflictions.
He counted you worthy of ineffable joy
where the angelic ranks sing in chorus
as they ever gaze on the face of the Almighty

commemoration.title: Venerable Theophanes the Confessor of Sigriane

value.text:
Divinely-wise Father Theophanes,
you were steadfast in afflictions of the flesh.
You patiently endured bitter exile for the sake of the precious icons,
taking no pity on your body, all-praised one.
You were banished by the wrath of Leo:
You mocked him, disregarding his counsels, vain thoughts and evil mind.

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of Saint Nikephoros, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
The streams of your wisdom
were drawn from the spiritual clouds,
pouring forth a fountain of Orthodoxy upon the world.
We the faithful draw forth the sweetness from there
and we turn from the outpourings of heresy
as from the bitter waters of Marah!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of Saint Nikephoros, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
As your most pure body lay in the tomb,
it did not in any way decay.
It was found to be whole, most blessed Nicephorus!
We bear it forth with zeal.
we rejoice, fed by the Orthodox faith,
and we bless you, divinely-wise one!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of Saint Nikephoros, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
The Church which is honored by the name of the apostles,
received you, most blessed one,
for through your godly deeds,
you became a temple of God.
After your burial you are again buried in a holy manner
and you have buried the foolish talk of the heretics!

commemoration.title: 3rd Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
You were the adornment of monastics, Benedict,
assembling a countless multitude to hymn the Lord.
You guided the steps of all to heaven
who rightly followed your divine teachings
and imitated your virtuous life, Father!
With them, we fittingly honor you,
rejoicing in your dormition.

commemoration.title: 3rd Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
You called down rain from the skies, Father, by your divine prayers,
like Elijah of old!
You caused a vessel to pour forth with oil, venerable one;
you raised the dead and worked many other miracles
to the glory of the God and Savior of all!
Therefore with love we celebrate your glorious memory, Benedict!

commemoration.title: 3rd Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
Father, you denied the world from your youth.
You were joyful with true faith and love
as you followed the crucified Christ!
You mortified your flesh through many tasks of obedience
and received richly the gift of healing:
You alleviated various illnesses and drove out evil spirits
to their great astonishment!

commemoration.title: 3rd Sunday of Great Lent: Veneration of the Cross

value.text:
You seven martyrs of Christ
counted the assaults of the torturers and violent death to be nothing!
You hastened to battle with readiness and courage,
covering yourselves with the glory of victory!
You are numbered among all the righteous;
we call you blessed, glorifying you with them forever!

commemoration.title: 3rd Sunday of Great Lent: Veneration of the Cross

value.text:
Martyred athlete Agapius,
you loved the well-spring of good things and the summit of desires!
You hastened to drain the cup of martyrdom,
calling on the divine name of the living God.
What courage was yours; what endurance,
by which you were openly given the gift of glory and splendor!

commemoration.title: 3rd Sunday of Great Lent: Veneration of the Cross

value.text:
All-blessed martyrs,
you gave yourselves to voluntary slaughter;
you sanctified the earth with your blood
and illumined the air with your passage.
Now in the image of God you live in the heavens
ever praying for us to the never-fading Light!

commemoration.title: Saint Patrick, Bishop of Armagh, Enlightener of Ireland

value.text:
Holy Patrick cries out to the newly-enlightened Christians:
Listen, my spiritual children:
I have begotten you as the Gospel says;
I have betrothed you as a bride to Christ God.
Stand fast, therefore, in the Faith and confess it fearlessly!
Do not be afraid of the hostile pagans,
that God may manifest Himself to you as a great Helper and Protector!

commemoration.title: Saint Patrick, Bishop of Armagh, Enlightener of Ireland

value.text:
Rejoice, hills and groves of Ireland!
Leap for joy, lakes and rivers!
For behold, through the grace of God from on high,
blessing and strength have come upon you,
for your enlightener and spiritual father comes to you:
Patrick, glorious among hierarchs,
a zealot of the Orthodox Faith,
chosen by God as an apostle!

commemoration.title: Saint Patrick, Bishop of Armagh, Enlightener of Ireland

value.text:
Who can tell the pains and struggles you endured,
preaching the Word of God to those in pagan darkness, Patrick?
Who can tell the tears which you shed in nightly vigil
as you prayed alone in the wilderness,
struggling against the fear of wild beasts and assaults of demons
by the power of the Cross of Christ
which you planted triumphantly over all Ireland!

commemoration.title: Saint Patrick, Bishop of Armagh, Enlightener of Ireland

value.text:
Great is your faith, holy bishop Patrick!
Having left your homeland and lands enlightened by Christ,
you journeyed to a land lying in the darkness of idolatry,
bringing the Gospel of Christ to the lost.
You did not depart ‘till you had brought the whole land to the Orthodox Faith.
Therefore we rightly praise you!

commemoration.title: Saint Cyril, Archbishop of Jerusalem

value.text:
You put the evil mind of the senseless Manes to shame,
denouncing the unworthy teachings of his foolishness wisely and well,
chief among teachers and splendor of priests;
Godly champion of the Church of Christ!
Therefore in gladness we celebrate your holy dormition.

commemoration.title: Saint Cyril, Archbishop of Jerusalem

value.text:
You shone like a star, enlightening the faithful
with the sacred brightness of your teachings,
while you darkened the heresies.
You were victorious to the end,
as a servant increasing the talent given to you.
You were well-pleasing to God, Cyril, blessed one of God,
and you surrendered your spirit into His hands.

commemoration.title: Saint Cyril, Archbishop of Jerusalem

value.text:
In the wisdom of your words and the splendor of your life,
you shone forth in the midst of the council of the fathers
like a most luminous star.
You were worthy of working wonders!
You choked the godless Macedonius with the cords of grace
as he madly blasphemed and openly worked iniquity
against the Holy Spirit Who gives life to all!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Chrysanthus and Daria, and those with them at Rome

value.text:
Daria of glorious fame,
you were wounded with the sweetest love of the Creator
and turned away from all ungodliness.
Through the many torments of your body,
you found within yourself a bridal chamber of God.
You were a divine vessel of the Spirit,
the adornment of athletes and the ornament of virgins!
You betrothed yourself to Christ by the many torments of your body!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Chrysanthus and Daria, and those with them at Rome

value.text:
Having received the illumination of the knowledge of God,
the eyes of your heart were enlightened.
you wisely abandoned the darkness of delusion, wise one!
You confessed Christ, the Lord Who took flesh for all.
Therefore, most praised Chrysanthus,
you were made strong by the might of the Spirit,
and were shown to be stronger than your torturers.

commemoration.title: Martyrs Chrysanthus and Daria, and those with them at Rome

value.text:
You counted the bait of the enemy and the burning of pleasures to be like a cobweb.
As you stood in the dark dungeon,
you were illumined with the light of God
and filled with spiritual fragrance
though you were surrounded by the stench of filth.
As a most excellent escort,
you led as a blameless bride to Christ
the woman who had sought to defile you!

commemoration.title: Martyred Holy Fathers who were slain at the Monastery of Saint Savva

value.text:
Suffocated and consumed by fire,
you committed your souls into the hands of the King of all
as unblemished sacrifices, glorious martyrs!
You have joined yourselves to the choirs of the bodiless powers
and inherited the everlasting glory.
Ever pray that those who sing praises to you
may also share in that glory!

commemoration.title: Martyred Holy Fathers who were slain at the Monastery of Saint Savva

value.text:
You were beaten with clubs, stoned with rocks,
and cut down by swords.
Yet, martyrs, you did not break the unity of your mind
bound together by love and fraternal desire!
Together you were put to death and cut limb from limb.
You placed yourselves upon the altar of God
as unblemished sacrifices, passion-bearers!

commemoration.title: Martyred Holy Fathers who were slain at the Monastery of Saint Savva

value.text:
Completely loving the highest of all desires,
you counted the beauties of life to be refuse, venerable Fathers.
Through vigil and prayer, through rain and burning heat,
you acquired those things which alone abide.
You lived together as one soul
and by grace were shown to be companions of the angels!

commemoration.title: 4th Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
Ever-memorable one,
you were revealed to be innocent, guileless, and merciful,
filled with brotherly love, humility, meekness and charity.
You were adorned with compassion,
gifted with patience, faith and hope.
You were enriched with prayer.
In holiness, you were illumined by the brightness of God!

commemoration.title: 4th Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
You were crucified to the world and to the passions,
preserving your soul undefiled and pure,
untainted by low things, Father James.
Thus you soared to the heavens with mystical visions.
there you set forth your life as a true friend of Christ,
ever-memorable one,
and a most faithful saint.

commemoration.title: 4th Saturday of Great Lent: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
You desired the glory which is eternal and does not pass away,
scorning the glory that is transitory and perishing.
You took up your Cross and followed after the crucified One,
subjecting your flesh to ascetic struggles.
therefore, James, we celebrate your memory!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Basil of Ancyra

value.text:
You were flayed by the unjust judge,
enduring bodily pains, glorious one,
looking forward to a painless end
and to the honors prepared for those who suffer.
Tempered like steel in the fire,
you became a well-forged sword of heaven,
cutting down the hosts of the enemy, blessed one.
Therefore, every nation of believers rejoices and honors you today,
courageous-minded athlete, truly glorious Basil!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Basil of Ancyra

value.text:
Adorned with the garment of the priesthood,
you served God like an angel, Basil of great renown,
offering sacrifice to Him
Who for our sakes appeared in the substance of flesh.
Therefore you were sacrificed like a perfect lamb,
becoming a pure offering.
Now you have offered yourself upon the altar of heaven.
Therefore, with voices of joy,
we ever call you blessed, crying out to you:
Pray without ceasing that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Basil of Ancyra

value.text:
You were bound and adorned with wounds,
going from city to city,
binding the tyrant and rightly guiding the steps of your feet.
When you had just entered the city of Caesarea
you received there your blessed end.
You were crowned and ascended at once to the city of heaven.
Now you stand before God the King.
Entreat Him to save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Nikon and 199 disciples with him in Sicily

value.text:
Neither hunger nor tribulation, truly wondrous ones,
nor nakedness nor wounds
nor the necessity of a violent death
were able to separate you from the love of God!
Crown-bearing athletes,
following the Shepherd like sheep led to the slaughter,
from the sunset you reached the unending rest of the heavenly Kingdom!

commemoration.title: Martyr Nikon and 199 disciples with him in Sicily

value.text:
You shone forth from the east like the sun,
most glorious one,
bringing light to the whole world with the radiance of miracles,
guiding the choir of your brilliant disciples like a star!
Together with them you suffered in might.
You were beheaded by the sword,
placing your souls in the hands of the King and Master of all.

commemoration.title: Martyr Nikon and 199 disciples with him in Sicily

value.text:
Using abstinence as a bridle, you curbed the pleasures of the body
and the disobedience of the flesh, blessed one.
Courageous, you vanquished the full armor of the enemy
by the power of the Spirit.
Therefore you were a leader of monastics
who ever followed your most wise and divine preaching, Nikon.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Annunciation

value.text:
The palace of light is ready for you, Master:
The womb of the undefiled child of God.
Come down to her; come to visit your fallen world,
held in bitter slavery to the jealous enemy.
Many ages have passed since its beauty was destroyed.
Make haste to descend to earth, O Lord!
Come to deliver us from the way of death!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Annunciation

value.text:
Gabriel the archangel comes to you, all-blameless one;
he will greet you, crying with joy:
Rejoice, deliverance from condemnation!
Rejoice, chosen vessel made perfect for God!
Rejoice, life-bearing dawn of the endless day!
The Lord, Whom the heavens cannot contain, is pleased to dwell in you!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Annunciation

value.text:
The mystery hidden from all eternity,
unknown even by the angels,
is now entrusted to the archangel Gabriel.
He will come to you, precious vessel;
he will salute you, crying in joy:
Rejoice, pure dove!  Rejoice, all holy one!
Make ready by your word to conceive the Word of God!

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Revealing to you the pre-eternal counsel,
Gabriel came and stood before you, Maid,
and in greeting said:
Rejoice, earth that has not been sown!
Rejoice, burning bush that remains unconsumed!
Rejoice, unsearchable depth!
Rejoice, bridge that leads to heaven!
Rejoice, ladder raised on high that Jacob saw!
Rejoice, divine jar of manna!
Rejoice, deliverance from the curse!
Rejoice, restoration of Adam,
the Lord is with you!

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Then the bodiless angel replied:
When God so wills, the order of nature is overcome,
and what is beyond mankind comes to pass.
Believe that my sayings are true,
all-holy and immaculate Lady.
And she cried aloud:
Let it be to me according to your word,
and I shall bear Him Who is without flesh, Who shall borrow flesh from me,
that through this mingling He may lead mankind up to its ancient glory,
for He alone has power so to do!

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
You appeared to me in the form of a man,
said the undefiled Maid to the chief of the heavenly hosts:
How then do you speak to me of things that pass man's power?
For you have said that God shall be with me,
and shall take up His dwelling in my womb.
How shall I become the spacious habitation
and the holy place of Him Who rides upon the cherubim?
Do not amuse me with deceit;
for I have not known pleasure,
I have not entered into wedlock.
How then shall I bear a Child?

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Gabriel the archangel was sent from heaven
to announce to the Virgin the glad tidings of her conceiving;
coming to Nazareth he pondered in amazement at this wonder:
How shall He Who dwells in the heights,
Whom none can comprehend, be born of a Virgin?
How shall He whose throne is heaven, and whose footstool is the earth,
be held in the womb of a woman?
He upon whom the six-winged seraphim and the many-eyed cherubim cannot gaze
has been pleased at a single word to be made flesh of this His creature!
It is the Word of God Who dwells in her.
Why then, do I stand here, and not say to the Maiden:
Rejoice, full of grace, the Lord is with you!
Rejoice, pure Virgin!
Rejoice, unwedded Bride!
Rejoice, Mother of life!
Blessed is the fruit of your womb!

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Today come forth glad tidings of joy:
It is the feast of the Virgin!
Things below are joined to things above.
Adam is renewed and Eve set free from her ancient curse,
and the tabernacle of human nature which the Lord took upon Himself
is consecrated as a temple of God.
The manner of His emptying is past knowledge;
the fashion of His conception is ineffable.
An angel ministers  at the wonder; a Virgin womb receives the Son.
The Holy Spirit is sent down; the Father on high gives His consent;
and so the covenant is brought to pass by common counsel.
In Him and through Him we are saved,
and together with Gabriel let us cry aloud to the Virgin:
Rejoice, full of grace, the Lord is with you!
From you has Christ our God and our salvation taken human nature,
raising it up to Himself:
Pray to Him that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
In the sixth month the archangel was sent to the pure Virgin,
and the bearer of glad tidings greeted her with joy,
announcing that the Redeemer would come forth from her.
She accepted his salutation with faith,
and conceived You, the pre-eternal God,
Who deigned to become Man ineffably,
for the salvation of our souls.

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
The Theotokos heard the mysterious voice
as the archangel announced the words of glad tidings.
When she accepted this salutation
she conceived You, the eternal God, in her womb.
Therefore we cry out with joy:
Unchanging God Who took flesh from her:
Grant peace to the world and to our souls, great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Annunciation of our Most Holy Lady, the Theotokos and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Behold, our restoration is now made manifest:
God is ineffably joined to mankind!
At the words of the archangel, error has vanished;
the Virgin has received the joyful news,
and the things of earth have become those of heaven!
The world is released from the ancestral curse!
Let the whole creation rejoice, singing a hymn of praise:
Lord, our Creator and Deliverer, glory to you!

commemoration.title: Martyr Matrona of Thessalonica
Martyr Matrona of Thessalonica

value.text:
You opposed with reason
the harsh threats and naked savagery of unbelievers,
for you were both divinely and humanly wise!
You foresaw the delight of things to come
which remain unchanged throughout the ages.
You received this unchanging delight
as you departed from earth to the mansions of heaven;
to the choir of unending voices, glorious one!

commemoration.title: Martyr Matrona of Thessalonica

value.text:
The yoke of slavery
did not prevent you, most glorious one,
from following the patience of the martyrs,
nor did feminine weakness, starvation, or beatings!
You endured torture with fervent strength of soul!
Therefore you have received a heavenly dwelling place:
Standing before your Creator, you are adorned with the crown of grace.

commemoration.title: 5th Saturday of Great Lent: of the Akathist to the Theotokos

value.text:
Venerable one, you were an earthly angel and heavenly man,
a fountain of compunction, a stream of compassion, a deep well of miracles!
You are surety for sinners:
an olive tree of God with the fruit of your labors
fitting to anoint the head!
We praise you in faith, wondrous Hilarion!

commemoration.title: 5th Saturday of Great Lent: of the Akathist to the Theotokos

value.text:
Your mind was illumined with the knowledge of God,
overcoming the passions of the flesh.
You did not participate in the things of this earth;
you bore the true imprint of divine goodness;
you were known to all to be like God
through cooperation with the Holy Spirit,
our Father Hilarion, the adornment of the monastic life!

commemoration.title: 5th Saturday of Great Lent: of the Akathist to the Theotokos
Venerable John Climacus of Sinai, Author of “the Ladder”

value.text:
Venerable Father John,
by faith you gave your mind wings to fly to God!
You abhorred the instability and confusion of the world;
taking up the Cross, you followed after Him Who beholds all things.
Through labors of fasting you bound your intractible body to your mind
by the power of the divine Spirit!

commemoration.title: Venerable Mary of Egypt

value.text:
Having worshipped at the holy places with great joy,
you received saving grace for the journey of virtue.
With all haste you set out joyfully upon the good path you had chosen.
You crossed the stream of the Jordan,
eagerly going to live in the dwelling place of the Forerunner.
You tamed the savagery of the passions by your ascetic way of life;
you boldly broke the rebelliousness of the flesh through abstinence,
ever-glorious Mother!

commemoration.title: Venerable Titus the Wonderworker

value.text:
Venerable and divinely inspired Titus,
you enlightened your soul with the light of the Orthodox faith!
You diminished the gloomy darkness of heresy.
Shining like a most splendid star,
you ever enlighten the ends of the world with your brilliant miracles!
Therefore we keep the feast and celebrate your memory!

commemoration.title: Venerable Titus the Wonderworker

value.text:
Titus, our divinely wise father,
you took up your Cross and followed Christ.
You made all the passions subject to your soul!
Therefore you received grace from on high
to heal the sufferings and put down the afflictions
of those who turn to you
and to cast out evil spirits.
Therefore we celebrate and bless your memory!

commemoration.title: Venerable Titus the Wonderworker

value.text:
Titus, our most blessed father,
you learned holy things by living in an ascetic way.
You enlightened your mind by divine communion.
You truly received the most holy anointing of the priesthood.
like an angel, you well served God, your Master, upon the earth!

commemoration.title: Venerable Niketas the Confessor, Abbot of Medikion

value.text:
You directed souls with your teaching.
as one who with faith guided others to knowledge of mystical things,
you showed yourself to be a divine builder.
Sowing the saving and good seeds,
you harvested fruits in abundance, God-bearer,
presenting them to your Master.
Now you stand before Him, blessed one, rejoicing!
Remember your flock which always honors you, inspired one of God!

commemoration.title: Venerable Niketas the Confessor, Abbot of Medikion

value.text:
When the most dark tyrant with brutal cruelty
imprisoned you in dark places in bitter exile,
you endured all, Father, rejoicing in your soul!
In your mind you glorified them as if they were the dwellings of paradise!
Now you behold their true beauty,
for you truly received the reward of your afflictions, blessed one!

commemoration.title: Venerable Niketas the Confessor, Abbot of Medikion

value.text:
You became simple and meek,
revealing yourself fervent in the defense of the Orthodox faith!
Covered with faith as with armor
and armed with abstinence as with a spear,
you denounced all blasphemous heresy, divinely-wise Nicetas,
honoring the divine icon of the Savior.
God-bearer, you clearly served and followed Him.

commemoration.title: The Raising of Lazarus (Lazarus Saturday)

value.text:
You were revealed to be a mystical trumpet,
calling all on high with spiritual hymns!
You were a divinely-blown clarion, praising the armies of God;
Glorifying all the saints and proclaiming their victories!
You drew a depth of words from the fountain of salvation
enriching the house of God!

commemoration.title: The Raising of Lazarus (Lazarus Saturday)

value.text:
You followed in the footsteps of the Word of God --
He Who created all from nothingness --
shaking away, as He commanded, love of worldly things
together with love of all passions.
You took up the Cross on your shoulders
and were crucified to the world.
Therefore, Father, shining with divine strength and deeds,
you received the eternal inheritance!

commemoration.title: The Raising of Lazarus (Lazarus Saturday)

value.text:
You revealed yourself to be a treasury of courage,
pleasing to God throughout all your life!
Aflame with love, you cried out, singing with sacred hymns,
calling to repentance and transformation through faith in God!
By these you were yourself a participant in the divine image,
and were revealed as the companion of joy!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Agathopodes the Deacon and Theodulus the Reader at Thessalonica

value.text:
You received names in accord with your character, wise ones,
and set out to accomplish divine works.
You labored for God in the straight paths, athletes,
truly draining the saving cup of martyrdom!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Agathopodes the Deacon and Theodulus the Reader at Thessalonica

value.text:
You parted ungodliness as though it were another sea,
entering into the land of dispassion, the Kingdom of heaven.
There, fittingly, a river of nourishment flows forth,
and, martyrs of Christ, the unchangeable and eternal Light shines!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Agathopodes the Deacon and Theodulus the Reader at Thessalonica

value.text:
Let us assemble in faith
to honor the sufferings and labors of the godly pair!
Let us set our minds with wings to soar aloft in imitation of their zeal!
Let us entreat Christ with fervor, saying:
Good One, as You are glorified in Your saints,
make us steadfast in Your fear!

commemoration.title: Saint Eutychius, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
You wisely guided your flock to the pasture of the right faith,
the living water of true wisdom,
the beautiful green of grass planted by God
for the food of incorruption which never fails or falls away!
Your mouth overflowed with the divine words of eternal life
and the thoughts which do not pass away.

commemoration.title: Saint Eutychius, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
The Church of God gave you to the flock and reasonable sheep of Christ
as an invincible champion, Eutychius.
You drove out the impious Nestorius,
who vainly blasphemed the all-glorious and pure Mother of God,
denying that she is in truth the Theotokos.
You rejected him!

commemoration.title: Saint Eutychius, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
You cut down the words of the heretics like roots and thorns
with the scythe and plow of your teaching.
You felled their vile hearts and sowed your correction:
The judgment of the divine commandments!
Showing these to be fruitful,
you earned your talent doubly,
bearing it to your Master.

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Tuesday

value.text:
Your life was illumined by the light of your great deeds,
enlightening all the faithful
and destroying the darkness of earthly passions,
for you appeared as the radiant sun, most blessed Hierarch Tikhon!
Now you dwell in the mansions of heaven
where the everlasting Light shines in glory
through the presence of the Son and the grace of the Holy Spirit.
Therefore we venerate your holy and radiant memory with unceasing honor and praise!

commemoration.title: Saint George the Confessor, Bishop of Mytilene

value.text:
Father George, you were a co-worker of God,
a priest and husbandman!
By your words, you brought the souls of the saved to the Master,
bearing fruit a hundred-fold!
Pray that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Tuesday

value.text:
You endured great suffering, Father Tikhon:
Defamation, slander and imprisonment,
false accusations and the threat of death,
vicious attacks by the enemies of the Church of Christ.
You bore these with courage and humility, crying out:
Do not despair in your hearts, but have faith in the Lord!

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Tuesday

value.text:
Civil strife and famine and war
were the burdens you bore, our bishop!
Yet you cried out to the enraged people, saying:
Love your neighbor and turn back to the Lord!
You called them to the path of salvation through repentance.

commemoration.title: Saint George the Confessor, Bishop of Mytilene

value.text:
All-wise Father George,
you venerated the holy and undefiled icon of Christ with honor!
You were strengthened by His might,
not fearing at all the threats of those who fought against God!
Entreat Him now that our souls may be granted peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint George the Confessor, Bishop of Mytilene

value.text:
Glorious Father George,
you endured the wrath of the senselessly enraged ungodly ones;
you saw them exalt themselves in impious arrogance,
and again beheld them when they were openly and utterly crushed
by the providence that moved against the foolish ones!

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Wednesday

value.text:
With thoughts higher than heaven, apostles,
you declared the glory of our God!
You were beholders of God Who by His Own will became incarnate!
You were instructors of the righteous,
foundations of the churches,
unshakable pillars and havens of true belief,
servants of ineffable mysteries,
leading our souls into light!

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Wednesday

value.text:
You hastened throughout all the earth
as if flying on eagles' wings,
sowing treasured doctrines,
by grace, uprooting the tares of falsehood!
Thus you produced a fruitful harvest, all-praised ones,
stored up forever in the granaries of wisdom:
Laid up in abundance for the immortal Husbandman!

commemoration.title: Apostle Herodion of the Seventy, and those with Him

value.text:
Let us bless Herodion,
Agabus, Asyncritus, Rufus and the divine Phlegon!
They were branches of a fruitful vine,
bringing forth the sweet drink of salvation
which with true faith in god, rejoices the thirsting hearts
of those who celebrate their divine memory in faith!

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Friday

value.text:
The many-personed unity of martyrs
endured various tortures with firmness.
they went rejoicing to the one God,
celebrating with a host of holy angelic powers!
They overcame many thousands of snakes with firm resistance
and the grace of the Spirit.

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Friday

value.text:
Let us honor with hymns the most-glorious Maximus,
the great Terence, the most-wise Pompeius,
the divine Macarius and Africanus
and with them the whole company of martyrs.
By their own blood they purchased the highest kingdom
and were filled with eternal glory!

commemoration.title: Great and Holy Friday

value.text:
Neither starvation nor misfortune,
nor life nor death
was able to separate you, glorious ones,
from the love you have towards Him Who created you!
Therefore you inherited the Kingdom of heaven,
inexhaustible sweetness and unending joy!
Pray for cleansing and mercy for us.

commemoration.title: Icon of the Mother of God of Mt. Athos, “Sweet Kissing”

value.text:
Hieromartyr, never cease to pray
for those who celebrate your memory with faith
and sing hymns to the many struggles of your martyrdom
that we may be preserved from misfortunes and tribulations
and from future corruption, Martyr Artemon, the preacher of God!

commemoration.title: Icon of the Mother of God of Mt. Athos, “Sweet Kissing”

value.text:
You lived on earth, yet united yourself to the bodiless ones.
together with them you minister without ceasing to the Trinity.
Divinely blessed Artemon, since you live as a heavenly man,
you teach mortals the divine wonders of heaven!

commemoration.title: Icon of the Mother of God of Mt. Athos, “Sweet Kissing”

value.text:
You were enlightened with the radiance of God
and your body was wasted with many tortures.
You passed over to the immaterial radiance.
By this you dispel the dark night of the passions with your prayers
enlightening our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Martin the Confessor, Pope of Rome

value.text:
What shall we call you now, Martin?
River full of spiritual waters,
ever watering souls for spiritual fertility,
lamp shining with the light of piety,
mountain pouring forth divine joy,
revealer of the words of God,
denouncer of every heresy!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Martin the Confessor, Pope of Rome

value.text:
What shall we call you now, Martin?
All-revered celebrant of the true tabernacle,
godly mediator between God and creation,
cup pouring forth divine drink,
beacon possessing the word of life,
proceeding from the west and made manifest in the east!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Martin the Confessor, Pope of Rome

value.text:
What shall we call you now, Martin?
Celebrated instructor in orthodox teachings;
sure leader of the choir of priests in the precepts of God,
most faithful denouncer of falsehood,
most valiant companion of the word,
most holy performer of the sacred mysteries,
most honored wonder-worker!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Apostle Aristarchus of the Seventy

value.text:
You followed Paul, the glorious disciple
and endured many tribulations, glorious ones.
You were imprisoned with chains and subjected to torture.
Finally you were beheaded by the sword.
Entreat Christ that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Apostle Aristarchus of the Seventy

value.text:
You preached with divine understanding
and wholly delivered the people from ignorance.
Wise apostles, you led them, saved, to the Word,
Who shone forth from the unbegotten Father.
Entreat Him that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Apostle Aristarchus of the Seventy

value.text:
Let us openly praise the true preachers of Christ:
Pudens, Aristarchus and the divine Trophimus,
for with the warmth of divine grace
they brought the winter of falsehood to an end.
Now they have made their abode in the never fading Light,
receiving the reward of the labors;
deified through ineffable communion!

commemoration.title: Bright Friday: The Life Giving Fountain of the Mother of God

value.text:
With the weapon of your words,
you wounded the assemblies of evil ones, martyr Simeon.
Therefore the clouds of heaven spoke
and choirs of angels together
continually applauded your unyielding struggles.
We glory in them as we all celebrate the feast of your holy dormition in faith,
giving glory to the Savior!

commemoration.title: Venerable John, disciple of Venerable Gregory of Decapolis

value.text:
Venerable father John,
you gave your mind wings to fly to God with faith!
You despised the disorderly state of the world
and taking up your cross,
you followed after Him Who beholds all things.
You enslaved the intemperance of your body to your mind
through ascetic feats,
by the power of the divine Spirit!

commemoration.title: Venerable John, disciple of Venerable Gregory of Decapolis

value.text:
You spent your whole life in great stillness,
in weeping and tears,
becoming a true monk by faith.
Adorned with poverty and made beautiful by abstinence,
you showed yourself to be a stranger and sojourner on earth.
Therefore, truly wondrous one, you delight in that which is good!

commemoration.title: Venerable John, disciple of Venerable Gregory of Decapolis

value.text:
You found Gregory, venerable John,
like a sun of great radiance,
shining with the light of the virtues
and the radiance of miracles.
You enlightened the eyes of your soul, dispelling the dark passions.
You became a light, all-blessed Father,
rejoicing to pass over to the never-fading light!

commemoration.title: Antipascha: Saint Thomas Sunday

value.text:
Venerable and all-glorious father John,
you were trained in the fold of the godly Chariton.
You drew up grace like a sponge, then pouring it out,
in imitation of his godly ways!
You spent your whole life in stillness
and were given ordination, becoming a worthy priest.
You ever offered the sacrifice
and like an unblemished lamb, purified by divine radiance
and enlightened in your mind,
you were carried up to mystical visions,
to the blessings of excellence!

commemoration.title: Antipascha: Saint Thomas Sunday

value.text:
Venerable and truly wondrous father John,
you were wounded by the divine desire of Christ our God,
Who for your sake willingly became a wanderer
and clothed Himself in flesh from the Virgin!
You reached a foreign land
and completely separated yourself from all the pleasures of the world.
Wise and all-blessed Father,
you lived as a stranger, acquiring the virtues.
You stood whole nights in prayer
and the contemplation of death.
You restrained the passions by your abstinence,
showing yourself to be a follower of those who fasted before you,
with whom you have been glorified!

commemoration.title: Antipascha: Saint Thomas Sunday

value.text:
All-blessed Father John,
you were strengthened by the might of the Trinity!
You avoided all the harm of heresy:
Through vision and godly action
you reached and clung to the glory of God
which is the end of all desires!
You truly and worthily received this after your repose!
Now, wise and blessed one, as you rejoice,
radiantly standing before God with the angelic choirs,
remember those who fittingly celebrate your memory!

commemoration.title: Saint Theodore the Sykeote, Bishop of Anastasiopolis

value.text:
Venerable Father, holy Theodore,
you were sanctified from your mother's womb
and were known to God, like Jeremiah of old!
A star heralded your nativity
and indeed the whole world has been truly enlightened
by the splendor of your life.
The darkness of the demons has vanished!
Infirmities have been driven away from people of every age
and grace has poured out all kinds of healings.
Therefore, we cry out to you:
Ever pray to Christ that He may grant the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint Theodore the Sykeote, Bishop of Anastasiopolis

value.text:
Venerable Father, most honored Theodore,
you are the sun who has enlightened the earth
with your works and countless signs!
You are a precious gift given to Christ our God,
the excellent foundation of the priesthood,
a model for monastics,
the strength of those who turn to you with faith,
a precious stone, a dwelling of the Trinity,
a bowl pouring forth a sea of healings!
Ever pray to Christ that He may grant the whole world peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint Theodore the Sykeote, Bishop of Anastasiopolis

value.text:
Venerable Father, truly wondrous Theodore,
you consumed all the tinder of sin
through mighty abstinence and the fire of prayer!
You received the illumination of God,
making the grace of the Trinity abide in you.
You became wholly radiant with rays of healing,
beholding future things, like Elijah of old,
breaking the bonds of barrenness,
driving away hordes of demons with the might of the Spirit of God!
Beseech Him that He may grant the whole world peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
You suffered with the Savior, glorious one,
united with His death by death.
You reign with him in splendor,
arrayed in a robe dyed in the bright purple of your blood,
adorned with the scepter of your sufferings,
magnificent for eternity in the crown of victory,
holy great Martyr George!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
You were armed with the shield of faith,
the helmet of grace and the spear of the Cross!
You were invincible to your adversaries, glorious George!
As a champion of God, you conquered the hordes of demons.
Now you join the angelic choir
and as the faithful call on you,
you help, sanctify and save them.

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
As a tiller of the earth you deserved your name,
warrior George.
By carrying on your shoulders the Cross of Christ,
you have plowed the earth, barren through Satan's snares.
The thorns of idolatry held it fast,
but you planted it with the vine of Christ's true faith!
You have brought healing for the faithful in every land.
You have tended well the garden of the Trinity.
Pray for the well-being of the world
and the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
We know you to be a star of great radiance, victorious George,
shining like the sun in the firmament of heaven!
You are a pearl of great price and a precious stone.
Even in the midst of our tribulations we glorify you!
You are a child of the day, courageous among martyrs,
a champion of the faithful who celebrate your memory.

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
George, brave warrior among the martyrs,
today we gather to sing your praise.
You have harvested the wheat of virtue;
you have sown in tears and reaped in joy!
You have finished the race and kept the faith,
you have received from God the crown of victory.
Pray for us to Christ our God
that He may deliver us from corruption and misfortune
as we celebrate your noble memory in faith!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
You trusted with a steady mind
and like a lion, went eagerly to the battle, glorious one!
You despised the body as a corruptible thing
and cared for your incorruptible soul!
Like gold purified seven times in the fire,
you were burned by many torments, wise martyr George!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
Come, brethren, let us praise in spiritual songs
the ever-memorable martyr George!
His endurance was harder than diamond;
he fervently declared himself for Christ!
He faced dangers and bore with hardships;
he hardened his perishable body to suffer torment!
His love overcame earthly nature,
enabling the lover to reach his Beloved through death:
Christ our God the Savior of our souls!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr, Victory-bearer, and Wonderworker George

value.text:
All peoples praise your memory in hymns and songs, O George!
It is adorned with grace and glory, resplendent in light!
The hosts of angels, apostles and martyrs
applaud your struggles, martyr,
praising Christ our God, the Savior Who glorified you!
Pray that He will enlighten and save our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Savva Stratelates “the General” of Rome,  and 70 soldiers with him

value.text:
You were an invincible commander,
a courageous athlete,
a universal beacon, enlightening the ends of the earth
with the brightness of your miracles.
You cast out the heavy darkness of the demons!
You are the adornment of martyrs, great Sabbas,
fellow-citizen with the holy, bodiless ones,
and you ever pray for our souls.

commemoration.title: Martyr Savva Stratelates “the General” of Rome,  and 70 soldiers with him

value.text:
You were shut up in prisons,
burned with fire and tortured with many torments.
You were torn asunder upon a tree,
afflicted with the cold of winter
and inflicted with frequent wounds.
You remained unshaken, athlete,
receiving fervently a blessed end in the waters.

commemoration.title: Martyr Savva Stratelates “the General” of Rome,  and 70 soldiers with him

value.text:
You were a handsome youth, most wealthy one;
all marveled at you.
You fearlessly set yourself apart for the labor of suffering
and with your holy and great struggles,
you raised up standards of victory against all enemies.
Therefore, truly wondrous one, we honor you with praise!

commemoration.title: Saint Basil of Poiana Marului

value.text:
Come, faithful, let us sing praises to Mark.
He is the wise writer of the Gospel!
The greatest of Egypt's cities heard his inspired words.
Apostle, by your prayers and teachings,
guide our lives in the way of peace!

commemoration.title: Saint Basil of Poiana Marului

value.text:
You gave life to barren souls,
watering them with the radiant stream of your Gospel.
Because of you, holy Mark,
Alexandria rejoices with us today,
celebrating your blessed memory!

commemoration.title: Saint Basil of Poiana Marului

value.text:
You became a fellow-traveler of Paul, the chosen vessel.
you accompanied him through all Macedonia;
then you followed Peter to Rome.
You were welcomed as his secretary and interpreter.
But it was in Egypt, all-wise Mark,
that you finished your course in a manner well-pleasing to God!

commemoration.title: Saint Basil of Poiana Marului

value.text:
Grace is poured out upon your lips,
Apostle Mark.
you became a shepherd of Christ's Church.
