You taught the sheep whom God endowed with reason
to believe in the consubstantial Trinity, one Godhead!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Holy Myrrhbearing Women with the Noble Joseph

value.text:
The evil emperor separated you from your flock like a sheep,
for you preached Christ God, our King, Who was slaughtered like a
lamb.
He unjustly killed you, blessed Basil,
and commanded that you be thrown into the sea.
Thus you gained the Kingdom of heaven and eternal glory!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Holy Myrrhbearing Women with the Noble Joseph

value.text:
You gloriously set the steps of your feet in the waters, glorious Basil,
for your body was cast out after your death as you foretold.
You crossed the sea with power
and honorably entrusted the burden of your relics
to your city of Amasea.
You are its unashamed intercessor,
a river of healings for the cleansing of many illnesses!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Holy Myrrhbearing Women with the Noble Joseph

value.text:
You were made steadfast by the law of God,
maintaining control over all the passions, blessed and glorious one.
You made your mind clearly their ruler
and you became a godly intercessor.
You fittingly received holy anointing
and were a guide for the reason-endowed flock,
adornment of hierarchs and martyrs.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Simeon, kinsman of the Lord, second Bishop of Jerusalem

value.text:
Simeon, you showed yourself to be a most holy priest,
a lawful athlete and true kinsman of the Creator!
You were truly a wonderworker and all-radiant beacon,
a guide for the lost, an unshakable pillar of the Church,
an heir of the Kingdom of heaven and equal of the angels!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Simeon, kinsman of the Lord, second Bishop of Jerusalem

value.text:
You have entered the heavenly Church in a holy way,
stained with blood, blessed one.
Now you stand before the Trinity,
richly shining with its radiance, most wealthy one.
Therefore, Simeon, we celebrate your radiant memorial today
and enlighten our spiritual senses!

commemoration.title: Nine Martyrs at Cyzicus: Theognes, Rufus, Antipater, Theostichus, Artemas, Magnus, Theodotus, Thaumasius, and Philemon

value.text:
Let us celebrate their holy memory with gladness!
Let us honor in faith and bless with hymns
Theognes, Rufus and Antipater,
Theostichus and Artemas,
Magnus and Theodotus,
the glorious Thaumasius and godly Philemon!
They shone splendidly in their sufferings,
enlightening those in darkness!

commemoration.title: Nine Martyrs at Cyzicus: Theognes, Rufus, Antipater, Theostichus, Artemas, Magnus, Theodotus, Thaumasius, and Philemon

value.text:
Beautiful flowers of the martyrs,
holy legion, company assembled by God,
leading congregation and chosen assembly,
holy choir, blessed council:
You struggled for the Trinity!
Entreat Him; beseech Him for us,
that we may receive remission of our sins!

commemoration.title: Nine Martyrs at Cyzicus: Theognes, Rufus, Antipater, Theostichus, Artemas, Magnus, Theodotus, Thaumasius, and Philemon

value.text:
When once the mindlessness of the Greeks was in control,
which had drawn all into the depths of sin,
all-praised martyrs of Christ,
you did not leave the straight and narrow path.
You did not join yourselves to ungodliness,
but suffered with courage and character.
Killed by the sword, you have inherited life!

commemoration.title: Apostle James the Brother of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
The illumination of the Spirit descended on you in the form of fire
and made you a divine vessel, blessed one,
dispelling with power the darkness of godlessness;
enlightening the world with the brightness of your all wise words.
Preacher of mysteries,
leader of the apostles,
James, the eye-witness of Christ.

commemoration.title: Apostle James the Brother of Saint John the Theologian
Apostle James the Brother of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
You drew men up from the depths of vanity
with a fisher's rod of grace.
You obeyed the commands of the Teacher, worthy James,
Who enlightened all your thoughts
and revealed you as an apostle and holy preacher,
expounding His incomprehensible divinity, most blessed one.

commemoration.title: Apostle James the Brother of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
You illumined those lying in the darkness of ignorance
with the lightning flash of your preaching, glorious James!
You revealed them to be sons through faith of the Master and God
Whose passion and death you imitated with zeal.
You became an heir of the glory, wise one,
as one speaking from God and a most faithful disciple.

commemoration.title: Apostle James the Brother of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
You followed after Christ and despised the world,
hiding His teachings in your treasury, godly James.
You were revealed to be His apostle.
Therefore, going to the nations with the commandments of the Savior,
you enlightened the souls in the darkness of delusion and passion,
that they might believe in the consubstantial Trinity!

commemoration.title: Apostle James the Brother of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
Blessed, God-seer James,
after you listened to the voice of the Word,
you paid no heed to the service and customs of your father,
for you left behind the life of earthly cares
and passed over the spiritual sea!
You stirred its depths with the precepts of godliness
and with your heavenly thunder,
Apostle most blessed of God!

commemoration.title: Prophet Jeremiah

value.text:
Lord, even though the holy Jeremiah was thrown into a cesspool,
he gained spiritually a beautiful, sweet fragrance.
He dwells in the mansions of paradise!
By his prayers save our souls, for You are our Benefactor!

commemoration.title: Prophet Jeremiah

value.text:
Lord, the prophet, shining with Your all-radiant light,
was seen even by his enemies to be blessed and honorable.
The adversary was put to shame by his virtues.
He saw future things as though they were present deeds!

commemoration.title: Prophet Jeremiah

value.text:
The Trial
Lord, You knew the glorious Jeremiah
even before he was created.
You sanctified the prophet before his birth and infancy
to know freedom and understanding from the beginning.
Through his prayers save our souls, for You are merciful!

commemoration.title: Saint Matrona of Moscow

value.text:
You were shown to be like a river of God,
flooded with the waters of the Spirit,
overflowing with divine teachings,
setting on fire the fullness of the Church.
You overwhelmed the assembly of the heretics with the depths of your divine words
and the abyss of your understanding.
For you, all wise and wondrous Father,
most wealthy Athanasius,
preached Christ the Master,
consubstantial with the Father Who begot Him!

commemoration.title: Saint Matrona of Moscow

value.text:
As a reteller of the mysteries of God
and a divine bishop,
you patiently endured tribulations and persecutions,
attacks and lengthy exiles, blessed one,
for the sake of the faith of Christ.
You clearly proclaimed Christ to be consubstantial, equally everlasting,
and equal in his activity
with the primal and equally unoriginate Father.
Therefore, He Himself has openly adorned you
with all-radiant teachings,
showing you to the world as brilliant light!

commemoration.title: Saint Matrona of Moscow

value.text:
Let us all sing hymns to Athanasius,
the holy bishop of Christ.
He overthrew the teaching of Arius,
declaring the Son to be one in essence with the Father.
He proclaimed the might of the Trinity to the ends of the earth:
One God in three Persons, indivisible.

commemoration.title: Saint Matrona of Moscow

value.text:
You were given immortal life
when you preached the life-giver Christ,
the Son and Word, consubstantial and equally everlasting
with the unoriginate Father Who begot Him.
You burned the tinder of heresies with your fiery tongue!
you expelled Arius from the Church of Christ, glorious one,
and with your divine preaching, wise one,
you enlightened the hearts of the faithful,
that they might worship the Trinity in one essence.

commemoration.title: Saint Matrona of Moscow

value.text:
Again, the namesake of immortality,
the river of the Nile flowing with gold,
arrives for his annual commemoration!
He pours out golden torrents of immortality in divine floods,
producing a harvest for eternity!
He teaches all to worship the indivisible might of the Trinity,
pouring out God's teachings with exalted and divine words.
He gives drink to the thoughts of the faithful
and he prays without ceasing for our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Timothy the Reader and his wife, Maura, in Egypt

value.text:
Let us assemble, all who love the martyrs!
Together let us praise with faith today
Maura and Timothy, courageous among martyrs.
They suffered greatly and slew the enemy.
They loved Christ and hated the world.
they are worthy citizens of the spiritual Zion!

commemoration.title: Martyr Timothy the Reader and his wife, Maura, in Egypt

value.text:
You suffered in purity, glorious Maura,
with brilliant radiance you cast the enemy into darkness!
You were trampled by horses and your fingers cut off.
You were crucified and burned with torches.
You passed over to divine rest
where the choir of martyrs ever rejoices.

commemoration.title: Martyr Timothy the Reader and his wife, Maura, in Egypt

value.text:
Timothy, your body was tied,
your eyes gouged out and spikes driven into your ears.
You were weighed down with a heavy stone.
Thus you threw down the enemy
and were carried up to divine glory, glorious one!
Therefore we come together with faith
and praise you with entreaties,
glory and boast of the martyrs!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Irene

value.text:
You reveled in the love of Christ, glorious Irene,
despising the gods of the pagans and their lifeless graven images.
You showed yourself to those who watched you
to be a pillar of the knowledge of God
as you suffered and finished your race,
preserving the faith in purity!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Irene

value.text:
You endured the raging of the burning fire, all praised one,
and injury to your whole body.
You looked forward, most honored one, to heavenly rewards
which Jesus alone has prepared
for those who love and fervently desire Him
as the most beautiful Bridegroom of our souls.

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Irene

value.text:
You were clothed in splendor, most honored one,
with a robe purple from your own blood!
You hastened to the One you desired:
the King, Creator and Lord of all
from Whom you received in truth a crown of victory.
Now you reign with Him as a virgin and martyr,
greatly suffering one.

commemoration.title: Righteous Job the Long-Suffering

value.text:
Let us praise Job, the blameless favorite of the Lord!
In the midst of his trials,
he was unconquered by the sores of his flesh.
He was the unshaken pillar,
recognized by all as a bulwark of courage.
With his wisdom-loving mind,
he broke the sting of the devil.
He is the godly and divinely wise one, the strength of the faithful!

commemoration.title: Righteous Job the Long-Suffering

value.text:
Righteous Job, you were known as righteous and guileless,
truthful, blameless and faithful.
You abstained from all evil
and were truly adorned with the virtues and resplendent in righteousness.
Therefore we rejoice today as we celebrate your holy and honored feast!

commemoration.title: Righteous Job the Long-Suffering

value.text:
You were clothed in the wealth of faith as in a costly purple robe.
You were adorned with mercy and righteousness as with a godly crown.
You ruled over the tyranny of the passions, blameless Job.
Therefore you have passed over to the spiritual kingdom
where you stand before the eternal King, all-glorious one.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian

value.text:
The beholder of ineffable revelations,
the interpreter of the mysteries of God on high:
The son of Zebedee has recorded the Gospel of Christ for us,
teaching us to confess God, Father, Son and Holy Spirit!

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian

value.text:
Divinely inspired instrument for the songs of heaven,
whose secrets he wrote down for us,
singing wonderfully the song of songs.
with words from his mouth as music from a lyre,
he prays for us to be saved.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian

value.text:
Let us give rightful praise to the son of thunder,
the source of divine words, the chief theologian,
the first to proclaim the truths of the teachings of the wisdom of God:
John the beloved and virgin.
For divinely inspired from within he said:
In the beginning was the Word!
Teaching that He is inseparable from the Father;
equal to Him in nature,
and showing us the right worship of the Trinity!
You have also shown us the Creator,
Who being with the Father and bearing life, showed us the true light.
Awesome and fearful wonder!
As you were filled with love, you were filled with divine speech,
and with the glory, belief and honor
which confirm our undivided faith,
through which we attain the eternal good on the day of judgment!

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian

value.text:
With your tongue resounding as thunder,
you declare the hidden Word of the Wisdom of God!
Beloved of God, you open your mouth to cry:
In the beginning was the Word!
Illumining all mankind with the knowledge of God.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian

value.text:
Godly-minded Father Arsenius,
whose understanding shone with the water of tears,
through this purification you communed with God.
You shone, blessed one, as a radiant and perfect pillar of goodness,
inflamed with the fear of God, boast of monks:
By your prayers ever keep watch for us all!

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist John the Theologian

value.text:
You appeared as the fullness of speech and knowledge,
adorned with virtues; overflowing with glory!
Aflame with zeal for God,
and striving for that which surpasses speech,
you fled to Egypt where you lived the ascetic life
exchanging your ineffable burden for glory!

commemoration.title: Prophet Isaiah

value.text:
Sent forth as a fiery coal of the pre-incarnate God,
the great and glorious Isaiah is commissioned as a prophet.
He beholds the ineffable glory of God
through his abundant goodness and purity;
as a herald he prepares the way of the Lord:
proclaiming the revelation of divine deliverance
coming forth to all nations.

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman

value.text:
The wondrous Simon, boast of the apostles,
passed across the earth like a brilliant lightning bolt!
He dispelled the darkness of idolatry
with his saving, brilliant and divine teachings!
He enlightened all people to glorify one God in three Persons,
indivisible and undivided!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman

value.text:
Like a rolling wheel, the blessed Simon
ran swiftly through the ends of the earth!
He burned away the madness of idolatry from all the land,
lighting brilliant beacons with piety,
he kindled luminous fires of grace for the faithful
that they may worship one God in three Persons,
indivisible and undivided!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman

value.text:
The most radiant and all-wondrous apostle Simon,
the teacher of the nations, the net of God,
draws us up from the depth of perdition
with the height of theology!
The true preacher now wisely leads all to the knowledge of Christ.
He sets before us his accomplishments
as a pleasing feast of all good things!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman

value.text:
You were called the namesake of zeal,
admirable Simon,
for you zealously imitated the all-powerful God!
He revealed you to be filled with divine miracles,
for having unusual zeal, blessed one,
you were aptly called "the zealot,"
and obtained a calling consistent with your character!
Therefore, as you dwell on high with the choirs of heaven,
entreat the Word, O seer of God,
that He may grant us great mercy!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman

value.text:
Most blessed Simon,
you have shown yourself to be a faithful mediator between God and men!
Now by your truly bold supplications,
turn Christ to us in steadfast love
and never cease to pray to the Lord
that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman

value.text:
Ever-memorable Simon,
you drank of the torrent of sweetness,
drinking with divine wisdom the understanding of God
which you fervently desired!
Now you have passed over with joy to Him,
deified by the all-splendid glory of the Trinity
and immeasurable peace!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Samaritan Woman

value.text:
All-wondrous Simon,
you contemplate the beauty of God,
looking upon it as far as you are able,
delighting in it through a higher union
and deified by His gifts!
You reached with joy the only divine One Whom you desired,
ever memorable preacher of Christ
and now you dwell with the angels!

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Founding of Constantinople

value.text:
With what crowns of praise
shall we adorn the divinely-wise teachers,
the voices of wisdom sounding amid clouds of darkness,
enlightening those in the shadow of death
with the light of the Gospel!
The great preachers of the undivided Trinity
who grafted barren unbelievers as branches
into the fruitful tree of the Orthodox Church
that they might obtain from Christ our God peace and great mercy.

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Founding of Constantinople

value.text:
With what hymns of praise
shall we magnify the divinely-wise teachers:
Cyril, who chose to live with wisdom in his youth.
He multiplied his talents to the glory of God;
and Methodius who renounced the things of this world for love of Christ.
He strove like an angel for the Kingdom of heaven.
Through them, we have come to know God, the eternal Trinity,
Father, Son and Holy Spirit,
receiving from Christ our God great mercy!

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Founding of Constantinople

value.text:
Come, lovers of feasts!
Let us glorify the apostolic laborers with songs of praise:
The pride of hierarchs,
the enlighteners and fervent intercessors for the Slavic people!
Rejoice, Cyril, golden herald of the Word of God,
lighting up the mysteries of the holy Trinity as the sun,
closing the blaspheming mouths of Islam!
Again, rejoice, Methodius!
You assisted him with prayers and miracles.
Most blessed fathers, never cease to intercede before Christ our God
for those who praise you with faith and love!

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Founding of Constantinople

value.text:
With what songs of praise
shall we glorify the divinely-wise teachers:
The golden-mouthed Cyril
who reached the heights of wisdom through his sweet preaching,
humbling the fierce pride of Islam!
And Methodius, the lover of solitude,
who in silence received the fruits of the Spirit.
Through their prayers, Christ our God, grant us great mercy.

commemoration.title: Saint Germanus, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
Like a wild beast, the ungodly Leo hated God.
He became the forerunner of the antichrist,
rejecting the veneration of the image of Christ.
He was cast out from the heritage of the faithful.
Therefore we entreat you, venerable Germanus,
as you banished his turmoil,
so by your prayers, cast out our confusion!

commemoration.title: Saint Epiphanius, Bishop of Cyprus

value.text:
Rejoice, Epiphanius!
You are a river filled with the waters of the Spirit,
the adornment of the Church,
the measure of bishops and support of monastics,
the foundation of the Orthodox,
the ground of the Church and a tower of strength.
You are the opponent of impiety,
a trumpet of the sound of God, a singing nightingale;
a heavenly mind and vigilant tongue,
meditating on the law of God through the grace of Christ.
Beseech Him to grant great mercy to our souls.

commemoration.title: Saint Epiphanius, Bishop of Cyprus

value.text:
Rejoice, instructor of those who fast!
you truly tended the flock of Christ, the chief Shepherd,
in the fields of the true Orthodox faith,
with the staff of your wise teachings, Epiphanius.
You yourself were like a meek lamb,
feeding on the grass of abstinence.
Now you have come to dwell in the fold of life on high
where you sing with the holy bishops and martyrs.
Ever pray that peace and great mercy be given to us
who celebrate your memory with love!

commemoration.title: Saint Germanus, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
Blessed Germanus,
you decisively threw down the reasoning of Leo.
He was filled with impiety:
Wretch that he was, he rejected the veneration
of the precious icons of Christ and of all the saints.
He remained hardened, even though he was denounced by your preaching!

commemoration.title: Saint Epiphanius, Bishop of Cyprus

value.text:
Rejoice, beacon of righteousness!
You have illumined the whole world with the rays of your fiery words!
In the storm of ignorance, Epiphanius,
you completely burned the teachings of the enemy,
guiding them to the true and peaceful harbor of the knowledge of God!
Rejoice, instrument of the Spirit's inspiration,
ever pouring out a sea of miracles!
You delivered men from death:
Entreat Christ that He may grant great mercy to our souls.

commemoration.title: Saint Germanus, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
You received what you had openly desired from of old, blessed Germanus,
for as a bishop, you have gone to your Master with boldness.
As you stand before Him, divinely revealed one,
you have received deification.
Pray now that peace may be granted to the world!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Isidore and Myrope of Chios

value.text:
The sufferings of the martyrs have indeed transcended
all praise, all words and thought!
They were steadfast pillars of piety.
Though clad like us in mortal and passion-plagued bodies,
the glorious ones braved the fire and triumphed over wounds,
suffering as if in the bodies of others!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Isidore and Myrope of Chios

value.text:
You were torn with wounds
stripping away the skin garments of mortality.
Arrayed in the vesture and splendid purple robe of incorruption,
you hastened to approach the tree of life.
Glorious one, you indeed received indestructible and endless life!
Now as you delight in it, preserve those who sing your praise.

commemoration.title: Martyrs Isidore and Myrope of Chios

value.text:
Burning with the zeal of piety, martyr Isidore,
you entered into the tribunal.
You accepted suffering with ardor
and received the crown of victory!
Adorned with divine teachings against falsehood
and strengthened by the armor of the Cross
you cast down the lying tyrant,
revealing yourself to be a crown-bearer!

commemoration.title: Venerable Theodore the Sanctified, disciple of Venerable Pachomius the Great

value.text:
Of old, the Master appointed the clouds on high.
later, He came down into Egypt on the light cloud.
He foretold that His chosen ones would shine forth,
caught up in the clouds, as wise in God.
With them our father Theodore the sanctified,
shines with the radiant brilliance of Christ!
He is the unshakable pillar, steadfast in virtue,
who prays with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Theodore the Sanctified, disciple of Venerable Pachomius the Great

value.text:
Before, Egypt was driven to insanity
by demonic sacrifices and passions.
Now it is adorned with much beauty and divine virtues!
Among these, the namesake of divine gifts shone forth:
The venerable Theodore, who saw and pleased God!
He imitated Christ in wonderful humility
and he prays with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Theodore the Sanctified, disciple of Venerable Pachomius the Great

value.text:
From his youth, the wise Theodore, the great faster,
was gifted with asceticism, abstinence, humility and patience.
He avoided evil and acquired the virtues.
He was a lover of the love of God!
With joy, the glorious one has transcended all visible things!
He is exalted by his way of life.
now he converses with God,
praying with boldness on behalf of our souls.

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Blind Man

value.text:
The divine apostle Paul, splendidly praising you with divine honor,
sets your courage before the faithful.
He speaks first of all to reveal you
as wise disciples of the Word of God
and as his true kinsmen:
Glorious Junia and blessed Andronicus, the favorites of God!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Blind Man

value.text:
Enlightening the whole earth with holy preaching,
you cast out the gloom of vainglory.
You have directed those who were sunk in the darkness of ungodliness
to the light of the knowledge of God.
Divine apostles, you are guides to salvation
and intercessors for all who ever honor you with faith!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Blind Man

value.text:
As a servant of the Word, a glorious minister,
a shining lamp for the whole world,
by your word, you ended the irrational corruption of ungodliness!
Therefore, using the words of God, for you are blessed by Him,
we joyfully glorify and celebrate your holy memory,
offering praise to the Almighty!

commemoration.title: Martyr Theodotus of Ancyra, and with him the seven Virgin Martyrs: Alexandra, Tecusa, Claudia, Phaine, Euphraisa, Matrona, and Julia, who suffered under Decius

value.text:
Adorned with a peaceful disposition,
you were chosen in holiness to minister to all!
All blessed Theodotus,
you were illumined with the crown of suffering.
You join a chorus in the heavens with those who suffered with you.
Together with them, pray that we may be saved!

commemoration.title: Martyr Theodotus of Ancyra, and with him the seven Virgin Martyrs: Alexandra, Tecusa, Claudia, Phaine, Euphraisa, Matrona, and Julia, who suffered under Decius

value.text:
Having offered yourself to the Lord as a sacred vessel
and submitted to His words, divinely blessed one,
you gave generously to the poor, wise martyr,
spiritually laying up for yourself the riches of martyrdom
which cannot be taken away!

commemoration.title: Martyr Theodotus of Ancyra, and with him the seven Virgin Martyrs: Alexandra, Tecusa, Claudia, Phaine, Euphraisa, Matrona, and Julia, who suffered under Decius

value.text:
Now let us the faithful all bless with joy Peter and Dionysius,
Paul, Andrew and Benedimus who were courageous and firm;
Christina, Heraclius and Paulinus,
a trio together who suffered steadfastly.
They trampled all the delusion of the serpent underfoot,
by grace dispelling the darkness of idolatry!

commemoration.title: Martyr Theodotus of Ancyra, and with him the seven Virgin Martyrs: Alexandra, Tecusa, Claudia, Phaine, Euphraisa, Matrona, and Julia, who suffered under Decius

value.text:
You purchased the immovable kingdom of God with your blood!
You reached the calm harbors, blessed ones of God,
after enduring all the waves of evil with courageous mind.
Therefore you are called blessed and glorified by all,
ever praying that we may find mercy on the day of judgment!

commemoration.title: Martyr Theodotus of Ancyra, and with him the seven Virgin Martyrs: Alexandra, Tecusa, Claudia, Phaine, Euphraisa, Matrona, and Julia, who suffered under Decius

value.text:
Behold the river of salvation;
the living spring the company of holy virgins has been shown to be!
Therefore, come with fervor!
Let us who are now sick draw forth healing!
Let those who are in sorrow draw forth joy
through the prayers of the holy brides of God!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Patrick, Bishop of Prusa, and his companions

value.text:
Wearing purple robes dyed in the blood of martyrdom
and bearing the precious Cross as a scepter,
the godly martyrs rejoice as they reign with Christ,
having desired to suffer willingly for Him:
Polyenus manifest in holiness,
Acacius and Menander and the divinely wise Patrick!
Now they stand rejoicing before the throne of Christ
praying with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Patrick, Bishop of Prusa, and his companions

value.text:
Desiring the kingdom of Christ,
the blessed and courageous ones preferred a temporary death
as though it were nourishment!
They manfully endured starvation and the pain of wounds.
Therefore, they have become helpers of all the faithful,
imparting abundant health to their souls and bodies!
Faithful, let us now joyfully hymn them as is fitting,
for they pray with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Patrick, Bishop of Prusa, and his companions

value.text:
Steered by the Word, the blessed hieromartyrs
sailed easily across the three-fold wave of the passions.
They were entrusted with the task of healing men's sufferings
with the waters of warm devotion.
Their relics were given holy burial,
richly pouring forth healings upon those in need.
Faithful, let us honor them fittingly and without ceasing,
for they pray with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Unmercenary Physician Thallelaios at Aegae in Cilicia and his companions, Martyrs Alexander and Asterios

value.text:
When a great disturbance of the earth laid hold of you
and a storm struck your soul, most glorious one,
you steered by your high calling as with a rudder,
crossing the depth of very painful tortures unharmed!
You reached the harbors of the most high, martyr Thalalaeus,
filled with eternal calm!

commemoration.title: Unmercenary Physician Thallelaios at Aegae in Cilicia and his companions, Martyrs Alexander and Asterios

value.text:
At the command of the tyrant
you were thrown into the depths of the sea,
yet through divine grace you did not drown, all-wise one.
With the rivers of your blood, divinely-wise one,
you drowned the spiritual Pharaoh and his army.
You committed him to complete destruction
for you were greatly strengthened by Christ!

commemoration.title: Unmercenary Physician Thallelaios at Aegae in Cilicia and his companions, Martyrs Alexander and Asterios

value.text:
You were lifted up upon a tree
and your side was torn by the savagery of the torturers.
You imitated the suffering of the Master of creation, glorious one.
You denounced the error of their thought
and reviled the delusion of idolatry.
You openly strengthened true worship,
great martyr Thalalaeus!

commemoration.title: The Ascension of our Lord

value.text:
As the King of kings,
the Lord Who reigns over all,
You, Lover of mankind, granted Your servant the wisdom of Solomon,
the meekness of David,
and the Orthodox faith of the apostles!
Therefore we glorify Your dispensation,
almighty Jesus,
Savior of our souls, and Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: The Ascension of our Lord

value.text:
You gave Your precious Cross
as a most powerful weapon to the emperor.
Through it he reigned righteously on earth,
shining with godliness.
And by Your compassion he was counted worthy of Your heavenly kingdom.
therefore with him we glorify Your dispensation,
almighty Jesus,
Savior of our souls, and Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: The Ascension of our Lord

value.text:
Emperor of eternal memory,
first you willingly submitted the purple to Christ,
recognizing Him as true God and King of all,
the great Benefactor and source of victory.
You saw Him set above every principality and power.
Therefore Jesus made the kingdom prosper for you, lover of virtue,
for he is the Savior of our souls, and Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: The Ascension of our Lord

value.text:
Constantine the great, most powerful emperor,
you received the finest of rich gifts from God
making you pre-eminent.
Enlightened by the rays of the most Holy Spirit through baptism,
you appeared invincible while you reigned,
receiving the world as a free gift of the Creator.
You ruled the city with faithfulness.
Since therefore you have boldness before Him,
never cease to pray to Christ that all who celebrate your memory in faith
may be granted forgiveness of sins and great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Ascension of our Lord

value.text:
You received the scepter from God,
Constantine, first emperor of Christians.
The hidden symbol of salvation appeared to you on earth.
Having the life-giving Cross as an invincible weapon, blessed saint,
you brought all the nations to the feet of Rome,
and yourself were led to God.

commemoration.title: Martyr Basiliscus, Bishop of Comana

value.text:
Your prayer first caused a barren tree to put forth fruit
and a spring to gush with living water.
By the fountain of your blood the earth was sanctified
and the air was hallowed by the passage of your soul
truly wealthy one!
Therefore with faith, Basiliscus,
we celebrate your holy and most festive day
on which you lawfully struggled.

commemoration.title: Martyr Basiliscus, Bishop of Comana

value.text:
Reigning like a king, you received the kingdom which abides forever,
glorious Basiliscus!
You stand before the King of hosts,
rejoicing with all the armies of the angels.
Together with them, blessed one, you chant divine hymns without ceasing,
radiantly illumined by splendor and divine communion!

commemoration.title: Martyr Basiliscus, Bishop of Comana

value.text:
When you walked the path of martyrdom rejoicing,
all praised one,
they pierced your feet with nails and fastened them.
Yet with them you trampled on the head of the enemy,
utterly crushing it, glorious one
and you trod the paths of heaven with might,
showing yourself to the Master as a conqueror!

commemoration.title: Saint Michael the Confessor, Bishop of Synnada

value.text:
Blessed and divinely inspired Father Michael,
you have fittingly been granted to behold the source of blessings:
The fulfillment of the desire for the utmost desires;
the true blessedness for which all nature truly yearns!
How great is your beauty, glorious one,
in which you stand before Christ, rejoicing,
as a radiant bishop.

commemoration.title: Saint Michael the Confessor, Bishop of Synnada

value.text:
Arrayed in priestly vestments, god-pleasing Father Michael,
you hastened to the tribunal of the tyrant.
There you offered yourself to Christ.
Adorned with double crowns, blessed one,
you behold the ranks of bishops.
How great is the ineffable gladness, all-wise one,
in which you were truly counted worthy to share,
divinely blessed one!

commemoration.title: Saint Michael the Confessor, Bishop of Synnada

value.text:
Sprinkled with dew from on high,
Godly wise Father Michael,
you divinely quenched the fire of temptations,
passing through it unharmed.
Rejoicing, blessed hieromartyr,
you were added in splendor to the holy bishops who were before you.
How great is the ineffable and brilliant habitation
in which Christ has now caused you to dwell as an honored bishop!

commemoration.title: Venerable Simeon Stylites the Younger of Wonderful Mountain

value.text:
Taking wing with divine love while yet bearing the flesh
and clad in the dust of the earth,
you openly became a dweller with the angels.
Forsaking earthly things, you ascended to the heavenly,
ever mounting to God on your lofty pillar, Father,
and radiant in your ascent!

commemoration.title: Venerable Simeon Stylites the Younger of Wonderful Mountain

value.text:
You broke open your flesh by abstinence, Simeon,
revealing your soul to be a vessel of the Spirit.
You ascended on high and drew near to God.
By His power you were made worthy to work miracles beyond nature!
Therefore your divine activities surpass all thought and understanding!

commemoration.title: Venerable Simeon Stylites the Younger of Wonderful Mountain

value.text:
All blessed Simeon,
by contemplation and by actions
you made your soul into a pillar
inscribed with the universal virtues.
You overcame the uprisings of the flesh,
clothing yourself in life-bearing mortification, venerable one.
You became a lamp ever shining with light,
enlightening all the ends of the world with grace!

commemoration.title: Third Finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist John

value.text:
We celebrate the third revelation of your precious head.
When it was severed, glorious one,
the Trinity crowned it for your godly zeal.
The ranks of angels, the company of martyrs,
the apostles of God and all the prophets
rejoice in its discovery.
Together with them, ever remember us, Forerunner of the Lord!

commemoration.title: Third Finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist John

value.text:
Blessed Forerunner John,
your head shone from the ground with rays brighter than the sun.
It enlightens the faithful.
We have it has a divine treasure
and draw rich grace from it,
sanctifying our souls, our bodies and thoughts.
As we celebrate, we call you blessed.

commemoration.title: Third Finding of the Honorable Head of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist John

value.text:
Your holy head, blessed Forerunner,
poured out abundant grace.
It was shown without his foreknowledge
to the priest who was wise in God.
He quickly went with faith and grace
and openly brought about its sanctified coming
with the emperor and the divinely wise people
who fervently maintain the Orthodox Faith.

commemoration.title: Apostle Carpus of the Seventy

value.text:
You were revealed as a radiant star
with the splendor and teaching of God.
You ever enlighten the ends of the earth, blessed one.
By grace you cast out the gloom of affliction from everyone.
Pray now that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Apostle Carpus of the Seventy

value.text:
You made the perfect and unbloody sacrifice to God
and were killed for Him, martyr.
You offered yourself upon the spiritual altar
as a sweet-smelling sacrifice, wealthy apostle Carpus.
Pray now that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Apostle Carpus of the Seventy

value.text:
Your mind made divine with joyful radiance,
you were enlightened, most wealthy Carpus.
You went out to preach Christ and teach the people
to worship Him, the Lover of mankind.
Pray now that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Therapon, Bishop of Sardis

value.text:
The glorious Therapont, soaked in the dye of his blood,
fashioned a most splendid garment of holiness.
He clothed himself in it with magnificence
to enter the Holy of Holies.
By his prayers, Lord, grant us all great mercy.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Therapon, Bishop of Sardis

value.text:
The most glorious Therapont,
enlightened by the acts of God,
was allowed to see the beauty of Christ with the eyes of his heart
for he please Him by his suffering.
Therefore, he ever heals sufferings of soul and body by grace
for those who turn to him with faith.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Therapon, Bishop of Sardis

value.text:
The most wealthy Therapont pours out a stream of healings
like a well of living water.
He fully washes away the corruption of serious illnesses
from all who turn to him with faith.
By his prayers, Lord, grant us all great mercy.

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Theodosia the Nun of Constantinople

value.text:
You were adorned in splendor with beauty of body and soul,
most glorious martyr Theodosia.
You brought yourself to Christ,
desiring to be crowned by Him with a wreath of glory
and to openly receive upon your brow
the truly fitting and priceless diadem of the Kingdom!
You were revealed to be an incorrupt bride, most wise one!

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Theodosia the Nun of Constantinople

value.text:
Shining with the radiance of virginity,
honored Theodosia,
and adorned in splendor with a royal robe
dyed in the blood of martyrdom,
you made your dwelling, most wise one,
in the heavenly bridal chamber of Christ!
You dance with the angelic ranks in an eternal choir,
glorious and most pure virgin!

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Theodosia the Nun of Constantinople

value.text:
Virgin martyr, most praised Theodosia,
you desired Christ with all your soul!
You endured the wounds of martyrdom;
you courageously endured flaying for the One you loved,
as your sides were raked with iron claws.
How steadfast was the endurance of your struggles
by which you indeed threw the proud one to the ground!

commemoration.title: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
Father, you protected your body with abstinence.
With your prayers and vigils you killed the unruliness of the passions!
Therefore, your teachings have enlightened the faithful
to bless the Father, the Son and the consubstantial Spirit!

commemoration.title: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
Beholding the beauties of paradise;
greatly delighting in the flowers of incorruption,
you budded forth the knowledge of God for the world!
We partake of this, venerable Isaac, with spiritual love
and bring growth to our souls!

commemoration.title: Memorial Saturday

value.text:
You shone forth like the sun from the desert upon the city, Father.
You adorned the monastic life.
Therefore, your teachings have enlightened the faithful
to bless the Father, the Son and the consubstantial Spirit!

commemoration.title: Holy Pentecost

value.text:
You extinguished the fire of ungodliness
with the drops of your blood, great martyr.
You have given a rich drink to the Church of Christ
and enlightened the hearts of the faithful
who honor your holy and precious memory with faith.

commemoration.title: Holy Pentecost

value.text:
You pulled up with the Word of God
those who had fallen into the sea of unbelief.
You endured great triple waves of torments,
all-praised passion-bearer Hermias,
until you joyfully entered with them into the harbor of heaven!

commemoration.title: Holy Pentecost

value.text:
Like an unassailable fortress, you were not shaken
by the assaults of the enemy, Hermias.
You pierced their hearts as with arrows,
overthrowing their plots like an invincible rampart
through the pain of your courageous struggles!

commemoration.title: Martyr Justin the Philosopher and those with him at Rome

value.text:
When the icy cold of ignorance ruled over all creation,
and by the assaults of the enemy the many idols were served
then the glorious martyrs with eager hearts
in the fervor of divine faith poured out their blood with love for Him
Who gloriously poured out His Own blood on the Cross!

commemoration.title: Martyr Justin the Philosopher and those with him at Rome

value.text:
Justin, the noble champion
with his glorious companions,
following the example of his divine Master
put on his priestly garment stained with blood.
Now together with the angels they stand in heaven
interceding before Christ the King of all.

commemoration.title: Saint Nikephoros the Confessor, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
All-wise, blest and holy hierarch,
we praise you, the successor of the apostles,
who shared in the ways of the martyrs,
imitating the ascetics,
the seal of teachers, a model of divine life,
the initiate of the mysteries of Christ,
divinely flowing river of understanding,
drowning the thoughts of the evil and blaspheming one!

commemoration.title: Saint Nikephoros the Confessor, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
Your divine inspiration was revealed by your sanctity!
We know you as the ground of truth,
the confirmation of the faith, the teacher of dogmas,
the advocate of devotion,
the dwelling of purity, chosen vessel, sweet savor of the Spirit,
great treasury of teachings,
the foundation of the Church of Christ!

commemoration.title: Saint Nikephoros the Confessor, Patriarch of Constantinople

value.text:
You increased the talent of wisdom, most wealthy one,
and were given the joy of your Lord.
Adorned with the grace of the radiance of God
and shining spiritually with the light of the Spirit,
you now stand at the right hand of the Giver of life,
ever enlightened, glorious one, with His divine brightness!

commemoration.title: Martyr Lucillian and those who suffered with him at Byzantium

value.text:
The cruel children of those who through envy killed the Lord
delivered you up, glorious Lucillian.
You displayed invincible courage
and inherited the delights of Paradise.
Therefore, pray that our souls be granted peace and great mercy.

commemoration.title: Martyr Lucillian and those who suffered with him at Byzantium

value.text:
The most holy children,
submitting to you as to a father,
suffered steadfastly together with you
together with illustrious Paula, a saint and martyr worthy of wonder.
Now you dwell with them in the heavens:
Entreat Christ to grant our souls peace and great mercy.

commemoration.title: Martyr Lucillian and those who suffered with him at Byzantium

value.text:
Greatly suffering martyr,
healing waters ever spring from your grave.
Those who hasten there are cleansed of passions:
Hordes of demons are drowned through the workings of the Holy Spirit.
Pray, therefore, that our souls may be granted peace and great mercy.

commemoration.title: “Surety of Sinners” Icon of the Mother of God of Korets

value.text:
You were revealed as a God-bearer.
wholly consecrated, the holy anointed of God.
You were robed in the Holy Spirit,
ever entering the Holy of Holies with splendor,
robed with godly radiance,
partaking of the grace of the holy mysteries
as a true and all glorious bishop,
praying with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: “Surety of Sinners” Icon of the Mother of God of Korets

value.text:
All blessed and holy hierarch Metrophanes,
your life was illumined with the radiance of the virtues.
You enlightened the faithful,
driving away the darkness of falsehood,
for you were shown to be the bright sun of the truth.
Now you have made your dwelling where the never fading light shines;
you have become a child of the day through the grace of the Holy Spirit!
Therefore as we celebrate your divine and light-bearing memory,
we honor you with love, ever-memorable one!

commemoration.title: “Surety of Sinners” Icon of the Mother of God of Korets

value.text:
Your mind was made beautiful by faith
and through yearning for God, divinely wise one.
You were shown to be radiant!
You learned incorruption in your mortal and corruptible body,
acquiring the splendor of the bodiless ones, all-wise one.
You became a stranger to pleasures
and were adorned with dispassion.
All-wise Father and Bishop Metrophanes,
you are a shining lamp and intercessor
for those who honor your memory with love!

commemoration.title: Venerable Bessarion, Wonderworker of Egypt

value.text:
You were the light of monastics, wise Bessarion.
By the rays of your virtues and the radiance of grace,
you were like a shining lamp for the desert.
Deliver from the gloom of the passions and the darkness of evil,
from all sorrow and temptation,
those who fervently honor you
and hymn your divine dormition with faith!

commemoration.title: Venerable Bessarion, Wonderworker of Egypt

value.text:
Knowing you to be like the wise Elijah,
we all openly praise you, Bessarion,
for through God's mercy upon you,
you caused streams of water to fall as rain from the sky!
By your honored prayers you send fountains of rain and divine dew from on high,
with grace, power and invincible protection,
upon all the faithful!

commemoration.title: Venerable Bessarion, Wonderworker of Egypt

value.text:
You endured standing in the midst of thorns
in your divine love of ineffable struggles;
you revealed an effort equal to that of the martyrs!
You sweeten the bitter waters of the sea
and give drink to thirsting souls, all wise one.
You crossed the rushing torrents of the Nile,
crossing over its waters dryshod, all praised one!

commemoration.title: Saint Cyril, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
All the tinder of heresies
is burned with your fiery teachings, all-wise one!
The army of the impious who would not submit to the truth
is drowned in the depths of your understanding, holy Cyril!
The Church of the faithful is ever adorned with your doctrines,
honoring you with mighty voices!

commemoration.title: Saint Cyril, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
Good and faithful servant,
laborer in the vineyard of Christ,
you bore the burden of the day
and increased the talent given to you.
You did not envy those who came after you,
therefore the gates of heaven have been opened to you!
Enter into the joy of your Lord
and pray for us, Cyril our father!

commemoration.title: Saint Cyril, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
You enlightened your mind with the radiance of the Spirit,
becoming a shining sun!
You extended the rays of your teachings to the ends of the earth,
enlightening the fullness of the faithful,
driving away the darkness of heresies, all-blest Godbearer,
with the power of Him Who shone forth from the Virgin!

commemoration.title: Saint Cyril, Archbishop of Alexandria

value.text:
The whole Church is adorned, holy Cyril,
with the good words of your preaching,
and arrayed with devotion in fitting beauty.
She honors your holy and venerable memory in a holy manner,
boast of the Orthodox, height of the fathers,
champion of the most holy Virgin at the council!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Timothy, Bishop of Prusa

value.text:
Holy Bishop Timothy,
boast of the people of Prussa,
you are the universal champion and beacon of the world,
adornment of the Church and holy sacrifice of faith,
the precious and gleaming adornment of the martyrs!
Pray that those who celebrate your most honored memory with faith
may be delivered from corruption and misfortunes!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Timothy, Bishop of Prusa

value.text:
With your sufferings, Timothy,
you wove an all-beautiful garment dyed in your blood.
You received ineffably from on high the heavenly garment
of incorrupt purity and unchanging life!
Athlete, as you wear this immaterial robe in the heights,
ever pray on behalf of all who praise you with devotion!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Timothy, Bishop of Prusa

value.text:
You were raised above the things of the earth
by your active ascetic purification.
Like a living cloud, most blessed one,
you threw down the evil serpent
with the thunder of your miracles
and the awesome lightning of your words!
You received the grace to burn the adversary
with the divine fire of the sacred gifts.

commemoration.title: Apostle Bartholomew of the Twelve

value.text:
All praised Barnabas,
radiant vessel of the Holy Spirit and son of consolation,
even before Paul you were the foremost of the seventy disciples;
with Paul you preached the gospel to the ends of the earth!
Therefore, fulfilling your talk of grace with your deeds,
you offered yourself as an immaculate whole burnt offering
to your Teacher Christ.
Glorious Apostle, we pray to you:
Ever beg that our souls may be saved in peace!

commemoration.title: Apostle Barnabas of the Seventy

value.text:
Barnabas, you were an instrument well tuned
by the action of the Spirit.
You committed yourself to summoning the nations,
guiding them to the knowledge of Christ by your words and deeds.
You have enlightened all to confess the true divinity of Jesus,
the Savior of our souls!

commemoration.title: Apostle Bartholomew of the Twelve

value.text:
You drew the ends of the earth out of the depths of vainglory
and evil ungodliness
with the net of your words, divinely eloquent Apostle!
You brought them with faith to Christ God
Who had given you such grace.
You are His divine disciple and the preacher of His mysteries,
Apostle Bartholomew!

commemoration.title: Apostle Barnabas of the Seventy

value.text:
You imitated the primal goodness
and essential and all-divine life.
You became a good man in essence, Barnabas,
receiving a name signifying "Son of consolation."
By the goodness of your character and purity of your mind,
you showed yourself to be a true disciple of Christ!

commemoration.title: Apostle Barnabas of the Seventy

value.text:
Submitting to the will of Him Whose will all things obey,
you imitated Him as a teacher of righteousness.
because of His suffering on the Cross,
you stand before your ultimate desire,
joining the chorus with the angels and apostles,
glorious Bartholomew!
You rejoiced as you drained the cup of death.

commemoration.title: Apostle Bartholomew of the Twelve

value.text:
Jesus our God, the Sun of righteousness,
sent you to the whole world like a ray of light
to disperse the gloom of ungodliness, all-glorious one,
and enlighten all who sit in the darkness of ignorance.
You made them heirs of the light,
divinely wise Bartholomew!

commemoration.title: Apostle Barnabas of the Seventy

value.text:
You have received invincible authority and power, Apostle,
over demons in the name of Christ,
to drive away the princes of darkness!
You traveled over the earth radiating light like the sun!
You were the first to arrive in Rome, glorious one,
preaching the saving coming of Christ!

commemoration.title: Apostle Bartholomew of the Twelve

value.text:
Your proclamation of salvation,
apostles and seers of God,
has gone out into all the earth,
enlightening the souls of those who were lost,
bringing to Christ those illumined by grace!
Therefore pray that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Venerable Onuphrius the Great

value.text:
Father Onuphrius, you were wise in God!
You endured the cold of night and burning heat of day
in the hope of future things.
You mortified your members on earth, venerable one,
and have received the life of heaven.
You entered with joy into the bridal chamber, holy one,
to behold the infinite beauty of your Creator!

commemoration.title: Venerable Onuphrius the Great

value.text:
Father Onuphrius, you were wise in God!
The glorious Paphnutius found you
hidden like a treasure in the desert!
He proclaimed clearly to those in the world
the discipline of your struggles.
He enriched the faithful with his account of your God-pleasing life.
By your supplications, all praised and glorious one,
show us to be your followers.

commemoration.title: Venerable Onuphrius the Great

value.text:
The sound of your teachings has gone out into all the earth,
venerable Father!
Therefore you have found the reward of your labors in the heavens.
You destroyed the hosts of demons
and reached the ranks of angels whose life you blamelessly followed!
Since you have boldness before Christ our God,
entreat peace for our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Onuphrius the Great

value.text:
Father Onuphrius, you were wise in God!
You cut yourself off from the tumult of the world
and climbed to the perfection of heaven.
You desired Him Who is the source of good things
and you received true love from Him, blessed one.
Enlightened by His radiance,
by your prayers, rescue us from the darkness of sin!

commemoration.title: Saint Triphyllius, Bishop of Leucosia (Nicosia), Cyprus

value.text:
We celebrate your holy memory, passion-bearing martyr,
knowing you to be an incorrupt bride adorned by the Holy Spirit!
We bow down in faith before your relics
and ever receive healing for our passions
as we honor you in confidence, most praised Aquilina.

commemoration.title: Saint Triphyllius, Bishop of Leucosia (Nicosia), Cyprus

value.text:
You offered the severing of your limbs as a gift to your Bridegroom!
Therefore, most honored one,
He counted you worthy of the all brilliant bridal chambers.
The transcendent One enlightens you with divine glory.
You stand before Him, rejoicing, Aquilina!
Earnestly pray to Him on behalf of us
who glorify your suffering with faith.

commemoration.title: Saint Triphyllius, Bishop of Leucosia (Nicosia), Cyprus

value.text:
You were inspired by God, Aquilina,
and held fast by the desire of your Creator.
You showed His suffering with your own flesh, all-praised one,
enduring each triple wave of pain!
Now as you live in the heavens,
wearing a crown that does not perish,
your glory is immune to pain!
And you look upon what the ranks of angels see!

commemoration.title: Prophet Elisha

value.text:
Showing kindness to the believing Shunamite woman of old,
in holiness you raised up the dead child by a prayer,
for you were a God-inspired, venerated prophet!
Again, with salt you brought the barren waters openly to fruitfulness;
you performed countless miracles by the grace of the all-powerful Spirit!
Therefore, blessed one, we praise you with hymns!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Manuel, Sabel, and Ismael, of Persia

value.text:
Let wonderful Manuel, blessed Sabel and all-wise Ismael
be honored with the most sacred hymns:
They openly preached the uncreated Trinity in holiness
in the presence of the enemies.
By an outpouring of blood they extinguished the delusion of idolatry.
They have received unfading glory!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Manuel, Sabel, and Ismael, of Persia

value.text:
Prize-winners, you are worthy of all praise!
Like brilliant stars you illumine the ends of the world with divine brightness!
You cast away the deep darkness of demons,
corrupting passions and dangers.
Therefore, glorious ones, as we assemble today,
we celebrate your radiant, light-bearing, joyful and holy feast!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Manuel, Sabel, and Ismael, of Persia

value.text:
You are great in name, Manuel, Ismael and Sabel:
You reasonably shamed the lawless king
when he lawlessly commanded you to bow down, blessed ones,
and offer unreasonable worship to lifeless gods!
You contended courageously and lawfully,
weaving crowns of victory for yourselves.
Now you intercede on behalf of the world!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Leontius, Hypatius, and Theodulus at Tripoli in Syria

value.text:
What shall we name you, passion-bearer?
Soldier of Christ, for you destroyed the enemy?
Ruler of passions, for you were an athlete of piety?
Feeder of the hungry, since you love the poor?
Righteous one, for you loved heavenly wisdom?
Many were your sufferings and splendid your struggles!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Leontius, Hypatius, and Theodulus at Tripoli in Syria

value.text:
All-praised athlete, Leontius,
neither fire, nor wounding, nor the sword
were able to separate you from the love of Christ!
You suffered manfully in the midst of the tormentors!
Divinely-wise bearer of the crown of victory,
you abolished the offerings of idols!
Now you dance in the heavens:
Pray earnestly that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Leontius, Hypatius, and Theodulus at Tripoli in Syria

value.text:
Who will not wonder at you, Leontius?
Since you received the well-spring of truth,
you pour forth rivers of benefaction to the faithful.
Without payment, you distribute abundant gifts to all who ask!
You gladden those who partake of the waters of goodness!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Leontius, Hypatius, and Theodulus at Tripoli in Syria

value.text:
What shall we call you, glorious one?
An offering of Greece, for you came from there?
Or the purification of Crete, for you were offered there?
A lamp, for you shone forth in the darkness?
A valiant one, for you were unconquered by those who wounded you?
Your honor takes many forms, most blessed Leontius!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Leontius, Hypatius, and Theodulus at Tripoli in Syria

value.text:
Let heaven rejoice in splendor today!
Let us the faithful on earth be glad
in the memory of the martyr Leontius!
For today has come, crowned not with irrational sacrifice,
but with spiritual flowers and the sacrifice of praise!
For as we offer the bloodless service to the Bestower of crowns,
he stands with us, adorned and radiant,
entreating for us that those who keep his memory in faith
may attain the courts of Paradise!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Methodius, Bishop of Patara

value.text:
You enlightened the fullness of the Church with your words,
divinely-revealed Methodius!
By the light of your sufferings
you diminished the darkness of pagan worship.
Now you have passed over to the never-setting light,
teacher of sacred truths.
Therefore we celebrate your radiant feast today,
enlightened with Godly devotion.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Methodius, Bishop of Patara

value.text:
You stained your sacred robe with streams of blood,
blessed God-bearing Methodius,
as you went forward, rejoicing, into the Holy of Holies!
There you gaze clearly upon the divine brightness of the Trinity,
all-blessed hierarch,
and are instructed more fully in Him Who is beyond comprehension and understanding!

commemoration.title: Martyr Julian of Tarsus, in Cilicia

value.text:
Blessed Martyr Julian,
we celebrate your divine and light-bearing memorial:
We know you as a radiant sun,
shining on the whole world with the brilliance of your mind;
casting out the night of disbelief in the true God!
As we venerate the dust of your relics, we gain strength of soul.

commemoration.title: Martyr Julian of Tarsus, in Cilicia

value.text:
You were lashed with a whip, blessed one,
kicked frightfully and confined in prison.
While in affliction, you transcended your surroundings:
You were encompassed by wild beasts;
you entered into the deep and were drowned by the sea.
You received your holy end without denying the Master of all!
You are greatly blessed, the glory of the martyrs!

commemoration.title: Martyr Julian of Tarsus, in Cilicia

value.text:
Your most holy and beloved mother
saw you drift from the waves of the sea to dry land.
By the direction of the Spirit,
she faithfully welcomed you, Martyr Julian.
She entrusted your blameless and sorely-tried body to the tomb:
The body victorious through grace over the devil's tyranny!

commemoration.title: Nativity of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist, John

value.text:
Today the voice of the Word is born
releasing Zachariah's silence;
revealing the harvest of the Church, freeing the bonds of barrenness.
The candlestick of the Light is drawing near!
The ray of the Sun proclaims His coming
for the edification of all and the salvation of our souls.

commemoration.title: Nativity of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist, John

value.text:
John is born; he ends Zachariah's silence.
The father cannot keep silent when his son, the voice of the Lord, is born!
When at first, he did not believe, his tongue was silenced,
but now John has been born to free his father:
The voice of the Word, the Forerunner of Light,
who always intercedes for our souls!

commemoration.title: Nativity of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist, John

value.text:
Today the great Forerunner comes from the barren womb of Elizabeth;
the great prophet of prophets, none greater than he!
The radiant candlestick of the Light; the voice of the Word,
the friend of the Bridegroom, preparing the Lord's chosen people
by purifying them with water before the coming of the Spirit.
The flower of the desert, the preacher of repentance,
the purification of transgressions.
He announced the Resurrection even to those in hell,
and he always prays for our souls.

commemoration.title: Nativity of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist, John

value.text:
Today the Forerunner heralds the coming of the Word of God;
today Zachariah's silence is freed,
for the father cannot remain silent at the nativity of the Forerunner
who will proclaim the world's deliverance with great boldness!

commemoration.title: Nativity of the Holy Glorious Prophet, Forerunner and Baptist, John

value.text:
Today the voice of Isaiah the prophet is fulfilled
in the birth of John, the greatest of prophets.
He said:  Behold, I will send my angel before Your face, to prepare Your way!
Now the warrior of the heavenly King has come.
He truly will prepare the way for our God.
A man by nature, but an angel in manner of life.
He embraced purity and chastity forever.
Now they are his by nature.
Let us all the faithful greet him, crying:
Pray for us, that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Febronia of Nisibis

value.text:
The divine beauty of your soul accompanied the beauty of your body.
You stood forth like a lily in the monastic robe,
arrayed in purple from the streams of your blood!
All-pure bride, the beautiful Bridegroom of heaven,
and the eternal bridal chamber,
have received you as a virgin and martyr!

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Febronia of Nisibis

value.text:
Behold Elizabeth, who said to the Virgin Mary:
Mother of my Lord, why have you come to me?
You bear the King and I the warrior.
You, the Law-giver; I, the transmitter of the law.
You, the Word and I, the voice proclaiming the Kingdom of heaven!

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Febronia of Nisibis

value.text:
Most-praised Febronia,
the angel of deliverance has come near to you,
for from childhood you were seen to fear the Lord.
You brought yourself to the Almighty as a pure and cherished offering.
Therefore, you trampled the foolishness of Selenus beneath your feet,
earnestly hastening to Christ, your Bridegroom!

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Febronia of Nisibis

value.text:
You Have Given A Sign
Most praised Febronia,
in your contest, you endured double suffering:
You mingled the blood of martyrdom with the sweat of your ascetic struggle.
Therefore the Benefactor has given you a double crown!
You have entered into Him adorned in splendor
as an all-pure virgin and invincible martyr!

commemoration.title: Virgin Martyr Febronia of Nisibis

value.text:
Elizabeth conceived the Forerunner of grace;
the Virgin conceived the King of glory!
Both mothers greeted each other with a kiss.
The infant leaped in the womb, praising his Master!
His mother was amazed and cried:
Why is this granted me, that the Mother of my Lord should come to me?
He will save the forsaken people, since He possesses great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint Sampson the Hospitable of Constantinople

value.text:
You were numbered with the ascetics,
divinely wise Father Samson:
You were adorned with freedom from passions.
Now you have gone to the holy monastery
radiant with the never-setting light
where the tree of life ever flourishes!
Intercede now that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Sampson the Hospitable of Constantinople

value.text:
Father Samson, inspired by God,
you are a lamp illumining the earth with the rays of your miracles!
You have enlightened all beneath the sun,
dispelling the darkness of the soul-destroying passions and diseases,
and the darkness of demons!
Intercede now that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Sampson the Hospitable of Constantinople

value.text:
You made your abode in the desert, all-praised father,
like Elijah of old!
You quenched the ragings of the flesh
with the fiery brightness of the ascetic life,
cleansing your mind by unceasingly turning to God!
Intercede now that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: The Holy Glorious and All-Praised Leaders of the Apostles, Peter and Paul

value.text:
How shall we worthily sing hymns to honor Peter and Paul?
Their hands  were filled with grace and truth;
their feet carried them to the ends of the earth,
preaching the Gospel of peace.
Once driven by the wind of the Spirit,
they are now carried up to heaven!
Truly they are rivers of wisdom and upholders of the Cross!
Through them  Christ our God, Who has great mercy,
has cast down the arrogance of demons!  (3 times)

commemoration.title: The Holy Glorious and All-Praised Leaders of the Apostles, Peter and Paul

value.text:
What spiritual songs shall we sing for Peter and Paul?
They have silenced the sharp tongues of the godless.
They are awesome swords of the Spirit.
They are the adornment of Rome;
they have nourished the whole world with the Word of God.
They are the living tablets of the New Testament
written by the hand of God:
Christ, Who has great and rich mercy,
has exalted them in Zion.

commemoration.title: The Holy Glorious and All-Praised Leaders of the Apostles, Peter and Paul

value.text:
Three times Christ asked Peter: Do you love me?
In this way He reversed the threefold denial of Himself.
Henceforth Simon was to lead those who had witnessed God's mysteries.
He cried out to the Lord:
You know all things; You know that I love You!
feed my sheep, tend my chosen ones, the Savior said.
feed my lambs, whose salvation I bought with my own blood!
blessed apostle, pray that he may grant us great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Holy Glorious and All-Praised Leaders of the Apostles, Peter and Paul

value.text:
What garlands of song shall we weave for Peter and Paul?
Separated in body, they were united by the Spirit;
they rank first among preachers:
One was the leader of the apostolic army,
while the other labored more than them all!
Truly, Christ our God, Who has great mercy,
has adorned them with the crowns of immortal glory! (3 times)

commemoration.title: The Holy Glorious and All-Praised Leaders of the Apostles, Peter and Paul

value.text:
A joyful feast dawns upon the earth today:
The memorial of Peter and  Paul,
the wise leaders of the apostles.
Let Rome rejoice and be glad with us!
Let us keep feast, brethren, in songs and hymns.
Rejoice, apostle Peter, true friend of Christ our God!
Rejoice, beloved Paul, herald of the faith and teacher of the universe!
You have boldness before him, chosen pair:
Pray unceasingly that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworking Unmercenary Physicians Cosmas and Damian at Rome

value.text:
Your holy tabernacles were light-bearing, saving heavens,
and now your relics shine as the sun,
radiant with the working of healing miracles, countless as the stars!
Blessed Cosmas and most glorious Damian,
ministers of the Lord, and intercessors for our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Hyacinth of Caesarea, in Cappadocia, and those with him

value.text:
The chosen head cornerstone has been set up in Zion:
The immovable foundation on which the ranks of martyrs have assembled themselves.
The victorious Hyacinth shines with them with heavenly light!
How great is your ineffable loving-kindness, Master!
By it, save our souls, as the only merciful One!

commemoration.title: Martyr Hyacinth of Caesarea, in Cappadocia, and those with him

value.text:
You shot through Jerusalem, the splendid city of God,
like a stone dyed with blood, clad in the purple robe of suffering.
You prayed openly, dancing and rejoicing!
By your prayers, all-blessed one,
save those who celebrate your all-glorious and sacred memory!

commemoration.title: Martyr Hyacinth of Caesarea, in Cappadocia, and those with him

value.text:
You possessed truly acceptable boldness before Christ the Master
as an invincible martyr and obedient listener!
Do not cease your entreaties, most wondrous one,
as a pious athlete,
delivering from temptation and evil fortune those who keep your memory,
singing hymns to you in faith!

commemoration.title: Finding of the relics of Venerable Maximus the Greek  (July 4, 1996)

value.text:
We know you to be a pillar of the Orthodox Faith;
an image of chastity, an example of meekness,
God's singer, illumining the Church of Christ,
an initiate of the sacred mysteries, Father Andrew.
Therefore, we celebrate your feast!

commemoration.title: Finding of the relics of Venerable Maximus the Greek  (July 4, 1996)

value.text:
Andrew, you turned to the Mother of God
as the subject of great praise;
with sweet words you praised the ways of the holy apostles
and the company of blessed martyrs.
With them, remember us who glorify you!

commemoration.title: Finding of the relics of Venerable Maximus the Greek  (July 4, 1996)

value.text:
You despised the earthly authority of the body.
with a clear mind and a pure heart
you clung to the Lord, wise Father Andrew!
You were revealed to be a God-inspired instrument of the Comforter,
singing the works of saving grace!

commemoration.title: Finding of the relics of Venerable Maximus the Greek  (July 4, 1996)

value.text:
We honor you, Andrew our father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Conversor with the angels, companion of the venerable and righteous ones!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh

value.text:
When the time came for your departure to God,
you entered the heavenly mansions as a brightly shining star
where you stand with the choir of saints before the throne of the consubstantial Trinity.
Your body lay hidden in the earth for many years:
It was revealed, manifesting wonders for those who venerate your relics, Sergius.
Grant victories to the Orthodox Christians over their adversaries;
pray to Christ our God to grant the faithful remission of sins
entreating Him to save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh

value.text:
When your mother came to the Church of God
even before your birth,
you cried out in her womb three times, giving glory to the Trinity.
Godly-wise Father Sergius,
you knew God before you knew the world!
You were known by God, blessed man.
The light of His grace shone from you to those who sought it.
The radiance of your face showed your spiritual and bodily purity.
You were a chosen vessel of Christ our God.
Entreat Him to save and enlighten our souls.

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh

value.text:
Come, faithful sons and daughters of the Russian Church!
Let us rejoice in this solemn feast!
Come, priests and monastics and behold the Church of God
filled and adorned with the sound of psalms, hymns and spiritual songs!
The venerable and glorious monastery of our Father Sergius rejoices,
exulting in the revelation of his relics.
It calls the world to sing to God with gladness:
Christ and Master, you have granted the people of Russia a mighty warrior;
an invincible weapon against invisible and visible enemies,
an unfailing treasure of gifts for the people of Christ!
By his prayers, grant our souls great mercy.

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh

value.text:
Saint, divinely wise,
when you heard a divine voice that said to you:
Behold, the coming of the most pure one!
You began to make yourself worthy of this visitation,
with many spiritual labors, and fervent prayer.
Light brighter than the sun illumined you,
showing your spiritual and bodily eyes the Mother of God.
You heard her words to you:
I shall not abandon this place, and your monastery shall not be in want.
Entreat her to save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh

value.text:
When the love of God descended on you,
divinely-wise and most blessed Father Sergius,
then you despised the world and loved only Christ in your soul.
Following His life-bearing steps, you reached the wilderness,
and cultivated it with the seeds of your labors,
irrigating it with streams of tears,
multiplying the fruits of good works.
Having nourished your children with these, you brought them to Christ God:
Entreat Him to save and enlighten our souls.

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh

value.text:
Lord, You have adorned your Church
with the precious and healing relics of our Father Sergius,
for he was well-pleasing to You.
She is beautiful, as the possessor of royal jewels,
rejoicing as she wears a brilliant crown,
calling her children begotten by him according to the Gospel
with water and the Spirit!
Therefore we glorify your loving dispensation, Jesus,
the Lover of mankind, and the Savior of our souls!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Sergius of Radonezh

value.text:
We honor you, Sergius our father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Conversor with the angels,
companion of the venerable and righteous ones!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Sisoes the Great

value.text:
Your all-festive commemoration, venerable one,
has shone forth brightly like the sun!
It enlightens the thoughts of the faithful
with the splendor of your wonders
and brightens them with the rays of your mighty works, all-blessed one!
Therefore in celebration we joyously honor you
and faithfully bless you as the boast of monks!

commemoration.title: Venerable Sisoes the Great

value.text:
At the time of your dormition, Father,
an incomprehensible wonder took place:
A choir of angels stood at once before you;
your countenance, wise one, shone like the sun,
revealing your radiant form and the purity of your soul,
showing all the manner of the repose you received!

commemoration.title: Venerable Sisoes the Great

value.text:
You lived as an earthly angel, most wealthy one,
Wasting your body as though it belonged to another.
You ever instructed yourself divinely, father,
with vigils and the remembrance of death.
You grew with great strides to your ultimate desire!
You have indeed drawn near to perfection itself!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Pancratius, Bishop of Taormina in Sicily

value.text:
When the pre-eminent among the disciples went about,
confirming the whole world,
he found you to be like a precious stone.
He set you, blessed one, as a foundation of the Church.
You cast down the pillars and temples of idolatry
by the divine power of the Word
Whose good pleasure it was to dwell with men in the flesh!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Pancratius, Bishop of Taormina in Sicily

value.text:
You cast out the evil spirits of malice by the Word,
making people spiritual by the grace of the Spirit.
You worked the field of their hearts, martyr Pancratius,
casting there the seed of God.
You have offered the fruits to the heavenly Gardener,
praying for those who praise you with faith!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Pancratius, Bishop of Taormina in Sicily

value.text:
You made the west like the east with spiritual splendors,
bearing the sun of the knowledge of God
Who shone forth upon us from the Virgin
in a way past understanding!
You set in your suffering, Father Pancratius,
shining forth to the never-setting light,
where, beyond the darkness of mirrors,
you behold the longed-for beauty of the Judge of your contest!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr Euphemia the All-praised

value.text:
Your memory dawns like the sun, holy Olga.
The mother of Russian kings, you pointed the way to Christ.
Teaching the angelic way, you overthrew the idol,
and the devil you countered with strength from the Holy Spirit.
You led the whole land to God from the darkness of ignorance.
pray to Him for those who remember you.

commemoration.title: Martyrs Proclus and Hilary of Ancyra

value.text:
You suffered a multitude of tortures,
together obtaining your holy crowns, Proclus and Hilary.
Therefore we worthily celebrate your memory,
praying fervently that you may intercede for us.

commemoration.title: Martyrs Proclus and Hilary of Ancyra

value.text:
Proclus, your body was torn asunder,
but you obtained eternal glory, blessed one.
Now that you are in the eternal light of Paradise,
pray that we who sing to you may also see this light!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Proclus and Hilary of Ancyra

value.text:
Like two fountains of light, holy passion bearers, Proclus and Hilary,
dispel the darkening of passions
as we sing to you with joy,
celebrating your memory!

commemoration.title: Holy Great Prince Vladimir (Basil in Baptism), Equal of the Apostles, and Enlightener of Rus'

value.text:
You were a second Constantine in word and deed,
for he was born in a Christian age,
