yet lived for many years among the pagans,
while you were born of heathen,
but loved Christ Who loved you.
You have gone to Him rejoicing!
Pray ceaselessly to Him for those who honor your memory.

commemoration.title: Holy Great Prince Vladimir (Basil in Baptism), Equal of the Apostles, and Enlightener of Rus'

value.text:
Brightly shining Mount Sinai, rejoices eternally,
for it is sanctified by the law of Moses and has seen the invisible,
and your great city, Vladimir, also shines brightly and celebrates with joy,
beholding in the Spirit the Son glorified in you with the Father.
Pray to Him to save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy Great Prince Vladimir (Basil in Baptism), Equal of the Apostles, and Enlightener of Rus'

value.text:
Come, let us all hasten to celebrate the memory of Vladimir,
our Russian father and guide.
He was born of heathens and came to love Christ Who loved him,
He has gone to Christ, rejoicing with his grandmother Olga.
He taught all his people to believe and worship one God in Trinity;
he destroyed the idols, and trampled them underfoot.
He nurtured for us Boris and Gleb, his precious posterity.
We now honor their memory with joy and faith, and keep the feast with love.
May they pray to the Lord to grant victory to the Orthodox Christians over their adversaries;
to grant peace to the whole world, and to save our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy Great Prince Vladimir (Basil in Baptism), Equal of the Apostles, and Enlightener of Rus'

value.text:
You were a root of the true faith, Vladimir,
watered by the Holy Spirit.
You put forth for us divinely planted branches with fragrant flowers:
The wondrous Boris, and Gleb, the zealot of godliness;
abundant sources of miracles for all the faithful.
Standing with them before Christ,
pray to Him to save and enlighten our souls.

commemoration.title: Holy Great Prince Vladimir (Basil in Baptism), Equal of the Apostles, and Enlightener of Rus'

value.text:
For the Russian people, Vladimir,
you were a father in spirit, a king and true preacher;
an apostle of Christ, announcing the baptism of salvation.
And having thereby brightly illumined your people,
you sanctified them throughout all the lands of your kingdom, blessed one.

commemoration.title: Holy Great Prince Vladimir (Basil in Baptism), Equal of the Apostles, and Enlightener of Rus'

value.text:
Most glorious wonder!
The wisdom of the proud perishes today,
and all the forces of evil lament at beholding Vladimir the great, our faithful ruler:
The wild branch that was divinely planted by the strength of God,
glorified and radiantly crowned by Him.

commemoration.title: Holy Great Prince Vladimir (Basil in Baptism), Equal of the Apostles, and Enlightener of Rus'

value.text:
Assemblies of the Orthodox faithful,
let us praise Vladimir the great:
Teacher of godliness, preacher of the faith, and first among Russian princes.
Let us crown him as equal to the apostles, with praises and spiritual songs:
Rejoice, most brave soldier of Christ!
For you wearied the enemy and caused him to perish
and having delivered us from his wiles,
you led us to Christ, our King and God!
Now, most-blessed and praise-worthy prince,
pray that peace and health be granted to orthodox Christians,
and victory over their adversaries,
and for our souls, great mercy!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Marina (Margaret) of Antioch

value.text:
All-glorious martyr Marina!
You have most worthily made your dwelling in the heavenly mansions
with the ranks of virgins and the legions of martyrs:
By your intercessions save those who celebrate your memorial in faith,
faithfully drawing near to your protection.
Beseech God for remission of sins, redemption and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Great Martyr Marina (Margaret) of Antioch

value.text:
All-laudable martyr Marina,
neither the fire of torments nor the enjoyment of pleasure,
nor worldly graces, nor the delight of youth,
separated you from the love of Christ!
You desired to reach the surpassing beauty of your holy Bridegroom:
You were made worthy of this, most divinely-blessed one!

commemoration.title: Martyr Emilian of Silistria in Bulgaria

value.text:
Though consumed by the fire, glorious one,
afflicted with wounds, imprisoned in dungeons
and subjected to many tribulations,
you did not sacrifice to the idols
nor did you deny Christ!
You remained invincible:
Therefore, the Master, the immovable King and good Judge of the contest
has given you the crown of victory!

commemoration.title: Martyr Emilian of Silistria in Bulgaria

value.text:
You dyed your robe with your blood, glorious one.
Wearing it, you have entered the Kingdom on high with joy!
You stand forever before God, the King of all,
asking for peace, health and speedy deliverance from evils
for those who honor you with faith!

commemoration.title: Martyr Emilian of Silistria in Bulgaria

value.text:
You ground the religion of the Greeks as fine as dust!
Through the grace of Christ our God, martyr Emilian,
you built a living tower of the knowledge of God,
a temple of holiness,
an immovable foundation of piety
for those who honor your courageous feats with godly wisdom,
most wealthy one!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Seraphim of Sarov

value.text:
Today the faithful rejoice in your memory, holy Father Seraphim
proclaiming you with a loud voice.
You forsook the good things of this life for love of Christ
and went to live in Sarov's wilderness.
You were not afraid of the struggle with invisible enemies,
but you swept them aside like dust with your prayers.

commemoration.title: Venerable Macrina, sister of Saint Basil the Great

value.text:
You lived in purity,
preserving your virginity chaste and undefiled.
You distributed your wealth, fulfilling the commandment of Christ.
Following Him, you forsook the world and all that is in it.
Therefore Jesus, the Lover of mankind and Savior of our souls,
has given you heaven and the things of heaven!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Seraphim of Sarov

value.text:
Holy Monk, when you went, into the wilderness of Sarov,
you put off your own will to the very end,
showing steadfast obedience to all.
You rejoiced to endure offense and dishonor!
You prayed for those who injured you.
Therefore we glorify your memory and entreat you:
Pray that the Lord will grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Seraphim of Sarov

value.text:
Come, assembly of the faithful!
Let us glorify today our great father in songs of praise!
Let us cry out to him:
Holy Monk, our Father Seraphim
you were truly granted divine life,
receiving from God a crown of incorruptible glory!
Therefore Sarov makes its boast in you;
your relics give glory to the Lord Who glorified you!
Pray that He will grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Seraphim of Sarov

value.text:
Blessed is the monastery of Sarov!
It holds you, holy Father Seraphim, as a treasure of virtues,
a vessel of purity, a guardian of chastity,
a well of grace, a spring of healing!
A physician who took no money from the sick,
a true ascetic who comforted those in affliction,
a peaceful harbor for those tossed in the storms of earthly passions!
Therefore we glorify your memory and entreat you:
Pray that the Lord will grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Seraphim of Sarov

value.text:
Rejoice, converser with angels,
the holy Monk Seraphim!
You lived with devotion upon the earth,
teaching the fear of the Lord to many who came to you
for you were enlightened by the Spirit!
You saw the things of the future
as though they belonged to the present day;
you filled the souls of the afflicted
with joy and tenderness.
Therefore we entreat you:
Pray to God for those who honor you!

commemoration.title: Uncovering of the relics of Venerable Seraphim of Sarov

value.text:
Holy Monk, saint Seraphim,
who can declare your struggles and the diseases which attacked you!
What tongue can proclaim the harsh life in the wilderness:
The vigils and the abstinence!
And again, your solitude living as a hermit,
your tongue ever still and silent as you stood in unceasing prayer.
Truly you have revealed yourself to be the adornment of those who fast;
an intercessor before God who will never be put to shame!
Therefore we cry out to you:
Rejoice, example of the monastic life!
Rejoice, comforter of those in affliction and need!
You have been a fervent advocate for all of us.
Pray to the Lord that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Prophet Elijah

value.text:
You were lifted up into the sky, to the gates of heaven,
by a fiery chariot, Elijah the Tishbite.
The grace of the fire worked a miracle on you.
Although you were created in the flesh you did not see death,
that you might preach in all places until the end.
Therefore come, and grant us your correction and instruction!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Prophet Elijah

value.text:
Two lights have shone in the universe:
the bright stars of Elijah and Elisha.
With the Word of God, the one stopped the rain from the heavens,
thus convicting the kings.
He ascended into heaven upon a fiery chariot!
The other received a double portion of grace.
He purified the polluted water,
and parted the stream of the Jordan.
now they rejoice with the angels:
Pray for the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Prophet Elijah

value.text:
Come, all Orthodox people!
Let us assemble in the holy place:
the temple in honor of the two prophets inspired by God!
Let us sing together, giving glory to Christ our God.
Let us raise our voices and say joyfully:
Rejoice, earthly angel, and heavenly man!
Elijah of great name!
Rejoice, for you received double grace from God:
Most revered Elisha!
Rejoice, pillars, champions and physicians of the Christian people!
Deliver from every obstacle and tribulation
those who celebrate your all-glorious feast in faith!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Prophet Elijah

value.text:
Never-setting light of the Church!
Prophet Elijah, burning with zeal for God!
You made the rain cease from heaven;
you were fed by a raven.
You convicted kings and were the cause of the death of priests.
You called down fire from heaven.
Twice you caused the death of fifty men.
The widow's jar of flour did not give out because of you,
nor did her flask of oil fail.
Through your prayers her son was raised from the dead.
You made fire burn the water,
and caused the streams of the Jordan to be turned back.
You ascended into heaven in a fiery chariot.
Elisha received a double portion of your grace:
Do not cease to intercede for us before God, to save our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Prophet Elijah

value.text:
Wise Elijah, in your burning zeal for God,
you slaughtered the priests of confusion with the sword!
By your word the heavens were bound
so that it might not rain upon the earth.
By giving your mantle to Elisha
he grew and was filled with a double portion of divine grace!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Prophet Elijah

value.text:
All-compassionate Word you translated Elijah the Tishbite
from the earth in a fiery chariot:
Through his prayers, save us who glorify you in faith
as we celebrate his divine and honored memory in joy!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Prophet Elijah

value.text:
Elijah, blessed of God,
you beheld the presence of God which enlightened you,
not in an earthquake, but in a still small voice.
You ascended to heaven in a wondrous manner,
sitting upon a chariot drawn by four horses:
You have become wonderful, God-inspired one!

commemoration.title: Prophet Ezekiel

value.text:
Wondrous Ezekiel,
most wise and blessed by God:
Having cleansed your soul and body,
you beheld in the spirit through a purified mind
the ineffable, unsearchable glory of the Lord
praised in hymns by innumerable voices,
borne aloft with lightning flashes by divine cherubim!

commemoration.title: Prophet Ezekiel

value.text:
Ezekiel, dwelling place of God,
you were sorely tried in emulation of Christ.
You bore the cruel burden of a debt to aliens:
You desired that this be recorded beforehand for the sake of the Cross,
the God-revealed deliverance and salvation of the world!
Pray that all who celebrate your memory to day
may be granted a share in it!

commemoration.title: Prophet Ezekiel

value.text:
Glorious Ezekiel, inspired by God:
You received from the Almighty a scroll
sweeter than honey in your mouth!
Made knowledgeable in things divine,
beholding and contemplating God,
you were a herald of holy mysteries,
offering the resentful assembly compassion from God.

commemoration.title: Myrrhbearer and Equal of the Apostles Mary Magdalene

value.text:
Mary Magdalene,
you were the first to behold the Resurrection
of Him Who in compassion raised our nature to its first splendor.
You became an apostle to the apostles!
Proclaiming the good news, you cried out to them:
Stop your lamentation and receive my announcement of joy!
Come and see the Resurrection of Christ,
Who has granted great mercy to the world!

commemoration.title: Myrrhbearer and Equal of the Apostles Mary Magdalene

value.text:
As a disciple faithfully ministering to Christ God
Who in His great compassion willingly assumed my poverty,
Mary Magdalene beheld Him stretched upon the Tree
and enclosed within a tomb.
She cried aloud with flowing tears:
What strange sight do I see?
You give life to the dead, yet You are counted among the dead!
How shall I bring myrrh to Hou
when You have removed from me the stench of demons?
How shall I shed tears for You,
for You wiped away the tears of Eve?
Yet, King of all, you appeared as a Gardener,
taking away the burning heat with the dew of your words.
You said to her: Go to My brethren!
Declare to them the joy of the Gospel!
For I shall ascend to the Father,
to My God and your God,
that I may grant great mercy to the world!

commemoration.title: Martyr Trophimus and 14 Others in Lycia

value.text:
With yourself, you led a choir of martyrs!
You suffered and rejoiced with them, wise one!
You have fittingly received heavenly blessings.
With them, remember us who praise you in faith,
entreating Christ that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Martyr Trophimus and 14 Others in Lycia

value.text:
Come, faithful: let us praise the martyrs Trophimus and Theophilus,
and with them, thirteen companions!
They quenched the fire of delusion with their precious blood!
Now they live in the Kingdom on high,
ever asking that our souls be granted peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Martyr Trophimus and 14 Others in Lycia

value.text:
You were undaunted as you entered the judgment hall, Martyr!
You endured sufferings and torture!
As you were wounded, you wounded the contending enemy,
seizing victory over him, Trophimus!
Therefore pray that our souls may be granted peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Martyrs and Passion-Bearers Boris and Gleb

value.text:
He Who orders all things by his providence,
fittingly granted you the name of Christ,
for you reached a worthy end in both name and works!
You betrothed yourself with faith and righteousness to Christ!
And as the daughter of the King of heaven, martyr,
you rejoice with Him and ever pray for us!

commemoration.title: Martyrs and Passion-Bearers Boris and Gleb

value.text:
Neither the passionate attachment of your parents
nor the pleasure of food,
nor the possession of riches, glorious one,
nor threats of torture by fire or the sword,
the wheel or the depths of the sea,
nor the attacks of wild beasts
could separate you from the love of your Creator,
Virgin Martyr Christina,
the glory and boast of the martyrs!

commemoration.title: Martyrs and Passion-Bearers Boris and Gleb

value.text:
Desiring the heavenly Father, glorious one,
you spurned your own impious father!
You loved the Jerusalem on high as your mother,
rejecting your mother's over-bearing love!
You were deified by Christ, and then laid down your life,
undaunted by tortures, martyr!

commemoration.title: Martyr Christina of Tyre

value.text:
Martyr Christina,
you offered your blood as priceless myrrh to Christ, your Bridegroom!
As an invincible athlete, wondrous one,
you received from Him the reward of an unfading crown!
You called upon the All-holy Spirit
and by your word, raised from the dead one stung by a venomous serpent!
Therefore Jesus, the Lover of mankind and Savior of our souls
has granted you a dwelling in the mansions of heaven!

commemoration.title: Dormition of the Righteous Anna, the Mother of the Most Holy Theotokos

value.text:
Divinely wise Anna,
you gave birth to the bearer of Life!
You presented your pure child to a life with God.
Together with the heavenly hosts,
you rejoice in the riches from on high.
We commemorate your falling asleep,
and on this day we honor the divine wisdom in faith!

commemoration.title: Dormition of the Righteous Anna, the Mother of the Most Holy Theotokos

value.text:
You faithfully observed the law
and worked unceasingly for God the Creator.
He granted you motherhood, Anna:
Your child brought forth Christ in the flesh.
With the Virgin Mother we honor you,
and celebrate today your holy dormition.

commemoration.title: Dormition of the Righteous Anna, the Mother of the Most Holy Theotokos

value.text:
Having divine wisdom, you gave birth to the door of heaven,
and you achieved heavenly glory forever!
We celebrate your holy dormition, Anna,
and ask you to pray that the turmoil of passions not destroy us,
and that we be spared from fear and desolation.

commemoration.title: Dormition of the Righteous Anna, the Mother of the Most Holy Theotokos

value.text:
Rejoice, spiritual swallow:
You announced the spring-time of grace to us!
You lived well and blamelessly in chastity,
preserving the treasure of virginity.
You gave birth with the pangs of a mother
to the all-pure Theotokos who alone knew not a man!
You are the honored ewe lamb who gave birth to the heifer
who at the angel's word bore the Word:
The Lamb who takes away the sin of the world,
and has translated you from the earth,
Anna, grandmother of the Lord!
Pray to Him now that He will grant great mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
Rejoice, Alaska; exult, North America,
for a lamp bearing the Light of the Sun of Righteousness
has gloriously appeared in you:
Father Jacob, wise in God,
who enlightened the northern lands
with the joyous message of the Gospel of Christ,
now shines forth in all the world.
Therefore we sing praises to Christ Who is wondrous in His saints!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
The holy prophet Moses
raised up a tabernacle on Mount Horeb
and there he spoke with God face to face
as one might speak with a friend.
The righteous Jacob pitched a tent in the Alaskan wilderness,
where he celebrated the mysteries of Christ
for the sanctification of the faithful.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
Today the assembly of the faithful
rejoices in the memory of Father Jacob,
boast of Alaska and glory of priests,
wise preacher of the Gospel of Christ,
sure pillar of the Church,
fellow-citizen with the angels,
equal of the apostles and prophets!
Holy Jacob, blessed Father,
entreat Christ our God that our souls may be saved.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
Born on the remote island of Atka,
you were called to become a witness to Christ,
not by the glorious path of martyrdom,
but by humbly accepting the divine call to enter the holy priesthood,
preaching healing, counseling, praying to God and tending your flock
for forty years in the Alaskan wilderness.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
Missionary teacher of the Atkan Aleuts,
you translated the Word of God and founded schools for them.
You continued the missionary efforts of the holy hierarch Innocent.
Following his example, you journeyed to remote lands,
bringing the Gospel to the Yup'iks and Athabascans
baptizing them into love and unity in Christ,
sanctifying them and bestowing the blessings of peace.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
Lovers of the feasts, let us hasten together
to honor the righteous Jacob!
He poured out his life for the Church
in countless sorrows and afflictions.
In pain and deprivation
he bore all like the apostles of old.
Therefore we celebrate your memory,
saint chosen by God,
for you are a helper to those in distress,
Jacob our father.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
Like the patriarch Jacob of old,
our holy Father Jacob
fled from the comforts of this life
and was granted a vision:
A ladder from heaven appeared in the wilds of Alaska
that the people might ascent to God.
With patience and love and the labor of many years,
he obtained the longed-for Bride:
the Holy Church of Christ,
shining forth in his native land.
Therefore we cry out to Him:
Entreat the Lord for us, holy Father Jacob,
that our souls may be saved.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Hermolaus and Martyrs Hermippus and Hermocrates at Nicomedia

value.text:
Martyr and athlete, Hermolaus,
once you hid yourself in fear from the evil ones.
You rejoiced to reveal the hidden mystery of devotion and understanding
to the passion-bearer Panteleimon.
Then you revealed yourself and zealously died for Christ
Who was well-pleased to suffer for us in His goodness.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Hermolaus and Martyrs Hermippus and Hermocrates at Nicomedia

value.text:
Martyr and athlete, Hermolaus,
you desired a holy life in sanctity.
You became a bishop of the almighty Jesus,
and by your life-bearing sermons and grace
you saved the people from the darkness of impurity.
You have passed over to the heavens,
washed in the blood of your suffering,
blessed one of God!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Hermolaus and Martyrs Hermippus and Hermocrates at Nicomedia

value.text:
Let us praise in faith with holy words
the martyrs of the Lord, Hermippus, Hermolaus and Hermocrates!
They suffered in a wonderful way,
killing the evil one and washing themselves in the water of baptism!
They were not defiled again with other impurities.
Therefore let us keep the feast and celebrate their memory!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
Father Jacob,
you have been revealed as a true lover of Christ,
as a faithful servant at the altar
and as a priest of the Lord,
an instructor in prayer and perseverance
an intercessor for the Old World and the New.
Pray for peace and great mercy for our souls.

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Jacob Netsvetov, Enlightener of the Peoples of Alaska

value.text:
A new miracle surpasses all ancient miracles!
Who knows of a Mother who gave birth without a man,
who carried in her arms her Creator?
This birth is the will of God!
Since you carried Him as an infant in your arms, most pure one,
and since you possess motherly boldness before Him:
do not cease praying for us who honor you,
that He may be bountiful and save our souls!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr and Healer Panteleimon

value.text:
The honorable memorial of the unmercenary has dawned on us today,
calling the faithful to a mystical feast,
leading the company of feast-lovers to a celebration of triumph!
For the wonderworking physician Panteleimon,
the great passion-bearer, now comes to us,
healing the infirmities of all,
and praying fervently to the Lord to save our souls!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr and Healer Panteleimon

value.text:
Because of your spiritual inheritance
you were named Panteleimon.
By lovingly caring for the souls of all men and healing their bodies,
you were shown to be worthy of the wealth of your name.
By acquiring the reward of virtue and retribution of piety, martyr,
you were revealed as a crown-bearing and invincible warrior of Christ our God.
Implore Him to save and enlighten our souls.

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr and Healer Panteleimon

value.text:
You unceasingly drew the grace of divine healing
from the spiritual fountains of the Savior,
abundantly pouring them out upon those who came to you, blessed one!
Illumine by your divine grace
those who in faith keep your glorious, all-holy and light-bearing feast.

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr and Healer Panteleimon

value.text:
You came to love the piety of your mother,
and reject the godlessness of your father.
You became a warrior; a true physician of souls!
You instructed yourself in the healing arts.
You were well skilled in matters of both soul and body:
a true physician and destroyer of sufferings.
As you acquired steadfastness in suffering and perseverance in prayer,
Panteleimon, martyr of Christ, pray fervently that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Holy Apostles of the Seventy and Deacons: Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, and Parmenas

value.text:
By a choice determined by God,
you were honored by being preferred to serve the needs of the saints!
You were full of divine wisdom, illumination and grace!
Now, glorious ones, you ever dwell in the heavens,
rejoicing with the angels.

commemoration.title: Holy Apostles of the Seventy and Deacons: Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, and Parmenas

value.text:
By the grace of the Spirit,
you were revealed to the world as bright lamps
shining richly with the light of knowledge,
ending the darkness of wickedness!
Having been translated, apostles,
you make your dwelling near the unapproachable Light!

commemoration.title: Holy Apostles of the Seventy and Deacons: Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, and Parmenas

value.text:
Let us praise the most holy Nicanor,
Parmenas and Timon,
and with them let us honor the divine Prochorus,
for these men fulfilled the commands of the Word!
They enrich the doubting,
and are most ardent intercessors with our God!

commemoration.title: Martyr Callinicus of Gangra in Asia Minor

value.text:
All-blessed martyr Callinicus,
you obtained the unseen Lord as an invincible ally against unseen enemies!
You raised up great trophies of immortality!
By the first of your contests
you overthrew him who boasts that he would blot out the earth and the sea.
You drowned him in the streams of your blood!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Procession of the Honorable and Lifegiving Cross of the Lord

value.text:
Come, faithful, let us behold the strange wonder:
How the tree of the Cross quenches the fire of every infirmity
and extinguishes the burning heat of the passions
in those who celebrate its prefeast with faith
and honor the celebration!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Procession of the Honorable and Lifegiving Cross of the Lord

value.text:
All who live, celebrate the prefeast with those who have died!
For the Tree of life, the protector of all,
the Resurrection of the dead, which killed hell,
now comes to give true grace and healing to all!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Procession of the Honorable and Lifegiving Cross of the Lord
Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Today the divine assembly of the faithful rejoices
for the Cross appears throughout the world!
It illumines the heavens with ineffable light,
brightens the air, adorning the face of the earth.
The Church of Christ exults with divine singing,
venerating and serving the holy and wondrous Cross which preserves her from above.
As we are strengthened by its power, let us approach the Master saying:
Grant peace to the world, and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Let all creation rejoice and dance!
for today the Cross shines from heaven to the ends of the earth!
It enlightens those who are born on earth,
bringing them to unity.
Today mankind exults with the choirs of angels,
for the Cross has destroyed the dividing walls
and gathered all into one.
Shining brighter than the sun, it enlightens all creation with grace,
showing salvation plainly to those who honor it in faith!

commemoration.title: Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Raising their minds above visible things,
their bodily limbs cut down,
the brave and righteous youths, with their divinely-wise mother,
were strengthened by the great hopes which have been fulfilled,
as they now rest in the bosom of their forefather Abraham!

commemoration.title: Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Most holy Eleazar,
the young men and their divinely wise mother,
arming themselves firmly with youthful boldness of soul,
gathering strength from zeal,
steadfastly attacked the adversary for the sake of piety,
to preserve the law of their fathers.

commemoration.title: Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Shining brighter than the sun,
revealing itself to the world as the scepter of Christ the King,
it shines to all the ends of the earth.
It has brought the human race out of hell.
And having despoiled hell and overthrown the enemy,
it vanquishes the arrogance of demons.
Now it declares the Resurrection of the Savior, and saves all who cry:
Grant peace to the world, and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Persecution did not shake the roof of the law,
firmly upheld by seven pillars.
For they bravely endured the senseless fury of their tormentor,
giving their bodies to the executioners:
These noble young men and brothers,
guardians of the oracles of Moses.

commemoration.title: Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
The holy Maccabees said to the tyrant:
Antiochus, there is for us one King alone:
God in Whom we have our being and to whom we turn!
A world higher and more lasting than the one we see awaits us.
Our homeland is the sure and invincible Jerusalem!
She keeps this solemn feast with the angels!
By their prayers, have mercy on us and save us!

commemoration.title: Procession of the Honorable Wood of the Life-Giving Cross of the Lord (First of the three “Feasts of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
The souls of the just are in the hands of God:
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, the forefathers before the law,
and their inheritance, the Maccabees whom now we praise.
For these sons of Abraham followed Him in the faith with strength of soul,
wrestling even to death for the sake of godliness.
Raised in reverence and striving worthily,
they reproved the godless Antiochus.
For the sake of eternal life they scorned the things of this world,
setting aside for God their lives: Soul and body!
Holy mother, who brought forth for us these seven sons!
With her, Maccabees, and the wise priest Eleazar,
as you stand before Christ our God for whom you labored,
entering into the fruits of your reward,
ever pray to Him for mankind.
For according to His will, He answers those who pray to Him in faith!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen from Jerusalem to Constantinople

value.text:
Stephen, you were the first among the martyrs to suffer;
you are the foundation of those who serve as deacons,
chosen by the apostles.
you enlighten with unfading light
those who celebrate your radiant feast with splendor,
giving grace and mercy to your servants.
by your prayers, martyr, guide them to everlasting life.

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen from Jerusalem to Constantinople

value.text:
Most honored Stephen,
first of the martyrs to suffer,
you are crowned with grace and glory, apostle.
When you were stoned, you offered a crown to our King and God,
spiritual and more valued than gold and precious stones.
Beautiful are your deeds and name!
Remember all of us!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen from Jerusalem to Constantinople

value.text:
Apostle Stephen,
you were shown to be first among martyrs and deacons;
the adornment of athletes, the strength of the faithful,
the glory of the righteous.
As you stand before the throne of Christ, the King of all,
ask that those who celebrate your honored memory
may be counted worthy to be cleansed of their sins
and to inherit the Kingdom of heaven.

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen from Jerusalem to Constantinople

value.text:
Stephen, martyr of Christ,
you received a crown of grace on your head,
in accordance with your name.
You adorned your neck with a chain of virtues as with gold.
You became an all-wise dwelling of the Wisdom you cherished,
keeping it as your beloved.
Therefore you have been honored with grace and glory!

commemoration.title: Translation of the relics of the Protomartyr and Archdeacon Stephen from Jerusalem to Constantinople

value.text:
Rejoice in the Lord, crown-bearer Stephen!
You followed your Master,
for you were the first martyr of Christ our King.
You abolished the deception of the enemy
and you pray to the Lord for the salvation of our souls.

commemoration.title: Venerable Isaac the Ascetic of the Dalmatian Monastery at Constantinople

value.text:
Your saints made themselves like the bodiless ones
with prayer and abstinence, Lord.
They dispelled the passions of the flesh
and brilliant with wonderful works
they have enlightened the hearts of all!
Through their supplications grant Your people great mercy.

commemoration.title: Venerable Isaac the Ascetic of the Dalmatian Monastery at Constantinople

value.text:
You appeared plainly as stars in the firmament of ascetic endeavor,
illumining the souls of monastics, venerable fathers,
driving away the darkness of demons.
Therefore, even after your death you are called blessed,
praying that all who celebrate your godly memory may be saved.

commemoration.title: Venerable Isaac the Ascetic of the Dalmatian Monastery at Constantinople

value.text:
Taking up zeal for the virtues,
Dalmatus and Isaac openly overthrew the heresy of Arius and Nestorius.
They fought on the side of the Orthodox
and have gained glory from all!
Through their prayers, Christ, grant Your people great mercy!

commemoration.title: 7 Holy Youths “Seven Sleepers” of Ephesus

value.text:
Come, let us ever sing hymns to the memory of the seven honored youths;
the brilliant seven-branched lampstand.
Let us cry out to Christ Who has crowned them:
By their prayers, Lord and Deliverer, bring peace to our life!

commemoration.title: 7 Holy Youths “Seven Sleepers” of Ephesus

value.text:
The seven godly youths died according to nature.
Yet they rose up at once as though from sleep
in a manner transcending nature indeed
for they had slept in the cave as dead for three hundred and seventy two years!

commemoration.title: 7 Holy Youths “Seven Sleepers” of Ephesus

value.text:
Now let us honor John and Martinian,
Anthony and Dionysius
with the godly Iamblicus and Maximilian,
for they pray on our behalf.
Together with them let us praise with devotion
the wise Exacustodian.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Come, let us go up with Jesus Who ascends the holy mountain!
There let us listen to the voice of the living God,
the unoriginate Father, Who through the divine Spirit
bears witness to His true Sonship with a cloud!
Illumined in mind, let us gaze upon Light in the midst of light!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Come, let us dance in the prefeast!
Let us purify ourselves!
Let us faithfully prepare for the divine entry
into the dwelling place of the transcendent God!
Let us receive the glory
which the forechosen apostles were given to behold mystically on Mount Tabor!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Come, let us transform ourselves with a higher transformation!
Let us prepare ourselves for tomorrow,
to ascend the holy mountain of God,
to behold the glory of Christ
which shines forth without changing more brightly than the sun!
Illumined with the light of the Trinity,
let us glorify His condescension!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
By your honored sufferings, glorious athlete Eusignius,
you portrayed the honored Passion,
and as a conqueror, you dwell in the city on high,
rejoicing with all the martyrs.
You are made divine by communion with the Godhead!
Therefore, we celebrate your honored and holy festival!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Dyed in the blood of your flesh, glorious one,
you clothed yourself in the purple robe of divine grace
and placed upon your head the crown of incorruptible life!
You carried the trophy of the Cross in your right hand as a scepter.
Most wise Martyr, you ever rejoice as you reign with Christ!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
You were recognized, Eusignius, as an invincible warrior,
for wielding the sword of the cross,
you went out to do battle with the enemy.
You fought with splendor and cast him down,
receiving the crown of victory
from the one Master and Judge of the contest Who reigns forever!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Come, let us ascend the mountain of the Lord
to the house of our God!
Let us look upon the glory of His Transfiguration,
the glory of the only-begotten of the Father!
Through Light, let us receive Light,
and exalted in the Spirit,
let us ever sing hymns to the consubstantial Trinity!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Enlightened with the radiance
of the virtues,
let us go to the holy mountain
that we may behold
the divine Transfiguration of the Lord!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Today on the mountain,
shining like the sun,
before undergoing His sufferings,
Christ shows the initiates of His mysteries
a Godly sign of His Divinity!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Desiring to transform
the nature of Adam,
Christ now ascends Mount Tabor
that He may reveal His Divinity
to the initiates of His mysteries!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
You were transfigured in glory on Mount Tabor, Christ God,
revealing the glory of Your Divinity to Your disciples:
Enlighten us also with the light of the knowledge of You
and guide us in the path of Your commandments,
for You alone are good and the Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Prefiguring Your Resurrection, Christ our God,
You took with You in Your ascent upon Mount Tabor
Your three disciples, Peter, James and John.
when You were transfigured, Savior,
Mount Tabor was covered with light!
Your disciples, Word, threw themselves down upon the ground,
unable to gaze upon the form that none may see.
the angels ministered in fear and trembling;
the heavens shook and the earth quaked
as they beheld on earth the Lord of glory!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
The mountain that once was veiled in smoke and terrible,
is now holy and revered,
since Your feet, Lord, have stood there!
for Your dread Transfiguration, the mystery hidden before the ages,
has been made manifest in the last times to Peter, James and John.
unable to endure the shining of Your face and the brilliance of Your garments,
they fell to the ground upon their faces!
seized with wonder and amazement, they saw Moses and Elijah
talking with You about the things that would befall You;
and a voice came in testimony from the Father saying:
this is My beloved Son in Whom I am well pleased: listen to Him!
it is He Who grants the world great mercy!
Transfiguration:  Lord I Call Continued                  Page two

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Savior, when You were transfigured upon a high mountain,
having with You the chief disciples,
You shone forth in glorious majesty,
proving that those who surpass in virtue shall be made worthy of divine glory!
Moses and Elijah, talking with Christ,
showed that He is Lord of both the living and the dead;
the God Who spoke of old through the law and the prophets.
and the voice of the Father testified to Him from the cloud of light, saying:
Listen to Him, Who through the Cross has captured hell
and has given the dead eternal life!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Before Your Crucifixion, Lord,
taking the disciples up into a high mountain,
You were transfigured before them,
enlightening them with the bright rays of Your power:
From love of mankind and in Your sovereign might,
it was Your desire to show them the splendor of Your Resurrection!
Grant in Your mercy as the Lover of mankind,
that we too may be counted worthy of this splendor in peace, O God!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
When You were transfigured before Your Crucifixion, Lord,
the mountain became like heaven
and a cloud spread itself out like a canopy
and the Father bore witness to You.
There were present Peter with James and John,
since they were to be with You at Your betrayal,
that seeing Your wonders they might not be dismayed at Your sufferings.
Grant in Your great mercy
that we too may be counted worthy to venerate these Your sufferings in peace!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
O God, in Your goodness You have sanctified the whole world with Your light:
You were transfigured on a high mountain,
showing Your power to Your disciples:
for You redeem the world from transgression.
therefore we cry out to You: Lord of compassion, save our souls.

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Moses, who saw God,
and Elijah who rode the fiery chariot across the heavens unconsumed,
beheld You in the cloud at Your Transfiguration, O Christ.
they testified that You are the Maker and fulfillment
of the law and the prophets.
with them, Master, count us also worthy of Your light,
that we may sing Your praises unto all ages.

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Christ our God, You were transfigured in glory on Mount Tabor,
showing Your disciples the splendor of Your divinity:
enlighten us also with the light of Your knowledge
and guide us in the path of Your commandments,
for You alone are good and the Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Come, let us ascend into the mount of the Lord,
to the house of our God,
and behold the glory of His Transfiguration,
the glory of the only-begotten Son of the Father.
Let us receive light from His light!
with uplifted spirits let us forever sing the praises of the consubstantial Trinity!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Christ, the light that shone before the sun,
was on the earth in the flesh.
in a manner fitting His divine majesty,
He fulfilled His fearful dispensation before His Crucifixion!
today upon Mount Tabor
He has mystically made known the image of the Trinity.
for taking apart the expressly chosen disciples, Peter, James and John,
He led them up into the mountain alone.
briefly, He concealed the flesh He had assumed,
and was transfigured before them,
manifesting the original beauty, though short of full perfection.
for He spared them as He assured them, lest seeing, they die.
Yet they saw as far as they could bear it.
He likewise called before Him the chief prophets Moses and Elijah,
who testified to His divinity:
That He is indeed the true brightness of the essence of the Father,
the Ruler of the living and the dead.
Therefore, a cloud covered them like a tent,
and there came the voice of the Father in testimony, saying:
This is My beloved Son,
Whom I have begotten without change from the womb before the morning star:
I have sent Him to save those who are baptized
in the name of the Father, Son and Holy Spirit,
and who confess with faith that the one power of the Godhead is indivisible:
listen to Him!
Christ our God, supreme in goodness and the Lover of mankind:
shine upon us with the light of Your unapproachable glory
and make us worthy to inherit Your eternal kingdom!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
When the chosen apostles beheld upon the mountain of the Transfiguration
the overwhelming flood of Your light, unoriginate Christ,
and Your unapproachable divinity,
they were caught up into a divine trance.
The cloud of light shone around them on every side.
They heard the voice of the Father
confirming the mystery of Your incarnation,
for even after taking flesh, You remain the only-begotten Son,
and the Savior of the world!
Transfiguration: Apostikha continued                     page two

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
He Who once spoke through symbols to Moses on Mount Sinai
saying:  I am He Who is!
was transfigured today upon Mount Tabor before the disciples.
in His own person He showed them the nature of mankind
arrayed in the original beauty of the image.
calling Moses and Elijah to be witnesses of this surpassing grace,
He made them sharers in His joy,
foretelling His death on the Cross and His saving Resurrection!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
Lord, today on Mount Tabor,
You have revealed the glory of Your divine image
to Your chosen disciples, Peter, James and John.
For they looked upon Your garments that gleamed like the light,
and at Your face that shone more than the sun!
Unable to endure the vision of Your brightness which none can bear,
they fell to the earth, powerless to lift up their gaze,
for they heard a voice that spoke from above:
This is My beloved Son
Who has come into the world to save mankind!

commemoration.title: The Holy Transfiguration of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ (the Second “Feast of the Savior” in August)

value.text:
David, the ancestor of God,
foreseeing in Spirit the sojourn with mankind of the only-begotten Son in the flesh
called the creation together to rejoice with Him,
and prophetically lifted up his voice to cry:
Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Your name!
For having gone up the mount with Your disciples,
You were transfigured, O Christ,
and made Adam's darkened image to shine again like lightning,
transforming it into the glory and splendor of Your own divinity.
therefore we cry aloud to You:
Lord and Creator of all things, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Prefiguring Your Resurrection,  Christ our God,
You took with You in Your ascent upon Mount Tabor
Your three disciples, Peter, James and John.
When You were transfigured, Savior,
Mount Tabor was covered with light!
Your disciples, Word, threw themselves down upon the ground,
unable to gaze upon the form that none may see.
The angels ministered in fear and trembling;
the heavens shook and the earth quaked
as they beheld on earth the Lord of glory!

commemoration.title: Martyr Dometius of Persia and his two disciples

value.text:
Lord, born and made flesh from the Virgin Cloud,
You were transfigured on Mount Tabor,
surrounding Yourself with a bright cloud.
The voice of the Father in the presence of the disciples
plainly declared You to be the beloved Son,
one in essence and sharing the same throne.
Therefore Peter spoke in wonder, not knowing what he said:
It is good for us to be here, Benefactor, rich in mercy!

commemoration.title: Martyr Dometius of Persia and his two disciples

value.text:
From all eternity You are God the Word,
covering Yourself with light as with a garment!
You were transfigured before Your disciples,
shining more brightly than the sun.
Moses and Elijah stood by Your side,
making it plain that You are the Lord both of the dead and the living.
They glorified Your ineffable dispensation,
Your compassion and Your great condescension,
by which You have saved the world utterly lost in sin.

commemoration.title: Martyr Dometius of Persia and his two disciples

value.text:
Before Your precious Cross and Passion,
You took the holy disciples whom especially You had chosen.
You went up, Master, into Mount Tabor
wishing to show them Your glory.
When they saw You transfigured, shining more brightly than the sun,
they fell on their faces, struck with wonder at Your power,
and they cried aloud:
Christ, You are the timeless Light and brightness of the Father,
yet of Your own will without change You are manifested in the flesh!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Today You have given Your apostles
a taste of Your Divinity, Lord.
Moses and Elijah were seen with You,
for You are God of both the law and of grace.
You have ransomed us, although we were held fast in the clutches of death!
We glorify Your loving plan for mankind, together with Your apostles,
almighty Jesus, the Savior of our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
He who once spoke through symbols to Moses on Mount Sinai
saying: I am He Who is!
Was transfigured today upon Mount Tabor before the disciples.
In His Own person He showed them the nature of mankind
arrayed in the original beauty of the image.
Calling Moses and Elijah to be witnesses of this exceeding grace,
He made them sharers in His joy,
foretelling His death on the Cross and His saving Resurrection!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
David, the ancestor of God,
foreseeing in spirit the sojourn with men of the only-begotten Son in the flesh,
called the creation together to rejoice with him,
and prophetically lifted up his voice to cry:
Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in Your name!
For having gone up the mount with Your disciples,
You were transfigured,  Christ,
and You made Adam's darkened image to shine again as lightning,
transforming it into the glory and splendor of Your own Divinity.
Therefore we cry aloud to You:
Lord and Creator of all things, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
In your goodness, O God, You have sanctified the whole world with Your light
and were transfigured on a high mountain,
showing Your power to Your disciples:
For You redeem the world from transgression.
Therefore we cry out to You: Lord of compassion, save our souls!

commemoration.title: Glorification of Venerable Herman of Alaska, Wonderworker of All America

value.text:
O Christ our God,
You were transfigured in glory on Mount Tabor,
showing Your disciples the splendor of Your Godhead;
enlighten us also with the light of Your knowledge
and guide us in the path of Your commandments,
for You alone are good and the Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: Glorification of Venerable Herman of Alaska, Wonderworker of All America

value.text:
Holy Father Herman,
because of your deeds and example,
we remember today the great teachers and ascetics.
Your wondrous life confounded the enemy.
You conversed with the angels!
Together with them, pray for the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
When You were transfigured before Your Crucifixion, Lord,
the mountain became as heaven
and a cloud spread itself out like a canopy
and the Father bore witness to You.
There were present Peter with James and John,
since they were to be with You at Your betrayal,
that seeing Your wonders they might not be dismayed at Your sufferings.
Grant in Your great mercy
that we too may be counted worthy to venerate Your sufferings in peace!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Let the assembly of all on earth and in heaven
come to praise Christ our God,
the Lord of both the living and the dead.
For when He was divinely transfigured on Tabor
as the Savior of our souls
it was His good pleasure to have beside Him
the leaders and preachers of both the law and grace.

commemoration.title: Martyr and Archdeacon Euplus of Catania

value.text:
Clad in a purple robe dyed in your blood, glorious one,
and crowned with the wreath of victory by the hand of the Creator of life,
you dwell in the heavens, reigning with the compassionate one.
Therefore, we call you blessed:
You are a true martyr and a servant of the Word,
the confirmation of the faith!

commemoration.title: Martyr and Archdeacon Euplus of Catania

value.text:
As a minister of the mysteries of the Master,
the wondrous Euplus brought himself forward like an innocent lamb.
He was beheaded with the sword,
becoming a divine lamb and sweet smelling sacrifice.
Therefore, we who love the martyrs call him blessed,
celebrating his hallowed suffering today in a holy manner!

commemoration.title: Martyr and Archdeacon Euplus of Catania

value.text:
You crossed worthily the sea of suffering,
your sail filled with the breath of the Spirit;
you made your way to the calm haven of the Kingdom of God
where you have received a rich reward for you pains.
You stand with the angels, blessed one,
before the Master of creation.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
The shining cloud of the Transfiguration
has replaced the darkness of the law!
Moses and Elijah were counted worthy of this glory, brighter than the light.
Taken up in it, they spoke to God, saying:
You are our God, the King of the ages!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
We honor you, Maximus, our father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Conversor with the angels,
companion of the venerable and righteous ones!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Let us draw near with eager steps,
ascending Mount Tabor.
Let us behold the glory
of the King of all:
Christ our Redeemer!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
You appeared, my Savior,
on the mount of Tabor,
with Moses and Elijah
and Your chosen apostles
shining more than the sun!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
The sound of your teachings has gone out into all the earth,
venerable Father Maximus!
Therefore you have found the reward of your labors in the heavens.
You destroyed the hosts of demons
and reached the ranks of angels whose life you blamelessly followed!
Since you have boldness before Christ our God,
entreat peace for our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Transfiguration of our Lord

value.text:
Christ, robed in the radiance of Divinity,
You made those who ascended the mountain with You
partakers of Your supernatural glory.
Therefore they cried out in exultation:
It is good for us to be here!
With them we bless You, transfigured Savior, throughout all ages!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Let us sound the cymbals!
Let us shout aloud in hymns
acclaiming the Virgin's feast of exodus in anticipation.
Let us joyfully call out at the tomb with songs,
for the Mother of God, the golden ark
now prepares to pass over from earth to heaven
as she is translated to the divine brightness of new and divine life!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Today the company of apostles
is wondrously gathered from the ends of the earth
for the living city of Him Who is the Master of all
hastens to depart gloriously from the earth to what is higher
to join the chorus with the King, her Son.
Sing a hymn of departure at her divine burial,
together in mind with the heavenly hosts!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Come now and gather in the prefeast,
company of priests, kings and rulers,
together with the ranks of virgins!
Assemble together, all people, sending up funeral hymns!
For tomorrow the Queen of all, bound for the mansions of heaven,
will commit her soul into the hands of her Son!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Standing before the throne of God, most honored prophet,
given joy and beholding glory,
you delight in divine food, filled with spiritual gladness and joy!
Now look down upon those who celebrate your memory,
delivering them from dangers by your unceasing prayers!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Pure and most holy Virgin,
the multitude of angels in heaven and men on earth
extol and venerate your falling asleep,
for you are the Mother of Christ our God and Creator of all.
Never cease to intercede with Him on our behalf
for next to God we have put our hope in you
greatly-honored, unwedded Theotokos!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You Have Given A Sign
You showed most exalted divine knowledge,
proclaiming the high and lofty mountain:
The preaching of the Savior which would be revealed
at the top of the mountains
where the nations hasten with faith and turn with fervor
to learn the ways of the Lord.
They are saved with eternal salvation!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Micah, wondrous among the prophets,
with a divinely inspired tongue,
you prophesied the Prince Whose coming is indeed from everlasting:
He issues forth as the Shepherd of His people
coming forth from Bethlehem.
Now you behold your prophecy fulfilled,
and with divine wisdom we glorify Him about Whom you spoke!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
All earth-dwellers,
dance in the spirit!
For behold, the Virgin,
the daughter of Adam
departs for heaven.

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
The dominions and thrones,
the rulers, principalities and powers,
the cherubim and fearful seraphim,
glorify your falling asleep!
All those who dwell on earth rejoice,
adorned by your divine glory!
Kings fall down and sing with the archangels and angels:
Rejoice, full of grace,
the Lord is with you,
granting the world through you great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
The source of life is laid in the grave,
and the tomb becomes a ladder into heaven!
Rejoice, Gethsemane, the holy abode of the Theotokos!
Come, faithful,
with Gabriel leading, let us cry:
Rejoice, full of grace,
the Lord is with you,
granting the world through you great mercy!  (3 times)

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Glorious are your mysteries, pure Lady:
you were made the throne of the Most High,
and today you are translated from earth to heaven!
Your glory is full of majesty,
shining with divine brightness!
Virgins, ascend on high with the Mother of the King!
Rejoice, full of grace,
the Lord is with you,
granting the world through you great mercy!  (3 times)

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
The spotless Bride,
the Mother of Him in Whom the Father was well pleased,
she who was preordained by God
to be the dwelling place of His union of two natures without confusion
delivers today her blameless soul to her Creator and her God.
The spiritual powers receive her with divine honors,
and she who is truly the Mother of Life departs to life,
the lamp of the unapproachable Light
the salvation of the faithful and hope of our souls!

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
She who is higher than the heavens
and more glorious than the cherubim,
she who is held in greater honor than all creation,
she who by reason of her surpassing purity
became the receiver of the everlasting essence,
today commends her most pure soul into the hands of her Son.
With her all things are filled with joy and she bestows great mercy on us!

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Come, all you ends of the earth,
let us praise the most holy translation of the Mother of God:
for she has delivered her spotless soul into the hands of her Son.
Therefore the world, restored to life by her holy Dormition,
in radiant joy celebrates this feast with psalms and hymns and spiritual songs
together with the angels and the apostles.

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
It was right that the eye-witnesses and ministers of the Word
should see the Dormition of His Mother according to the flesh:
the final mystery concerning her!
So that they might be witnesses not only to the Ascension of the Savior,
but also to the translation of her who gave Him birth!
Assembled from all parts by divine power, they came to Zion,
and sped on her way to heaven the Virgin who is higher than the cherubim.
We also venerate her, for she prays for our souls.

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Sing, people!  Sing the praises of the Mother of our God:
for today she delivers her soul, full of light,
into the immaculate hands of Him Who was made incarnate of her without seed.
And she entreats Him without ceasing
to grant the earth peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Come, people, let us sing the praises of the pure and most holy Virgin
from whom the Word of the Father ineffably came forth in the flesh!
Let us cry aloud and say:
Blessed are you among women
and blessed is the womb that held Christ!
Having delivered your soul into His holy hands
most pure one, entreat Him to save our souls.

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Pure and most holy Virgin,
the multitude of angels in heaven and mankind on earth
extol and venerate your falling asleep,
for you are the Mother of Christ our God and Creator of all.
Never cease to intercede with Him on our behalf
for next to God we have put our hope in you,
greatly-honored, unwedded Theotokos!

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Come, people, let us sing today to Christ our God a song of David!
The virgins that follow her, he said, shall be brought to the King.
With joy and gladness shall they be brought!
For she, through whom we have been made Godlike, is of the seed of David,
and gloriously and ineffably commends herself into the hands of her own Son and Master!
Praising her as the Mother of God
we cry out to her and say:
Save us from all distress and tribulation
For we confess you to be the Theotokos!

commemoration.title: The Dormition of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
At your departing, Virgin Theotokos
to Him Who was ineffably born of you,
James the first bishop and brother of the Lord was there,
and so was Peter, the honored leader and chief of the disciples,
and the whole sacred fellowship of the apostles.
In discourses that showed forth heavenly things
they sang the praises of the divine mystery of the dispensation of Christ,
and they rejoiced, greatly-venerated Virgin,
as they buried your body.
On high the most holy angelic powers bowed in wonder,
saying to one another:
Open wide your gates and receive her who bore the Creator of heaven and earth!
So we too cry out to you, gracious Lady:
Raise up all Christian people and save our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
How shall we creatures of dust look upon Your image, Word?
How shall we, polluted in sin, dare to gaze upon the face of our sinless God?
How shall we, paralyzed in corruption,
come before the unapproachable One?
The cherubim veil their faces, not daring to look upon You;
the seraphim who carry You cannot gaze upon Your glory!
In fear they serve You, Creator!
Do not condemn us, merciful Christ,
for we embrace Your image in faith.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
With what eyes shall we earth-dwellers gaze upon Your image, O Christ?
The hosts of angels cannot look upon it without fear;
it flashes with rays of divine lightning.
It triumphs over the assaults of godlessness today.
It sojourns among a royal priesthood, a pious people.
Its coming brings joy to all Orthodox Christians,
who fall before it in faith and fear!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
The praiseworthy day of the Master has come again!
He Who is enthroned on high now looks down upon us,
through the eyes of His most pure image.
He Who is above the cherubim, upon Whom none may gaze,
is made visible, as the scriptures say,
to those with whom He shares His own likeness,
for You wondrously fashioned us in Your image,
by the most pure finger of the Father,
and by worshipping You in faith, we are made pure.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Jesus, your Son and our God, Theotokos,
confirming His two natures,
dies as a Man and arises as God!
It was His good pleasure, Mother of God,
that you also die lest unbelievers consider His dispensation a fantasy!
You were translated to the Kingdom of heaven, celestial Bride
taken up from the earth as from your dwelling chamber.
The air was sanctified by your passage
as the earth was illumined by your giving of birth.
The apostles send you forth and the angels bear you up.
As they buried your all-pure body, singing funeral hymns for you
they gazed in awe and spoke with fear:
This change is from the right hand of the Most High,
for He dwelt within you,
and you shall never be shaken!
All-hymned Mother, do not cease to watch over us,
for we are your people and the sheep of your pasture:
We call on your name,
asking salvation and great mercy for your sake.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You became incarnate as You willed, Lord:
You desired to assume our poverty
to show forth the riches of compassion,
by which You have deified me, who am dust!
We glorify You, Lover of mankind,
as we gaze upon the image of Your countenance.
Grant Your servants unhindered entry into Eden, Savior,
overlooking all our transgressions.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Martyr, when the enemy flogged you with thongs of hide,
destroying your holy flesh with constant lashings,
you turned your gaze to Christ, the contest's Judge.
He stretched out His hand of divine might to you!
Therefore, having completed the race,
you received great honors, all-courageous athlete Myron!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
When the shameful enemy strove with flatteries
to sway you from your intention,
adorned with courage you opposed him steadfastly!
You endured the pains which brought you to a painless rest:
To the Kingdom of heaven and everlasting delight,
all-praised Martyr Myron!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
When the conflagration set by the godless was consuming every land
you were set ablaze, blessed one, by the burning of the Spirit.
You preached the Word, Who in His goodness,
wrapped himself in flesh taken from the divine Virgin Maiden!
Therefore, strengthened by the might of grace,
you endured fire, torments and cruel persecutions.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Touching the relics of the holy martyrs Florus and Laurus,
you draw grace and receive enlightenment, gladness and mercy,
for the divine work of healing richly flows from them!
Let us bless them as favorites of the Lord,
earnestly cry out: Glory to You, our God!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You were imprisoned in a pit and buried in the earth
at the command of the tyrant.
By divine speech and the revelation of the Holy Spirit
you have been revealed to us
as stars shining with portents, wonders and gifts of healing,
brother athletes and fellow citizens with the angels!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Come, people, let us sing the praises of the pure and most holy Virgin
from whom the Word of the Father ineffably came forth in the flesh!
Let us cry aloud and say:
Blessed are you among women
and blessed is the womb that held Christ!
Having delivered your soul into His holy hands
most pure one, entreat Him to save our souls.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You Have Given A Sign
Revealed as perfect stones cut by martyrdom
and quarried by torments, holy ones,
you fashioned yourselves into a church of the Lord,
casting the temples and worship of the idols down to the ground!
Therefore, we call them blest as inhabitants of Paradise;
offerings of the temple of heaven.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
At your departing, Virgin Theotokos
to Him Who was ineffably born of you,
James, the first bishop and brother of the Lord was there,
and so was Peter, the honored leader and chief of the disciples,
and the whole sacred fellowship of the apostles.
In discourses that showed forth heavenly things
they sang the praises of the divine mystery of the dispensation of Christ,
and they rejoiced, greatly-venerated Virgin,
as they buried your body.
On high the most holy angelic powers bowed in wonder,
saying to one another:
Open wide your gates and receive her who bore the Creator of heaven and earth!
So we too cry out to you, gracious Lady:
Raise up all Christian people and save our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You are manifested as the namesake of courage!
You struggled valiantly, engaging the enemy.
You destroyed him as another Pharaoh,
engulfing his whole army in the streams of your blood!
Therefore, truly wondrous one,
pray that God may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Glorious one, you brought a great army
to God the Giver of all good.
They struggled and together with you,
through death have found undying glory!
Pray with them, all-glorious one,
that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You were revealed as a model of courage!
You dared to go before the assembly
to give yourself over to the arena of suffering.
You went there as a general, most wealthy martyr Andrew.
You ever pour the water of healings upon the faithful,
for you receive grace from the heavens.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Samuel, she who gave birth to you,
received you as a worthy fruit of prayer!
As she had promised, with her maternal hands
she gave you, a rightly acceptable gift,
to God her benefactor!
Therefore the grace of the Spirit rested upon you, glorious one,
causing you to grow in innocence,
and adorning you with wisdom!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You were invested as a priest with sacred chrism
and revealed to be a prophet who foresaw things to come!
At the command of God, you foretold the future and anointed a king.
You judged with justice the people of Israel
who ever sinned and withdrew themselves from their God,
truly-wondrous Samuel, the blessed bearer of God!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Putting aside the gloom and weight of the flesh
you now behold him who you desired,
not in a mirror darkly or in shadows, as before,
but face to face!
You rejoice as you go about the heavens, most honored prophet,
peer of the other prophets of God,
conversor with the righteous and sharer in the portion of the angels!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Come, let us keep the feast shared by all the world,
of the Dormition of the all-pure Theotokos!
Today angels celebrate the sacred translation of the Mother of God,
summoning us earth-born mortals to the festivity,
that we may cry out with ceaseless voices:
Rejoice, for you have been translated from the earth,
and changed your abode to the heavenly mansions!
Rejoice, for you have brought together the choir of apostles
through a bright cloud!
Rejoice, our hope and protection!
For we, the Christian people, never cease to bless you!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Blessed Apostle Thaddeus,
after the divine and light-bearing Resurrection of Christ
and the all-holy Ascension to heaven,
you were entrusted with the divine proclamation of the Gospel
in the city of Edessa.
When you arrived there, by words and the divine image of Christ,
you firmly established Abgar in the truth,
together with the people under him.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Blessed Apostle Thaddeus,
having partaken of the highest Light,
you were truly a second light through divine participation!
You dispelled the night of idolatry,
leading souls to the sovereign God of all.
Therefore, we rejoice in honoring your brilliant memory as we glorify Christ.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You were a fountain adorned with wisdom,
pouring forth life-giving words!
You converted the foolish and shamed the tyrant emperor,
destroying the worship of many idols!
You strengthened the faithful to remain steadfast in the grace of God!
You were cruelly burned,
as you hastened to ascend with your crown to the Kingdom on high!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
It was right that the eye-witnesses and ministers of the Word
should see the Dormition of His Mother according to the flesh:
The final mystery concerning her!
So that they might be witnesses not only of the Ascension of the Savior,
but also to the translation of her who gave Him birth.
Assembled from all parts by divine power, they came to Zion,
and sped on her way to heaven the Virgin who is higher than the cherubim.
We also venerate her, for she prays for our souls.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
You stood before the Master,
covered with the blood of your terrible contest:
A pure offering and sweet-smelling sacrifice,
an acceptable gift, a holy oblation,
an unblemished burnt offering!
Therefore, by your prayers, great athlete Agathonicus,
preserve the fullness of the Church in peace!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Dormition of the Mother of God

value.text:
Searching, Agathonicus, for the original goodness,
and the beauty that lies beyond understanding,
you rejoiced as you hastened to the noble struggles before you!
You wrestled with the enemy,
and with virtue, cast him to the ground!
You wove for your head a splendid wreath of victory!
Now you pray to the Lover of Mankind for those who sing your praise.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Eutyches, disciple of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
Blessed Martyr Eutychus,
you were trained in holiness by the honored disciple:
The Theologian and Preacher of the Word!
You were taught the whole of his most sacred revelation,
and were revealed yourself to be a light,
illumining every mind by grace through your sacred theology.
Therefore we honor your holy memory!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Eutyches, disciple of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
When you were locked in a dungeon,
you received the heavenly bread of life!
When you were thrown into the flames, glorious one,
you remained unharmed!
You submitted to cruelly inflicted beatings,
taming the raging of wild beasts by your prayers!
When you were beheaded by the sword,
you were taken up into heaven as by the chariot of God!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Eutyches, disciple of Saint John the Theologian

value.text:
Wholly blessed one,
you tore down the fortress of error with the weapon of firm patience!
You endured imprisonment and a glorious death;
therefore you received immortality!
You dwell with the choirs of martyrs and the ranks of angels;
you are fully deified in a godly manner,
perfectly partaking in the higher communion!

commemoration.title: Return of the Relics of the Apostle Bartholomew from Anastasiopolis to Lipari

value.text:
Your mind was illumined with divine brilliance, Titus,
as you journeyed with the divine Paul!
You were a ray of the sun enlightening those in darkness.
With him you freed the whole earth from the deepest night!
Therefore we call you blessed, as a God-chosen bishop,
an inspired apostle and most fervent intercessor!

commemoration.title: Return of the Relics of the Apostle Bartholomew from Anastasiopolis to Lipari

value.text:
Apostle Bartholomew,
you forsook the things of the earth and followed after Christ.
You were marked by the inspiration of the Holy Spirit
being sent by Him to perishing nations
turning the people to the light of the knowledge of God!
You completed the godly exploits of your suffering.
you endured different tortures,
and surrendered your soul to Christ.
Entreat Him, most blessed one,
