commemoration.title: Martyr Callistratus and 49 companions

value.text:
Divinely wise martyr Callistratus,
enriched by the word of life, you guided to life
those who once were dead in the curse through ignorance!
They died with zeal, glorious one, for the Resurrection of us all!
Truly we believe they dwell with Christ:
Together with them, remember us to the all-good Lord!

commemoration.title: Martyr Callistratus and 49 companions

value.text:
Martyred athlete Callistratus,
your mind illumined by the light of piety,
you unwaveringly trod the path to heavenly blessedness,
conquering all the snares of the enemy!
Therefore we praise you, honoring your sacred memory,
most blessed one!

commemoration.title: Venerable Chariton the Confessor, Abbot of Palestine

value.text:
By abstinence and fervent prayer, venerable Chariton,
you caused your body's passions to wither.
With streams of tears you drowned the deceitful serpent, blessed one.
In great measure you were well-pleasing to God!
Therefore Jesus, the Lover of mankind and the Savior of our souls,
has adorned you with heavenly gifts!

commemoration.title: Venerable Chariton the Confessor, Abbot of Palestine

value.text:
God-bearing Chariton,
even after death, in Christ you live in the heavens!
For His sake you crucified yourself to the world,
for you were above the world and the flesh,
truly living, transcending all visible things!
Yet you did not live for yourself alone,
but Christ our God dwelt within you!
Entreat Him that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Chariton the Confessor, Abbot of Palestine

value.text:
You fled, most sacred and blessed Chariton,
withdrawing into the mountains and deserts.
Preserving your soul undefiled,
you were revealed to be a dwelling of the Trinity,
in Whose power you founded holy dwellings, blessed one:
Monasteries for the building up and salvation
of monastics who honor your holy memory.

commemoration.title: Venerable Chariton the Confessor, Abbot of Palestine

value.text:
With the sweat of your struggle, truly wondrous one,
you quenched the burning fire of the passions!
You partook of fire through your wounds and sufferings,
confessing the condescension of the incarnate Word before evil tyrants!
You were a witness for Him, adorned with wounds from your manifold torments,
most wealthy, God-bearing Chariton!

commemoration.title: Venerable Kyriakos the Anchorite

value.text:
Bearing the Cross upon your shoulders,
you followed after Christ.
With unrelenting thought, you turned away from the pleasures of life;
you killed the passions of the flesh with intense vigils and prayers,
receiving the grace to heal infirmities, venerable one.
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Kyriakos the Anchorite

value.text:
You curbed the passions with the bridle of abstinence,
wonderworker Cyriacus.
You clothed yourself in the radiant garment of dispassion,
uncovering all the malice of him who stripped our first parents naked in days of old!
Now you ever rejoice as you dwell in Paradise!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Kyriakos the Anchorite

value.text:
You lived in the desert, venerable Cyriacus,
having bitter herbs as your food.
You embittered your senses, uprooting the passions of your soul.
Therefore, blessed one, you lived like the angels
and have received the delight of heaven after your repose.
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Kyriakos the Anchorite

value.text:
We honor you, Cyriacus, our father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Conversor with the angels,
companion of the venerable and righteous ones!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Gregory, Bishop of Greater Armenia, Equal of the Apostles, Enlightener of Armenia

value.text:
Rhipsimia loved You, the Master of all,
the immortal Bridegroom!
She accepted the flaying of the skin of her body,
having first torn apart the dirty sackcloth of the passions by abstinence.
The ever-memorable Gaiana also struggled with her,
leading an assembly of virgins who struggled bravely,
casting down Eve's ancient deceiver!
Honoring them as they deserve, we praise You, O Christ!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Gregory, Bishop of Greater Armenia, Equal of the Apostles, Enlightener of Armenia

value.text:
Threefold waves of torture, most wise Gregory,
did not overcome your soul, glorious athlete,
nor did your long imprisonment, hidden in a gloomy pit!
You shone like light on those languishing in the darkness of emptiness,
revealing them to be children of the day through the font of baptism,
through higher rebirth and a divine and saving way of life,
as a God-pleasing bishop!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Gregory, Bishop of Greater Armenia, Equal of the Apostles, Enlightener of Armenia

value.text:
You dyed your sacred robe in the blood of your martyrdom,
hastening to enter the holy of holies, admirable Martyr,
where there is divine glory, ineffable light,
and the voices of those who feast!
There you received the reward of your labors:
an unfading crown, eternal glory
and a dwelling in paradise!
Wise Gregory, pray with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Gregory, Bishop of Greater Armenia, Equal of the Apostles, Enlightener of Armenia

value.text:
The martyr and pastor was taught the secret things of the mysteries of God,
having spiritually entered the inaccessible darkness of ineffable light,
being enlightened as a martyr and instructed as a pastor!
Therefore he was crowned with double wreaths of heavenly glory.
He ever intercedes with Christ on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Heaven and earth are sanctified,
the Church is radiant and all the people celebrate,
for behold, the Mother of God enters invisibly with the armies of the angels,
the Forerunner and the Theologian,
the prophets and the apostles!
She prays to Christ for Christians
and entreats Him to have mercy on this land and people
who glorify the feast of her protection.

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Now you stand before the Master of all
with boldness before Him, O Father.
Pray that we who celebrate your memory and splendid feast
may be delivered from misfortunes and dangers,
divinely blessed Romanus!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Today the powers of heaven rejoice with us
and the souls of the just are spiritually assembled
to behold the Queen and Mother glorified by the faithful!
They witness the vision of the Mother of God,
her arms outstretched upon the clouds in prayer,
entreating peace for the world,
strength for Orthodox Christians and salvation for our souls!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
The musical harp of the divine Spirit, the flute of the Church,
the nightingale, the cicada, chanting the hymns of God,
places his melodious compositions before us all,
gladdening those who are wise in God!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
You are like a divinely planted paradise, Theotokos,
the place where the tree of life was watered by the Holy Spirit!
We acknowledge that you gave birth to the Creator of all
Who feeds the faithful with the bread of life.
Together with the Forerunner, entreat Him on our behalf
and by your precious veil protect your people from all attacks!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
The most radiant and shining lampstand,
the sweetly-sounding harp
which has as strings the words of the Spirit, true in meaning,
sings and teaches openly to the ends of the earth
with never-ceasing hymns glorifying the brightness of God!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
People, let us joyfully sing a song of David
to the Handmaiden and Bride of God,
the Mother of Christ, the King of all:
Master, at Your right hand stood the Queen,
decked in robes of gold
and adorned in divine apparel.
When she, the chosen among women
had been made more beautiful than all the world,
You were pleased to be born of her in Your great mercy.
You have given her, the only blessed one,
to Your people as a helper,
to guide and protect them from all tribulation!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
You are a mountain greater and more glorious than Sinai, Theotokos!
Sinai could not bear the descent of God's glory in images and figures:
It caught fire and there was thunder and lightning!
but at the command of Him Who encompasses all,
you bore in your womb the divine Fire Himself without being consumed,
the Word of God Who holds all in the palm of His hand.
As His Mother you have boldness to approach Him,
therefore, Lady, help those who keep your holy feast in faith.
In your mercy, do not forget to visit us,
for you received the gift from God
of guiding and protecting your servants, the Christian flock.

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
Since you are higher than all in heaven and on earth,
more glorious than the cherubim and most honored of all creation,
Christ has given you to Christians as defender and protector.
Therefore we sing to you, Lady and refuge of all,
and we celebrate with joy the holy feast of your protection.
Pray to Christ that He may grant us great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
The Church of God is adorned as with a shining crown
by your precious veil, Theotokos!
Today she shines with joy,
celebrating mystically and crying to you:
Rejoice, precious raiment and crown of the glory of God!
Rejoice, only fulfillment of glory and eternal joy!
Rejoice, haven of those who run to you,
our deliverer and our salvation!

commemoration.title: The Protection of our Most Holy Lady the Mother of God and Ever-Virgin Mary

value.text:
You showed yourself to be the first-fruits of good works,
a starting-point of salvation,
for composing angelic Songs, Romanus our father,
you revealed your life to be divine.
Entreat Christ God that He may deliver those who hymn you
from dangers and tribulations!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina, and Martyr Theoctistus, of Nicomedia

value.text:
Most blessed Cyprian,
you turned aside indeed from the falsehood and lore of idolatrous teaching!
You armed yourself for salvation with the sword of the Cross,
throwing away the books of sorcery
as you put off the old man!
The knowledge of the consubstantial Trinity lived within you!
With the angels, ever beseech Him, Bishop, that we may be saved!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina, and Martyr Theoctistus, of Nicomedia

value.text:
Most honorable Cyprian,
glory of athletes and crown of martyrs:
By your sermons you persuaded the divinely wise
to maintain their courage most valiantly
in the face of imprisonment, bondage and varied tortures,
nakedness, binding and bitter cold,
with wounding and death at the end.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina, and Martyr Theoctistus, of Nicomedia

value.text:
Through the anointing of the priesthood
and the blood of martyrdom,
you drew near to God, most perfect and all-glorious Cyprian!
You are the flower of nature;
the adornment of preaching,
the summit of wisdom and a rule of true dogmas,
a harmoniser of the canons:
You are the splendor of the churches!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina, and Martyr Theoctistus, of Nicomedia

value.text:
You are the splendor of virgins and martyrs, Justina!
You opposed the spells of demons with hymns to the Spirit!
By the sign of the Cross,
you preserved your virginity,
offering yourself to Christ as a most holy sacrifice!
You are an unconquered martyr,
receiving the crowns of victory!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Cyprian, Virgin Martyr Justina, and Martyr Theoctistus, of Nicomedia

value.text:
Let us praise Cyprian,
the divinely shining lamp,
the converser with Paul and sharer of his labors!
He dwells with the angels;
having received an incorruptible crown from the one God.
He ever prays that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Dionysius the Areopagite, Bishop of Athens

value.text:
The divine Paul, speaking out in public,
fished for you with the hook of grace, wise one!
Seeing in you a chosen vessel,
he made you a teacher of the sacred mysteries;
a beholder of ineffable things!
Pray together with him, truly eloquent Dionysius,
that those who hymn you with love may be saved!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Dionysius the Areopagite, Bishop of Athens

value.text:
Making yourself, as far as you were able, like God through meditation,
blessed Dionysius,
you mystically wrote your godly treatise on divine names with piety.
Achieving unity through a higher union,
you learned things that pass man's understanding,
teaching to the ends of the earth!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Dionysius the Areopagite, Bishop of Athens

value.text:
Come, let us the faithful
praise the annual celebration of the hierarch Dionysius, with Cyprian!
When Dionysius had rejected the stoic philosophers,
he became an initiate of the gnostic hidden mysteries.
But enlightened by the holy virgin Justina,
he fled the treachery of demons!
After destroying books of sorcery,
he became a herald of the Gospel!
Therefore, as we sinners celebrate their glory,
we give glory to the Savior:
Christ God, You crowned your victors with glory:
Through their supplications, save our souls!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Dionysius the Areopagite, Bishop of Athens

value.text:
For the sake of virtue, most wise Father Dionysius,
you made your mind equal to the angels!
You wrote a sacred account of the heavenly order of their hierarchies,
aligning the Church's ranks with theirs,
likening them to the hosts of heaven!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Dionysius the Areopagite, Bishop of Athens

value.text:
We call you the unseen depth of heavenly knowledge,
most splendid martyr of Christ!
We hymn you as a warrior and steadfast champion of the Church, wise one,
for you shone with most pure fire!
You were counted worthy to wear the garment of light with the armies on high,
having enlightened your mind with the radiance of the Holy Spirit, Dionysius!
Therefore with faith we celebrate your universal memorial,
glorifying the Lord Who glorified you!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul the Simple of Egypt

value.text:
Wondrous Paul, how like the angels you lived!
How you humbled your soul like a child!
How you frustrated all the powers of hell!
Your patience was ineffable, your struggles were glorious!
Venerable one, entreat Christ God
for those who honor your holy memory with love!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul the Simple of Egypt

value.text:
Wise Paul, your obedience was wonderful!
Borne aloft by it, as on wings, you took flight in your spirit,
reaching even the heavens where you now dwell in blessedness.
Ever pray to Christ God
for those who honor your holy memory with love!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul the Simple of Egypt

value.text:
With Christ dwelling in your soul, venerable one,
you boldly said to Him:
I shall remain unmoved on this place, Jesus my Savior,
until You listen to me!
You received the fulfillment of your petition instantly,
driving out an unclean spirit with authority!
Pray, most marvelous wonder-worker,
for us who honor your holy memory with love!

commemoration.title: Venerable Paul the Simple of Egypt

value.text:
Heeding the Master's voice within your soul,
forsaking the world,
you ran after Him in imitation of the angels, blessed one,
dwelling in the desert as one of the bodiless hosts,
imitating Christ Himself in obedience!
Therefore, most wise one, you found repayment one hundred-fold and eternal life!
Intercede for our souls!

commemoration.title: Glorification of Saint Innocent, Metropolitan of Moscow, Enlightener of the Aleuts, Apostle to the Americas

value.text:
With what crowns of praise
shall we adorn the wise apostle of our land?
He came boldly to enlighten an island people,
sitting in darkness and ignorance,
with the radiant Gospel of salvation!
by planting there the Orthodox faith
he brought them great mercy from Christ our God.

commemoration.title: Glorification of Saint Innocent, Metropolitan of Moscow, Enlightener of the Aleuts, Apostle to the Americas

value.text:
With what songs of praise
shall we now bless Innocent, our teacher wise in God?
As the first archpastor to rule our land,
he has taught us by his words and deeds
the way we must go to attain to the glorious kingdom
won and promised to us by Christ our God
Who grants us great mercy!

commemoration.title: Glorification of Saint Innocent, Metropolitan of Moscow, Enlightener of the Aleuts, Apostle to the Americas

value.text:
With what songs of virtue
shall we exalt our Father Innocent?
In the distant reaches of Alaska and Siberia,
he brought heathen worship to an end by his word!
Like the holy apostle Paul before him,
bound in chains of obedience to the will of God,
he brought comfort to the faithful in the land of Russia
who through his prayers and teaching
receive great mercy from Christ our God!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Apostle Thomas

value.text:
Most blessed Thomas,
for the godly-minded you are a fountain of divine knowledge:
You have touched the side of the Master of all:
An act of boldness taught you that He is two natures in one Person.
You cried out: You are both my Master and my eternal God!
The Lord of glory Who took flesh for my sake.

commemoration.title: Martyrs Sergius and Bacchus in Syria

value.text:
The army of the martyrs of Christ
has been strengthened against the enemy.
Among them Sergius and Bacchus shine like stars:
The all glorious and excellent athletes!
The evil host of demons was forced into flight by them;
by them tyrants were amazed and angels astonished,
beholding the bodiless enemy trampled underfoot by bodily men!
Celebrating their feast with universal joy,
the Church of the faithful cries out:
As You bound the mighty one by the weakness of the flesh;
through the prayers of Your saints, save our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Pelagia the Penitent

value.text:
As the apostle teaches,
where sin abounded, grace abounded all the more:
For with prayers and tears, Pelagia,
you dried up the sea of your many falls.
Through repentance, you presented an offering well-pleasing to the Lord,
and now you intercede with Him for our souls.

commemoration.title: Glorification of Saint Tikhon, Patriarch of Moscow and All Russia, Enlightener of North America

value.text:
Divinely-inspired teacher of the mysteries, Father Tikhon,
we know you as a foundation of truth, confirmation of the faith, expounder of piety,
abode of purity, elect vessel, fragrance of the Spirit, truly great treasury of teachings,
and a foundation of the Church of Christ in the Russian lands and North America.

commemoration.title: Glorification of Saint Tikhon, Patriarch of Moscow and All Russia, Enlightener of North America

value.text:
We give glory to you, all-praised God-bearer Tikhon,
successor to the apostles and of like character with the martyrs,
zealous emulator of ascetics, seal of teachers, divine model,
expounder of the mysteries of Christ!
You are a river overflowing with holy understanding,
drowning the intentions of blasphemers and transgressors,
truly wise, new confessor Tikhon!

commemoration.title: Glorification of Saint Tikhon, Patriarch of Moscow and All Russia, Enlightener of North America

value.text:
You increased the talent of wisdom truly rich one
and were granted the joy of your Lord.
You were adorned with the grace of divine radiance
and your understanding shone with spiritual radiance.
Now you stand at the right hand of Christ, the Bearer of life,
eternally illumined, glorious new confessor Tikhon!

commemoration.title: Apostle James, son of Alphaeus

value.text:
By receiving the grace of the Holy Spirit, James,
you were numbered with the holy choir of apostles;
for a mighty wind descended from heaven,
and a fiery tongue breathed upon you,
with which you burned away the thorns of the nations' godlessness.
Pray to Christ God, as His preacher,
that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Eulampius and Eulampia, at Nicomedia, and 200 Martyrs with them

value.text:
Since the likeness of your names was combined with fraternal love,
and your purity united with freedom from passions,
you preserved unharmed the good strength of your will,
for where God is loved, the world is set at naught.
Wonder!  The serpent is put to death!
The devil is cast down by the brother and sister martyrs,
Eulampius the wise and Eulampia.
Let us cry out to them with spiritual songs:
Since you have finished well your course in Christ,
entreat peace for the world, and great mercy for our souls.

commemoration.title: Martyrs Eulampius and Eulampia, at Nicomedia, and 200 Martyrs with them

value.text:
The two who were made radiant by the light of the Trinity
were a brother and sister who cast down the cruelty of the tyrant!
As they trampled the flames underfoot, they danced and sang:
Behold, how good and pleasant it is
when brethren dwell in unity!
As they gazed steadfastly into heaven,
they were granted divine glory by Christ our God.
They ever intercede that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Apostle Philip of the Seventy, One of the Seven Deacons

value.text:
Philip, the people marveled,
when they beheld the divine signs wrought by your hand where they lived:
The recovery of sight by the blind,
the healing of the lame,
the expulsion of unclean spirits!
They came to you for spiritual cleansing,
brought suddenly from unbelief to faith!
When they heard of this, the choir of the apostles rejoiced,
for a multitude of Samaritans was led to God!

commemoration.title: Apostle Philip of the Seventy, One of the Seven Deacons

value.text:
You were yourself a chariot of God,
divinely-eloquent one!
As you beheld the wondrous eunuch of the Candace riding in a chariot,
questioning and in doubt,
you overtook him and revealed to him
the word and revelation of what he desired!
He believed, blessed one,
and asked divine cleansing of you.
When he received it, the Creator of all made him a divine preacher:
The first among martyrs of all Ethiopia!

commemoration.title: Apostle Philip of the Seventy, One of the Seven Deacons

value.text:
Blessed Philip,
you were filled with wisdom and divine grace
and numbered among the seven deacons:
You were chosen with Stephen to minister to the needs of the saints!
When you beheld him killed, glorious one,
you hastened to Samaria at the command of God,
preaching God's word and enlightening those that were in darkness,
whom you made children of the day, most wise one,
through the Holy Spirit of God!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
You traveled the narrow path with an untroubled spirit,
aiming for the things which lead to life!
You are the boast of ascetics, Euthymius,
steadfastly trampling the pursuing demons.
Therefore you were counted worthy to be an heir of the kingdom of heaven
where you delight in unending beauty!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
Your radiant light astonished the angels
and openly alarmed the savage demons!
You adorned the assemblies of faithful with splendor,
ever directing them to the heavenly dwelling of Christ!
Entreat Him that those who celebrate your most honored memory with faith
may be delivered from corruption and misfortunes.

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
The bosom of the sea received you, glorious one,
and like Jonah of old, gave you over to the dry land.
With the help of wild beasts you gained an honorable burial!
You are a divine source of healings, a chosen prince of martyrs,
the foundation of the church and intercessor for our souls,
most glorious God-bearer!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
The sound of your teachings has gone out into all the earth,
venerable Father!
Therefore you have found the reward of your labors in the heavens.
You destroyed the hosts of demons
and reached the ranks of angels whose life you blamelessly followed!
Since you have boldness before Christ our God,
entreat peace for our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
You strengthened the faithful, enriching their faith,
discoursing on the knowledge of God,
that they might endure the rage of the tyrant with boldness
for the sake of the incorruptible life to come!
Therefore today we call you blessed, glorious Lucian,
as we celebrate your divine solemnity.

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
You endured a long imprisonment and violent death, venerable one.
You were tied with ropes and flayed, blessed one.
Weakened by long thirst and cruel starvation,
you openly received heavenly food.
You were an invincible martyr, valiant athlete of Christ!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
Father, you brought psalms and hymns to Christ daily,
while you lived in the desert.
You offered up your soul and mind to the one God like Moses the great,
ascending to the impassable heights of holiness!
You vanquished the bodiless enemy,
becoming a pure habitation and instrument of the divine spirit!

commemoration.title: Venerable Euthymius the New of Thessalonica, and Monk of Mount Athos

value.text:
Venerable Father,
you gave no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids,
until you freed your soul and body of the passions,
preparing yourself as a dwelling of the Holy Spirit.
For Christ, coming with the Father, made his abode with you;
you became a favorite of the consubstantial Trinity!
Great preacher Euthymius, pray for our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Longinus the Centurion, who stood at the Cross of the Lord

value.text:
Longinus the Centurian
saw the Temple torn asunder at your passion, O Christ.
He proclaimed you to be the Son of God to the Jews.
He was beheaded, and cast out on a dung heap.
A woman who found him there had her vision restored.
With her, we cry out to You, as You crowned him in his contest:
By his intercessions illumine the eyes of our hearts
that we may glorify You as God crucified for us.

commemoration.title: Prophet Hosea

value.text:
The Holy Spirit Who proceeds from the Father,
through your tongue spoke of the coming of Christ
which would come to pass in later times
for the restoration of creation!
Prophet, as we now behold the fulfillment of what was prophesied,
we honor your memory!

commemoration.title: Prophet Hosea

value.text:
Divinely eloquent Prophet,
we see your words now filled with grace!
As you stand before the God of all,
pray for all who celebrate your memory with faith,
asking forgiveness of sins, peace and great mercy for their souls!

commemoration.title: Prophet Hosea

value.text:
Lover of mankind, You took our nature as Your bride,
although it had willfully fallen away from You.
You delivered it from defilement,
joining it inseparably to Yourself through an ineffable union.
Your prophet was an image of this,
chastely taking a former harlot to wife!

commemoration.title: Prophet Hosea

value.text:
Raised on the dogmas of the apostles, blessed one,
and the teachings of the divine fathers,
you venerated the visible image of the incarnate God in sacred symbols
and in honorable icons.
Therefore you suffered for them, glorious one:
You were revealed to be a teacher of piety and the adornment of martyrs!

commemoration.title: Prophet Hosea

value.text:
You united yourself to the Lord from childhood, blessed one,
running your course to the end!
Armed with the Cross, you set your hand to the plow,
following the commandments of the Lord as it is written!
Entreat Him that those who celebrate your most honored memory with faith
may be delivered from corruption and tribulation.

commemoration.title: Prophet Hosea

value.text:
Through faith you became a precious stone that was not broken,
but beaten and rolled upon the ground,
you made smooth the path of faith, glorious one,
so that it is easy to climb, O Father.
You overturned the opinions and evil fame of Copronymus
for they were a rotten foundation!

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Luke

value.text:
What shall we call you, God-inspired speaker?
A faithful steward of the mysteries of Christ?
A servant of the divine tent not made with human hands,
perfected in the fullness of time by the Builder of wisdom?
He entrusted to you the new law of grace,
inscribed in Zion on tablets hewn from the rock of love:
Faithful witness, pray to Him that our souls may be saved.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Luke

value.text:
Apostle of Christ,
compiler of divine dogmas and foundation of the Church.
You were the attendant and imitator of Paul, the vessel of election.
By wisdom you have rescued us from the turmoil of ignorance,
for our hearts were in the depths of destruction.
Therefore we beseech you:
Most admirable Luke, the pride of Antioch,
pray to our Savior and God,
for those who celebrate your most honorable memory in faith.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Luke

value.text:
What shall we call you, Apostle?
Heaven, for you have made an account of the glory of God for us?
Lightning, for you illumine the world with radiance?
A cloud, for you rain down in a torrent the knowledge of God?
A chalice pouring the rich wine of wisdom to gladden our hearts?
Pray to the Lord that He may save our souls.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Luke

value.text:
What shall we call you, glorious one?
The treasury of heavenly gifts?
The steadfast physician of our souls and bodies?
The fellow-laborer of Paul and his companion in travel and hardship?
The author of the Acts of the Apostles.
Luke, your exceeding goodness has won for you measureless praise:
Pray to the Lord that He may save our souls.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Luke

value.text:
How shall we address you, chosen of God?
A river, flowing forth to us from Paradise?
The ark of the new covenant ratified by Christ our God?
The illuminator, made radiant by the never-setting light?
The lampstand enlightening the Church?
Your words are the bread of life, the divine table, the cup of joy?
Pray to the Lord that He may save our souls.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Luke

value.text:
All-wise Apostle,
faithful laborer of the Savior,
witness of the triumph of His Passion,
you have completed the race, you have kept the faith,
harvesting the peoples from the darkness of error,
offering us as a sweet-smelling oblation to the heavenly King.
Now you stand before the Judge of all:
Pray that He may rescue us from our sins
and deliver us from eternal death,
when He comes in glory on the day of judgment.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Luke

value.text:
Grace is poured out upon your lips like a tongue of fire:
You received the Word of light, Apostle Luke!
You proclaimed salvation for those who longed to be made children of light,
writing and teaching the holy Gospel in the fragrance of truth;
compiling faithfully the deeds and words of Paul, your teacher.
Your holy writings are powerful weapons of light!
Through them we pierce the darkness of evil:
Pray that we may love the Light of all,
that delivered from the corruption of death,
we may be granted peace, eternal light and great mercy.

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr Artemius at Antioch

value.text:
Your relics, glorious one, ever pour the grace of healing
on those who love you,
drowning passions and infirmities, Artemius,
putting to flight legions of evil demons.
They water the hearts of the faithful,
causing the divine fruits of the virtues to spring forth,
together with the knowledge of true worship!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr Artemius at Antioch

value.text:
Let us honor Artemius,
the spiritual beacon of faith,
for he denounced the evil emperor
and God has robed the church with the purple of his martyr's blood!
Therefore he has received the abundant grace of healing,
curing the infirmities of those who approach his relics in faith!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr Artemius at Antioch

value.text:
You did not reject Christ, divinely wise Artemius,
nor did you sacrifice to idols
but you gave your long-suffering and tortured body to scourging
and the torments of many wounds!
You were patient as though another suffered in your place.
You awaited future rewards and immortal glory!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr Artemius at Antioch

value.text:
You were suspended from a height and mangled,
broken by stones,
you were burned on all sides by heated irons
and finally beheaded by the sword.
Yet you remained steadfast, glorious one,
for you set the foundation of your soul's house on the spiritual Rock!
Therefore you are filled with ineffable light through your victories,
joining the angels and the martyrs!

commemoration.title: Venerable Hilarion the Great

value.text:
With luminous beams of healing, glorious Father,
you brilliantly enlightened the world,
dispelling the deep darkness of infirmities!
Therefore, all acknowledge you to be another sun,
the confirmation of monastics,
guiding by the divine Spirit those who are saved!
Now we celebrate your radiant and saving memory, Hilarion,
through you receiving remission of sins.

commemoration.title: Venerable Hilarion the Great

value.text:
Bearing the wisdom of perfection from your youth,
and taking upon yourself the yoke of Christ, Hilarion,
you imitated the life of the godly Anthony,
emulating his virtue in many ways.
You wasted the flesh which chaffed at the bit like a young stallion:
Your soul needed to tame it to finish the ascetic race!
Most blessed Father and miraculous God-bearer,
ask for purification and great mercy
for those who celebrate your memory with love!

commemoration.title: Venerable Hilarion the Great

value.text:
You made the carnal passions subject to your reasonable soul
by abstinence, Father.
Adorned with wings of dispassion, venerable one,
you received the grace to heal,
to expel evil spirits and save those who turn to you.
Therefore, the choirs of monastics bless you,
rightly glorious one,
and all creation honors your struggles, Hilarion!

commemoration.title: Venerable Hilarion the Great

value.text:
You were meek of soul and heart,
wounded by divine love!
You withdrew from the turmoils of life by a holy ascent.
Armed with the weapon of the Cross
you advanced on the demons and waged war, most blessed one!
You wrought a crown of victory for yourself
and now you dwell in the splendor of the saints!
Together with them, ask for deliverance of sins for us,
peace and enlightenment!

commemoration.title: Venerable Hilarion the Great

value.text:
Filled with the Holy Spirit,
the venerable Hilarion vanquished the snares of the demons!
Armed with the Cross and rejoicing in it,
by his word he healed all sicknesses, passions of the soul
and every bodily infirmity.
Through his supplications, O Christ,
send us peace as the Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: Saint Averkios the Wonderworker, Bishop of Hieropolis, Equal of the Apostles

value.text:
With the splendors of divine teachings
you destroyed the night of polytheism, Father Abercius!
You revealed the dawn in all-glorious miracles,
making those who were in darkness children of the day!
Therefore, we all celebrate your holy memory with faith,
singing hymns to you, divinely inspired one!

commemoration.title: Saint Averkios the Wonderworker, Bishop of Hieropolis, Equal of the Apostles

value.text:
The blessed youths spurned the evil commands:
Submitting to God, they were bound, breaking the bonds of falsehood!
Rejecting worldly rank they have received the glory of perfection
which won for them the joy of the heavenly Kingdom!

commemoration.title: Saint Averkios the Wonderworker, Bishop of Hieropolis, Equal of the Apostles

value.text:
Come, people, let us earnestly hymn the witnesses of piety,
The divinely assembled regiment,
The blessed choir, the invincible company of martyrs,
The beautiful triumph of the Church of God,
The indivisible assembly,
The unvanquished army and unshakable foundation of piety!

commemoration.title: Saint Averkios the Wonderworker, Bishop of Hieropolis, Equal of the Apostles

value.text:
Cleaving wholly to God, Abercius,
you revealed yourself fulfilling the teachings of God.
You received grace from on high, venerable one,
driving away mankind’s many infirmities!
You destroyed the temples of the idols,
planting the knowledge of God
in those who languished in wretched ignorance, blessed one!

commemoration.title: Saint Averkios the Wonderworker, Bishop of Hieropolis, Equal of the Apostles

value.text:
You trained yourselves mightily for the struggles of suffering, Saints.
You hid in a cave, entreating the Lord.
With unceasing supplications you sought power and might from Him
through His wisdom and judgments as the Lover of mankind.
In a godly manner He commanded all of you to fall asleep in peace!

commemoration.title: Saint Averkios the Wonderworker, Bishop of Hieropolis, Equal of the Apostles

value.text:
You wrought a miracle, Father,
mingling wine and oil in a single vessel, preserving them in that way,
but when needed you caused them to separate by divine grace!
By your supplication you caused a gift of warm water to gush forth
healing the infirmities of those who approach you with faith
and call you blessed, Father Abercius!

commemoration.title: Saint Macarius the Roman of Mesopotamia

value.text:
Let us all, the assembly of the faithful,
now celebrate the holy feast with joy!
Let us cry out with loud voices in psalms and hymns
praising the brother of God and disciple of the Lord with faith
for he ever prays that we may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Macarius the Roman of Mesopotamia

value.text:
You were the brother and successor of Christ, the chief Shepherd,
and He put you forward among the apostles.
You loved Him for Whom you died,
and were not dismayed by torture, glorious James!
Ever pray to Him that He may save our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him

value.text:
The godly minded virgin martyrs
enkindled by the love of Christ,
did not heed the weakness of their nature.
Manifestly strengthened by the power of God
they trampled down the delusion of the enemy!
They were not afraid of the pain of torture
and did not fear the fiery furnace!

commemoration.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him

value.text:
Today with unity of mind and with hymns, faithful,
let us honor the glorious chief shepherd Arethas and his companions!
He denounced the evil one and shed his blood in confession of Christ!
Therefore a pillar of fire consumed the face of the earth
in reproof of the ungodliness of the enemy!
Therefore, Christ God, as You strengthened the athletes for Your glory,
by the prayers of Your saints,
preserve us also from temptations and tribulations,
for You are the Master of all!

commemoration.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him

value.text:
You formed a beautiful choir, most glorious Arethas
of your holy fellow martyrs!
You struggled with them, completing the good race
and the good fight of your courageous contest!
Therefore entreat Christ that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him

value.text:
You opposed your courage, most praised Martyr Arethas,
to the savagery of evil men!
By the grace of God, you were shown to be victorious!
Glorious one, you brought to Christ,
a choir of martyrs formed by soldiers of all ages and races!

commemoration.title: Martyr Arethas and 4,299 Martyrs with him

value.text:
Understanding beforehand the wicked and evil plan of unbelieving men,
you struggled to suffer for Christ with a bold spirit!
You struggled for Him Who in days of old in the time of the law
saved from Egypt through the wilderness
those who condemned Him to the Cross!
So now also, those who were infected with unbelief,
went from words to deeds as they condemned you to the fire.
You suffered with strong patience and unity of mind,
showing yourselves to be great among martyrs!
Since you have boldness before God,
entreat Him that our souls may be delivered from sins!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Marcian and Martyrius, the Notaries of Constantinople

value.text:
Having completed the course and kept the faith,
Marcian and Martyrius,
you have been wreathed with a crown of martyrdom!
You are unshakable pillars of the Church,
breasts flowing with wholesome milk,
beacons and shining pearls,
you have enlightened creation with the splendor of your piety!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Marcian and Martyrius, the Notaries of Constantinople

value.text:
You were godly twins,
sharing a single heart and mind!
You destroyed the division of Arius,
by teaching worship of the unoriginate Son, co-eternal with the Father,
and worship of the Spirit:
the Trinity in Unity and Unity in Trinity,
one Essence in three undivided Persons!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Marcian and Martyrius, the Notaries of Constantinople

value.text:
You showed yourselves to be followers of Paul,
the preacher of holy truths:
You were like him in zeal; one with him in mind and heart:
You drowned the adversaries with your outpoured blood
drying up the torrent of wicked heresies!
You were revealed, Marcian and Martyrius,
to be rivers of true worship watering the Church of Christ!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Marcian and Martyrius, the Notaries of Constantinople

value.text:
You were disciples and followers
of the one who preached and confessed the consubstantial Trinity.
You were persecuted with him, blessed ones,
for the sake of the Trinity.
You preferred death by the sword to blasphemous heresy.
Since God has adorned you with crowns of martyrdom
and you have received boldness before Him,
pray that those who honor your memory may be delivered from misfortunes!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Marcian and Martyrius, the Notaries of Constantinople

value.text:
Marcian and Martyrius
conquered heresies with the shield of faith,
enlightening the world with the light of orthodoxy!
They are champions of the Trinity and spiritual beacons of the Church!
Obedient to Paul, the equal of the apostles,
they cast down the division of Arius and Nestorius,
refuting also the mingling of Sabellius and Severus.
They theologized about the Unity in Trinity,
the God Who was incarnate of the Virgin!
The most blessed ones preached to all one Christ in two natures!
Now that they have received crowns of victory from heaven,
these heralds of God pray for great mercy for our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Demetrios the Myrrh-gusher of Thessaloniki

value.text:
Holy Demetrius, martyr and passion-bearer of Christ,
you enlighten the world like a sun with miracles!
Therefore on the day of your memorial,
we all delight in your wonders, blessed one,
as we keep the feast with faith!
Since you have boldness before the Lord,
entreat Him to save your servants from corruption and tribulations.

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Demetrios the Myrrh-gusher of Thessaloniki

value.text:
Most glorious wonder!
With rays of miracles brighter than the sun
Demetrius ever enlightens the ends of the earth
for he is illumined by the never-fading light
and delights in the sun that never sets!
By his rays have the clouds of the enemy been dispelled,
infirmities driven away and the demons vanquished!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Demetrios the Myrrh-gusher of Thessaloniki

value.text:
Most glorious wonder!
The thrice-blessed Demetrius, pierced for the sake of Christ,
ever reveals himself to the foe as a two-edged sword,
cutting down the uprisings of the enemy
and casting down the boldness of demons!
Let us cry out to him:
Holy Demetrius, save us that ever faithfully honor you with love!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Demetrios the Myrrh-gusher of Thessaloniki

value.text:
Today the universal feast of the passion-bearer has assembled us!
Come, lovers of the feasts of the Church!
Let us celebrate his commemoration brilliantly, saying:
Rejoice, for you tore the garment of impiety with faith,
robing yourself with a spirit of courage!
Rejoice, for you destroyed the schemes of the enemy
with the power given you by God!
Rejoice, for with your pierced limbs
you spiritually portrayed the sufferings of Christ for us!
Entreat Him, Demetrius, adornment of athletes,
that we be delivered from enemies, visible and invisible,
and that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Demetrios the Myrrh-gusher of Thessaloniki

value.text:
Your side was pierced by spears for the sake of the Savior
Whose side was pierced on the Cross,
for with love you imitated Him in your wounds,
showing all the steadfastness of your witness, passion-bearer Demetrius!
Therefore the tyrant fell wounded,
receiving the shaft of your confession, athlete of Christ!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Demetrios the Myrrh-gusher of Thessaloniki

value.text:
Glorious Martyr Demetrius,
you ever enlighten the Church like a radiant star,
protecting it from destruction by the enemy,
delivering it from misery and every storm!
Therefore, blessed one it offers you praise with joy
keeping your annual commemoration,
singing hymns with faith and love to the Lord Who has glorified you!

commemoration.title: Holy, Glorious Demetrios the Myrrh-gusher of Thessaloniki

value.text:
Most glorious wonder!
Today joy shines forth in heaven and on earth
at the commemoration of the martyr Demetrius!
He is crowned with praises by the angels and receives hymns from men!
How greatly he suffered!
How well he fought the fight!
By this the evil enemy was felled when Christ conquered him!

commemoration.title: Righteous Mother Olga of Kwethluk–Tanqilria Arrsamquq–Wonderworker, Matushka of All Alaska

value.text:
Strengthened with divine words, wise Nestor,
with true courage you killed the proud tormentor of the martyr Demetrius.
Confessing the immortal God
Who died and harrowed hell,
you received an unjust death, glorious one.
Therefore, rejoicing, you have inherited everlasting life!

commemoration.title: Righteous Mother Olga of Kwethluk–Tanqilria Arrsamquq–Wonderworker, Matushka of All Alaska

value.text:
You were a godly youth, radiant in physical beauty and power.
therefore you threw down the might of Lyaeus by the power of the Almighty!
You suffered, rejoicing,
and have been numbered with the choirs of those who struggled.
As you rejoice with them, ever remember us!

commemoration.title: Righteous Mother Olga of Kwethluk–Tanqilria Arrsamquq–Wonderworker, Matushka of All Alaska

value.text:
Glorious sufferer Nestor,
you girded yourself in all the armor of Christ!
Locked in mortal combat, you destroyed Lyaeus.
With invisible arrows you brought down and killed the invisible enemy!
Therefore the bountiful One has crowned you with a wreath of victory!

commemoration.title: Venerable John the Chozebite

value.text:
God-bearing Father Stephen,
you enlightened your mind with theology,
directing your anger like a spear against the blaspheming heretics.
Desiring the food of heaven, venerable Father,
you were granted to partake of it, wondrous one,
standing before the throne of the almighty King of all!

commemoration.title: Venerable John the Chozebite

value.text:
God-bearing Father Stephen,
you strengthened your mind in splendor with divine thought.
You directed all the powers of your soul in righteousness,
with courage against anger
and with chastity against desire.
With the love of wisdom
you fashioned an all-beautiful chariot of the virtues.
Seated in it, glorious one, you ascended on high with joy!

commemoration.title: Venerable John the Chozebite

value.text:
God-bearing Father Stephen,
you ever satisfied your mind with abstinence.
You made it hasten to the prime cause,
turning from the turmoil of the world and avoiding its tumult.
Indeed, you mingled purity of mind with the greatest desire!
You are venerable and divinely wise, most discerning one!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Zenobios and his sister Zenobia, of Aegæ in Cilicia

value.text:
Your sister Zenobia was of one mind with you, all-wise one.
She voluntarily chose to suffer with you.
She manfully endured with you a violent death,
and received with you the crown of victory,
entering with you, Zenobius, into the Kingdom on high.

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Zenobios and his sister Zenobia, of Aegæ in Cilicia

value.text:
Come, lovers of the martyrs!
Let us clap our hands today and form a choir!
Let us sing songs to commemorate the most pious contenders
Zenobius and Zenobia!
They became champions of the Trinity,
and in the arena they courageously drowned the invisible enemy with their holy blood.
They have gloriously gained the crown of victory!
Therefore let us cry out to them:
Couple, holy before the Lord, both blessed and illumined,
intercede with the Savior for the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Zenobios and his sister Zenobia, of Aegæ in Cilicia

value.text:
You dyed your vestments, Zenobius,
with the blood of martyrdom,
thus making them more adorned with grace and sanctity,
entering with them into the holy of holies, glorious one.
As a wise high priest, you were offered as a perfect and all-pure offering
and as an unblemished sacrifice
to Him Who was sacrificed for you, most holy one.

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia

value.text:
Boundless is the grace of the saints
which they have received from Christ!
Therefore their relics continually work miracles by the power of God,
and their names, invoked with faith, heal incurable diseases.
Through them free us also from passions of soul and body,
Lord and Lover of mankind!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia

value.text:
The two holy ones who shared a single character and single soul,
as like-minded companions,
disdained corruptible things on earth,
showing themselves to be citizens of heaven like the angels,
though dwelling in the body:
Therefore they grant healings to all who suffer,
performing good works for those in need without exacting any fee!
Let us fittingly honor them with an annual festival,
for they pray to Christ with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia

value.text:
Holy unmercenaries, Cosmas and Damian,
you scorned the tyranny of suffering,
trampling down in Christ, every snare of the evil serpent!
You were revealed to be as radiant as beacons,
ever illumining the whole world with divine signs,
driving away darkness and infirmities by grace;
showing yourselves to be the saviors of all who with steadfast faith
celebrate your glorious memory, all-wise ones!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia

value.text:
Having placed all their hope in heaven,
the saints laid up for themselves
a treasure which cannot be stolen away:
They freely received and freely give healing to the infirm!
Following the Gospel, they acquired neither silver nor gold,
but performed works of mercy for both men and beasts,
that obedient to Christ
they might pray with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia

value.text:
The divinely wise Cosmas and Damian,
the ever-memorable two,
made themselves wholly the dwelling of the Trinity!
They pour forth the waters of healing like torrents
from the life-giving source,
by their touch, their relics cure suffering
and their very names drive infirmities away from all those
who turn to the saving harbor of Christ!
They pray with boldness on behalf of our souls.

commemoration.title: Holy Wonderworkers and Unmercenaries Cosmas and Damian of Mesopotamia

value.text:
You ever have Christ working within you,
as you work wonders in the world and heal the sick!
Holy Unmercenaries, your healing is an inexhaustible source:
Drawn from, it flows in abundance;
poured out, it gushes forth,
flowing every day in great quantity,
granting healing to all, yet remaining undrained!
Those who draw from it are filled with healing, yet it remains full!
Therefore what shall we call you?
Healing physicians of soul and bodies?
Healers of incurable sufferings who heal all?
You have received this gift from Christ the Savior,
Who grants us great mercy!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Seraphim (Samoilovich), Archbishop of Uglich

value.text:
We honor you, Joannicius our father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Converser with the angels,
companion of the venerable and righteous ones!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
The divinely-eloquent Paul ordains you, most blessed one,
as his namesake and follower!
You are adorned with his character and piety,
his endurance through tribulations!
Aflame with his zeal, you are a champion of Orthodoxy!
Now you are glorified with him in the heavenly mansions!

commemoration.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Christ has crowned you with a bright wreath of righteousness, blessed bishop!
You have kept the faith; you have finished your course,
and He has adorned your confession, truly wondrous one!
Therefore, since you have received your inheritance in heaven,
pray to the Savior for those who sing praises to you!

commemoration.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Most blessed Paul, the namesake of confession,
you are the intercessor for those who praise you in faith:
Deliver us from all misfortune and every sin,
from the storm of the passions and from tyranny,
for you are an invincible martyr, Father,
a rightly-accepted bishop!
You have acquired boldness before Christ our God!

commemoration.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
You strangled the ungodly Arius and the impious Macedonius
with the strong cords of your teachings!
With your true words of doctrine,
you strengthened multitudes of the Orthodox faithful,
Hieromartyr and Father!
Therefore, the Lover of mankind accepted your brilliant confession,
revealing you to be a dweller in His Kingdom!

commemoration.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Clothed in the vestments of a bishop, venerable Father,
you imitated your namesake, Paul.
You endured persecution and tribulations;
by constant toil you overthrew the blasphemous teachings of Arius!
You suffered for the unoriginate and consubstantial Trinity;
you cast down the impious Macedonius who fought against the Spirit!
You gave a clear explanation of the Orthodox Faith to all,
for you are united with the immaterial angels.
Together with them, pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Venerable Father Paul,
you were invested with virtue by Christ God!
Strengthened by the Faith,
you bravely overcame every attack of the demons and strangers!
You established your flock upon a rock
unassailed by any heresy.
Now that you sing with the angels,
pray to the Savior that our souls may be preserved in peace!

commemoration.title: Saint Paul the Confessor, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Venerable one,
you sailed the deep of fasting with the sail of abstinence.
you escaped the storm of the passions.
Therefore, as the namesake of the divine Paul,
you endured persecution and tribulations.
You were maltreated amidst the blasphemies of the heretics.
You cast down the opinions of Arius
and vanquished the heresy of Nestorius.
Therefore you were revealed as a zealot of the Church of Christ!
Entreat Him, blessed hierarch, that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: 33 Holy Martyrs of Melitene

value.text:
You were fittingly revealed as a divinely assembled regiment,
greatly glorious ones:
A sacred army, a Godly company, a holy nation;
a legion of martyrs inspired by God,
a noble gathering and unbreakable alliance,
inhabitants of the City on high!
Therefore you are rightly called blessed!

commemoration.title: 33 Holy Martyrs of Melitene

value.text:
Let us all assemble and honor Nicander,
with Hesychius, Athanasius and Mamas,
the divine Barachius and Callinicus,
Theogenes and Nicon,
Longinus and Theodore,
Valerius and Xanthius,
Theodulus, Callimachus and Eugene,
the Godly Theodochus and Ostrychius!

commemoration.title: 33 Holy Martyrs of Melitene

value.text:
Let us together hymn the true witnesses with faith:
The valiant Hieron,
the glorious Epiphanius, Maximian and Ducitius,
Claudian and Theophilus
and the Godly Gigantius,
Dorotheus and Theodotus,
Castrycius, Anicetas and Themelius,
and also Eutychius!

commemoration.title: 33 Holy Martyrs of Melitene

value.text:
You cut off all the heavy burden of material things
and the great turmoil of the flesh.
Wise one, controlling even your breath,
you remained untouched by the passions,
your courageous mind strong as a pillar surrounded by spiritual armor!
Now you have truly received the divine vision and splendor
and have taken your place before Him Whom you desired,
where made divine by your manner,
you delight in his never-ending radiance!

commemoration.title: 33 Holy Martyrs of Melitene

value.text:
Having set aside all the folly of the passions
and made your flesh subject to your spirit,
you became a rule of virtue,
the confirmation of monastics,
a model for those who fast,
the adornment of the venerable ones!
Now you behold the ineffable beauty of your Creator
and are ever nurtured by the spirit on the beauties of heaven!
Therefore we have assembled to celebrate with hymns and sweet songs
your honored and most festive memory!

commemoration.title: 33 Holy Martyrs of Melitene

value.text:
You loved the light, like Elijah and John the Forerunner.
You observed stillness in the mountains and arid deserts,
ever learning to ascend towards God
and excelling in the virtues.
Therefore you have gained your ultimate desire, all-wise one,
and you stand rejoicing before the triply-radiant light of the Trinity
from whom you received divine splendor!
Intercede with boldness on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
The eternal wisdom established you, Gabriel
a light reflecting things divine,
illumining the whole creation,
revealing to us the divine mystery hidden from before the ages:
God who is bodiless made flesh in a Virgin womb
and become Man that He might save mankind.

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Destroy the wanton violence of Hagar's sons:
the enemies who attack your flock;
heal the divisions of the Church,
calm the storm of unending temptations;
deliver from danger and calamities
those who honor you in love,
and hasten to your protection, Gabriel the archangel,
the intercessor for our souls!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Michael the Archangel,
fiery is your appearance and miraculous your beauty!
You traverse creation by immaterial nature,
fulfilling the commands of the creator of all.
By your might you are known as all powerful.
The temples honored by your Holy name
you have made a source of healing!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Make Your angels spirits as it is written,
and Your ministers a flaming fire!
You, Word, have shown Michael to be the first among archangels:
He submits to Your commands,
and proclaims with fear the thrice-Holy hymn to Your glory.

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Princes of the angelic powers rejoice with us,
for your leader and our champion the great prince of angels is sanctified,
being revealed to us in his honored temple.
Therefore rightfully singing praises to him we cry out:
Save us under the protection of your wings,
Michael, the greatest archangel!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Michael the Archangel,
you have been revealed as the bright messenger of the tri-luminary Godhead.
Together with the heavenly powers you cry out:
Holy are You, Father
Holy are You, co-eternal Word
Holy are You, Holy Spirit:
One glory, one kingdom, one essence,
one Godhead, one power!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Standing before the throne of the tri-luminary Godhead,
brilliant with the rays of its unceasing light:
save from the passions of darkness
those on earth who praise you joyfully!
Illumine them, Gabriel the archangel,
the intercessor for our souls!

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Since you, leader of hosts, are first in rank and an archangel,
deliver from every oppression, sorrow, sickness and sin
those who praise you humbly and implore you.
Since you are immaterial you behold Him who is without matter.
You shine with the unapproachable light of the glory of the Lord,
Who in His love took flesh for our sakes from a Virgin,
when He willed to save mankind.

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

value.text:
Let us who in the world celebrate as the angels,
sing out to God sitting on the throne of glory:
Holy are You, heavenly Father,
Holy are You, co-eternal Word,
Holy are You, most Holy Spirit!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Onesiphorus and Porphyrius of Ephesus

value.text:
You nobly subjected the uprising of the flesh to the soul
through ascetic feats of fasting,
and you followed Christ, Matrona,
living devoutly with those who fast,
quenching the burning of pleasure with divine showers of tears,
kindling a fervent desire for the Creator!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Onesiphorus and Porphyrius of Ephesus

value.text:
You built hallowed tabernacles in many souls
for the use of God!
You yourself were a temple of the Spirit, all-wise one,
guiding souls by your spiritual purity
to the healing struggles of fasting!
You brought saved souls to the master as a dowry, Matrona!
Together with them we honor you in faith!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Onesiphorus and Porphyrius of Ephesus

value.text:
The maidens loved the Bridegroom and Lord,
submitting to His teaching!
In the spirit, they disdained the weakness of the flesh,
struggling with diligence to restrain the passions!
They have been led with you, Matrona, ever rejoicing,
into the heavenly bridal chamber of God!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Onesiphorus and Porphyrius of Ephesus

value.text:
Martyred athlete, blessed Onesiphorus,
you confessed Christ God,
suffering greatly before the tribunal of evil!
You endured the wounds of blows and the immolation of your body!
Therefore you have been crowned with the wreath of victory
by the hand of the Creator of life, all-praised one!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Onesiphorus and Porphyrius of Ephesus

value.text:
Martyred athlete Porphyrius,
by the grace and power of the Spirit,
you dyed a purple robe for yourself in the bath of your blood.
Thus clothed, you were revealed in splendor,
reigning with our one God Who reigns forever!
Beseech Him now, glorious one, that we all may be saved!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Onesiphorus and Porphyrius of Ephesus
Apostles of the Seventy: Erastus, Olympas, Herodion, Sosipater, Quartus, and Tertius

value.text:
Blessed ones, you have led to Christ God the gentiles,
delivered by the blood of Him Who was well pleased to be born on earth
and Who willingly endured the Cross and death!
Most wise ones, now entreat Him
that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Apostles of the Seventy: Erastus, Olympas, Herodion, Sosipater, Quartus, and Tertius

value.text:
Holy preachers, who traveled the whole world in splendor
like winged eagles,
you led those pursued by the devil
to the incorruptible Faith!
Pray that our souls may be given peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Apostles of the Seventy: Erastus, Olympas, Herodion, Sosipater, Quartus, and Tertius

value.text:
Let us honor Tertius and Sosipater with holy voices,
with Olympus and Rodion
and together with them Erastus, the initiate of the mysteries,
and the godly Quartus:
They glorify Christ our God,
beseeching Him to grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Martyr Menas of Egypt

value.text:
Again the yearly memorial of the beacons of the world has dawned:
Mennas, Victor and Vincent!
They enlighten the hearts of the faithful
by their struggles for Christ and His Cross!
Therefore let us honor Christ our God in hymns,
Who has crowned them with glory and honor!

commemoration.title: Venerable Theodore the Confessor, Abbot of the Studion

value.text:
Wise initiate of sacred mysteries,
the abundant grace of the Spirit was poured forth in your mouth!
A well-spring of teaching gushed forth from there,
revealing you, Theodore, to be a champion of true worship,
a zealous bearer of the truth,
a pillar and fortress of the Orthodox faith,
and a most excellent example of the monastic life, wise one!

commemoration.title: Venerable Theodore the Confessor, Abbot of the Studion

value.text:
Father Theodore,
true to your name: "the gift of God,"
you have given the gifts you received beyond understanding
to those who love you in faith!
You increased your talent, blessed one,
and heard the voice of God calling you to His bridal chamber.
Wondrous one, you live there now by the throne of the King of all!

commemoration.title: Venerable Theodore the Confessor, Abbot of the Studion

value.text:
Theodore, Father of fathers,
you brought a multitude of monastics to Christ!
You were the godly cause of their salvation.
You were enlightened with true teaching!
You were revealed prophetically to be the mouth of the Lord!
As you stand now before Him wise one, ever remember us!

commemoration.title: Martyr Menas of Egypt

value.text:
Come, all who love the martyrs!
Let us honor their thrice-radiant chorus:
Mennas, Victor and Vincent,
for they paid with blood to purchase eternal life!
They spoke out against the author of evil, saying:
We will not prefer corruptible things to incorruptible!
We will not do battle for an earthly and mortal king,
but we will fight for the living King Who ever cries to the faithful:
He who believes in me, even if he dies, he shall live!

commemoration.title: Saint John the Merciful, Patriarch of Alexandria

value.text:
John, the great pastor and beacon of Alexandria,
the follower of Christ,
was a wellspring of mercy!
His true sympathy overflowed
with increasing compassion for those in need!
Come! Let us who are poor in spirit drink our fill!
Let us practice his serenity!
For with a truly compassionate presence
he showed hospitality to the wandering Christ through the poor!
Like Abraham in days of old,
he was counted worthy of blessedness!
He prays with boldness that our souls may find mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint John the Merciful, Patriarch of Alexandria

value.text:
He Who sees what is hidden
elevated you to a most magnificent throne.
He foresaw your purity;
the rightness of your mind and your godly presence!
He anointed and perfected you with chrism, wise one,
openly appointing you to be the shepherd of His flock!
You guided them to the heaven of divine desire,
divinely-eloquent John!

commemoration.title: Saint John the Merciful, Patriarch of Alexandria

value.text:
The Lord granted all the requests of your heart, truly wondrous one!
You observed all the laws of salvation,
for you loved God and neighbor without limit, as your very self,
divinely blessed one!
You satisfied those in need:
Today, therefore, John, we honor you!

commemoration.title: Saint John the Merciful, Patriarch of Alexandria

value.text:
In mercy, wondrous John, you followed the most merciful Master!
You cast forth your bread, venerable one, distributing to those in need.
Therefore, holy one, your memory is truly eternal:
by your supplications, most wealthy bishop,
you save from temptations and tribulations,
those who celebrate it in faith!

commemoration.title: Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Thrice-blessed saint, most holy Father,
excellent pastor and great shepherd, disciple of Christ,
you have laid down your life for your sheep,
and now, all-praised John Chrysostom, by your intercessions,
pray that we may be granted great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Let us hymn with songs
the golden trumpet, the divinely inspired instrument,
the unsounded depth of teaching,
the strength of the Church, the heavenly mind,
the golden cup pouring rivers of sweet doctrines; nourishing creation!

commemoration.title: Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Let Chrysostom be magnified in hymns!
He is the earthly angel and heavenly man,
the sweet-voiced singing swallow,
the treasury of virtues, the unbroken stone,
the shining example of faith and model of martyrs,
the peer of the holy angels and equal of the apostles!

commemoration.title: Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Let us fittingly honor John Chrysostom, the never-setting star!
He enlightens the whole world with the rays of teaching;
he is the preacher of repentance,
the golden sponge washing away the slime of ignorance
and moistening hearts that are withered by sin.

commemoration.title: Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
Rejoice, divinely inspired trumpet of the Church,
beautiful tongue of gold describing images of repentance for us in love!
Golden mind, golden-mouthed swallow, dove with golden pinions,
Chanting hymns in the verdant abundance of the virtues!
You are a golden stream flowing with waters:
A pledge of God’s love for mankind!
Entreat Christ God to send down great mercy to our souls.

commemoration.title: Saint John Chrysostom, Archbishop of Constantinople

value.text:
You revealed yourself as a golden-voiced trumpet,
Chrysostom of golden words,
gilding the hearts of the faithful with your golden teachings,
as the prophet said:
The sound of your corrections has gone out, venerable father;
you have enlightened the ends of the universe!

commemoration.title: Holy, All-Praised Apostle Philip

value.text:
As Moses of old,
you were instructed by divine ascent.
Desiring to see God you spiritually saw his image.
You accepted the Son as knowledge and testimony of the Father,
for they are known as one being:
The Unity honorably exalted by all,
the Kingdom, power, glory and worship!

commemoration.title: Holy, All-Praised Apostle Philip

value.text:
God-seer Philip,
you proclaimed with divine inspiration and the teaching of the Holy Spirit,
sounding the Savior's heavenly Gospel in the world with a fiery tongue.
You burned all deceit to ashes like dried grass.
You proclaimed the Lord Christ in the universe,
Who is Master over all.

commemoration.title: Holy, All-Praised Apostle Philip

value.text:
You burn with the brilliance of a great light, Philip,
shining as a light of the universe.
Seeking the light of God you found illumination in the Son,
Whose image is equal to the first image.
Implore Him, Apostle, to save those sealed by divine blood.

commemoration.title: Holy, All-Praised Apostle Philip

value.text:
Having established action, blessed one,
as an entrance into true vision,
and vision as the end of divine action,
you implored Christ to show you the ineffable glory of the Father,
for every reasonable creature desires witness of God.
You received the One you desired, glorious one,
of Whom the Son is the image!
Pray to Him boldly for our souls!

commemoration.title: Holy, All-Praised Apostle Philip

value.text:
Apostle Philip,
your mouth is a vessel of sweet spices,
pouring out a life-giving drink for the faithful.
Entering by action into vision,
you welcomed and followed Christ.
You adorned the barren and childless Church of the pagans,
by teaching and increasing her children.
You can do much since you are near to God:
Pray that the Church may be saved from need and distress!

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Matthew

value.text:
The Searcher of the hearts of men
inspired your mind, Apostle, with His divine knowledge:
He called you to Himself, ransoming you from the world's deceit:
for He is the Light whose rays shine to the ends of the earth.
He commanded you to proclaim His word.
He made you worthy to write His holy Gospel:
Pray that He may enlighten and save our souls.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Matthew

value.text:
Once a publican, now a disciple,
you accepted the urgent call of the eternal Word.
You abandoned the collection of the taxes,
eager for the promise of communion in His kingdom;
you cast away the raging tumult of this life.
Now you behold His glory face to face:
Pray that He may enlighten and save our souls.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Matthew

value.text:
In days of old, as the earth lay waste in evil,
the prophet Daniel was endowed with clearness of sight.
He beheld a stone, cut without human hands from a mountain:
a stone which ground the riches of earthly kingdoms to dust.
In the fullness of time this all-wise Lord came down to earth:
passing by the customs-house, He chose you to be His herald,
He called you, who once served an earthly kingdom,
to serve Him, the light of the world,
pray to Him, blessed Matthew,
that He may enlighten and save our souls.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Matthew

value.text:
You were called by Christ to heavenly discipleship;
you followed Him eagerly, chosen one of God.
He delivered you from subjection to earthly cares;
abandoning the vain collection of tribute,
you faithfully kept the accounts of the heavenly King.
Blessed Evangelist, you are a light for those who dwell in darkness,
a guide to salvation for those who wander astray,
Matthew, the herald of glad tidings, pray for those who honor you!

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Matthew

value.text:
All-praised Matthew,
your words are a trumpet drawing men to the knowledge of God.
They have delivered the inhabitants of the earth from enslavement to evil,
leading us into the true faith, the unity of righteousness:
Pray to Christ our God to deliver us from corruption and danger.

commemoration.title: Apostle and Evangelist Matthew

value.text:
The full stature of goodness is made manifest in you, blessed Matthew:
In the fullness of time you abandoned the occupation of an evil age,
soaring as an eagle to the heights of righteousness,
you have filled the earth with the wisdom hidden from all eternity,
following fervently in the footsteps of Christ,
you have borne the Gospel of peace, life, and salvation to men,
filling with divine commandments those who hunger after righteousness,
blessed guide, well-pleasing to the Creator,
pray for us who bless your memory.

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory, Wonderworker of Neocaesarea

value.text:
What shall we call you, Gregory?
Master, for you subjected the passions to your mind!
Husbandman, for you reaped the fruit of wisdom!
One granted the vision of God and taught with heavenly theology!
A sacred performer of the mysteries
and most wondrous worker of miracles!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory, Wonderworker of Neocaesarea

value.text:
What shall I now call you, Gregory?
Mighty destroyer of godless impiety,
setting forth the laws of true worship!
Wise teacher and bestower of invincible peace!
Unvanquished conqueror of armies!
One who ever dwells in the mountains,
beholding those living in the cities!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory, Wonderworker of Neocaesarea

value.text:
You most wisely embarked upon the depths of knowledge,
hierarch of Christ!
You acquired the vision of the Trinity,
foreseeing steadfastly in the spirit Christ our God!
You poured forth on us a flood of miracles,
making solid the watery nature of the sea,
changing the pagan priest's dark delusion to belief!
You persuaded the persecutors truly to believe,
revealing yourself to them as a pillar of virtue!
You were called a prophet through your miracles!
therefore we beseech you,
ever pray for us to the Savior that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Gregory, Wonderworker of Neocaesarea

value.text:
What shall I now proclaim you, venerable one?
You followed the apostles as a worker of miracles!
You restrained the river by calling on Christ,
drying up the lake which was the cause of contention between brethren!
You dispersed the ungodly congregation,
increasing and enlightening Christian assemblies!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Martyr Platon of Ancyra

value.text:
You transcended every sense and directed your mind toward life on high!
With godly thoughts and great wisdom of soul,
you scorned the baseness and lowliness of visible things.
You courageously endured torture and burning for Christ, Martyr!

commemoration.title: Martyr Platon of Ancyra

value.text:
Trained by fasting and hardened by ascetic endeavor,
you were tormented with manifold tortures,
becoming a two-edged sword cutting down hordes of demons, Romanus!
You are the adornment of athletes,
the precious ornament of the Church,
the divine boast of those who died shedding their own blood, all-praised one!

commemoration.title: Martyr Platon of Ancyra

value.text:
A child speaks with eloquence and amazes the mindless ones!
He is adorned with honorable adversity!
Illumined by his death, he is enriched
by the good fame of holy athletes whose zeal he acquired!
Pray with them, truly wise Romanus,
that we be given remission of our sins!

commemoration.title: Martyr Platon of Ancyra

value.text:
The victories of your martyr are awesome and glorious, Lord!
For imitating the boldness of the fishermen,
by his words and deeds he tore asunder mythology,
catching the foolishness of the philosopher Plato with the nets of theology!
When his skin was flayed and he was beheaded,
he choked the enemy with the outpouring of his blood!
Most blessed wonder-worker Plato,
the adornment of the martyrs:
You preached the great name of Christ with boldness!
Pray that great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Platon of Ancyra

value.text:
