Filled with valiant wisdom and with courageous resolution,
you endured the cutting of your limbs and dismemberment of your body,
together with unbearable fire, starvation and death,
in expectation of the glory which does not fade with time,
which lies before you eternally,
and foreseeing everlasting blessedness!

commemoration.title: Martyr Platon of Ancyra

value.text:
By grace, you trampled down every assault of the enemy
and the attacks of your persecutors!
You were crowned with the wreath of victory, most wealthy one,
given incorruptible gladness and ineffable and divine radiance!
In their midst now, ask remission of sins for those who fittingly praise you!

commemoration.title: Martyr Platon of Ancyra

value.text:
You were beaten and torn in pieces,
imprisoned in a dungeon,
your tongue was cut out and your jaw was broken,
glorious athlete!
You received a blessed end through violent suffocation.
You were revealed to be unshakable and steadfast
through the operation of the divine spirit, Romanus,
therefore we praise you with faith!

commemoration.title: Prophet Obadiah (Abdia)

value.text:
As a shining vessel of the Spirit,
you were illumined by Him, Obadiah!
With most divine vision, you were enriched by the image of prophecy:
Foreknowledge of things to come and knowledge of the truth.
Pray that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Prophet Obadiah (Abdia)

value.text:
You were a glorious prophet:
a divine herald of God full of unfading light!
You beheld the glory which surpasses understanding and reason
as you stood before the Master of all!
Entreat Him that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Entry into the Temple of the Most Holy Theotokos

value.text:
Today the God-bearing temple, the Theotokos,
is offered in the Temple of the Lord,
and Zachariah receives her!
Today the Holy of Holies exults
and the choir of angels mystically celebrates!
Today we celebrate with them and cry out with Gabriel:
Rejoice, full of grace,
the Lord of great mercy is with you!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today the living Temple of the holy glory of Christ our God
she who alone among women is pure and blessed
is offered in the Temple of the law,
that she may make her dwelling in the sanctuary,
Joachim and Anna rejoice with her in spirit,
and choirs of virgins sing to the Lord,
chanting psalms and honoring His Mother.

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today let us, the faithful, dance for joy,
singing to the Lord with psalms and hymns,
venerating His hallowed tabernacle,
the living ark, which contained the Word Who cannot be contained.
For she, a young child in the flesh,
is offered in wondrous fashion to the Lord,
and with rejoicing, Zachariah the great high priest
receives her as the dwelling place of God.

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Anna, the all-blessed cried out rejoicing:
Zachariah, take her whom the prophets of God proclaimed in spirit,
and lead her into the holy Temple,
there to be brought up in reverence,
that she may become the divine throne of the Master of all,
His palace, His resting place, and dwelling filled with light!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
The young girls rejoice today,
and with their lamps in hand they go in reverence before the spiritual lamp
as she enters the Holy of Holies.
They foreshadow the ineffable brightness that is to shine forth from her
and to give light by the Spirit
to those who sit in the darkness of ignorance.

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
The prophets proclaimed you, O Virgin Mother of God:
you are the glory of the apostles and the pride of martyrs,
the restoration of all who dwell on earth:
for through you we are reconciled to God.
Therefore we honor your entrance into the Temple of the Lord,
and saved by your intercession, with the angel we all cry to you:
Rejoice!  most holy lady!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
After your birth, Lady and Bride of God,
you went to the Temple of the Lord
to be raised as a child consecrated in the Holy of Holies.
Then Gabriel was sent to bring you food, undefiled Virgin.
All the powers of heaven stood amazed, seeing the Holy Spirit dwell in you!
Therefore, pure and undefiled Mother of God,
glorified in heaven and earth,
save your people!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Led by the Holy Spirit,
the holy and immaculate maid is taken to dwell in the holy Temple.
she who is in truth the most holy Temple of our holy God
is fed by an angel!
He has sanctified all things by her entry,
and has made godlike the fallen nature of mortals.

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today the God-bearing Temple, the Theotokos,
is offered in the Temple of the Lord,
and Zachariah receives her!
Today the Holy of Holies exults
and the choir of angels mystically celebrates!
Today we celebrate with them and cry out with Gabriel:
Rejoice, full of grace, the Lord of great mercy is with you!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
A day of joy has dawned;
a feast worthy of all reverence!
For today, she who was a Virgin before childbirth
and remained a Virgin after bearing a child,
is offered in the Temple!
The venerable Zachariah, father of the forerunner,
rejoices and cries out in gladness:
the holy intercessor of those in affliction
comes to the holy Temple,
there to be consecrated as the dwelling of the almighty!
Let the forefather, Joachim, be glad
and let Anna rejoice!
For they have offered the Queen without blemish
as a three-year old heifer of sacrifice to God!
Mothers, rejoice with them!
Virgins, dance for joy!
Barren women, form a chorus!
For the pre-ordained Queen of all has opened the kingdom of heaven to us!
Rejoice and be glad, all people!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today let heaven greatly rejoice
and let the clouds pour down gladness
at the great and mighty acts of our God!
for behold, the gate that faces the east,
born according to the promise from a barren and fruitless womb,
and dedicated to God as His dwelling,
is led today into the Temple as an unblemished sacrifice.
Let David greatly rejoice, striking upon his harp.
she is led to the King, with her Virgin companions,
her escort, in her train!
Within the tabernacle of God, His place of atonement, shall she be raised
to become the dwelling of Him Who was begotten of the Father
without change before all ages
for the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Come let all the faithful praise the only immaculate one,
foretold by the prophets and now offered in the Temple:
the Mother fore-ordained before the ages,
made manifest as the Theotokos in the last days!
By her prayers, Lord, grant us your peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Heaven and earth rejoice, beholding the spiritual heaven,
the only Virgin without blemish, enters the house of God to be reared in reverence.
Zachariah cried to her in amazement:
gate of the Lord!  to you I open the gates of the Temple:
rejoice and go round it in gladness.
For I know and believe that the deliverance of Israel
shall now come to dwell openly in our midst
and that from you shall be born God the Word,
Who grants the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
The most holy Virgin, Temple that is to hold God,
is dedicated within the Temple of the Lord;
and young girls, bearing lamps, now go before her.
Her noble parents, Joachim and Anna, leap for joy and dance,
for they have borne her who is to bear the Creator.
And she, the all-pure, with rejoicing goes round the divine habitations,
and is fed by the hands of an angel.
She it is who will become Mother of Christ,
Who grants the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Anna, truly blessed by God's grace
led with gladness into the Temple of the Lord
the pure and ever-Virgin who is full of grace,
and she called the young girls to go before her with lamps in hand.
"Go, child," she said, "to Him Who gave you to me;
be to Him an offering and a sweet smelling incense.
Go into the place which none may enter:
Learn its mysteries and prepare yourself
to become the pleasing and beautiful dwelling-place of Jesus,
Who grants the world great mercy!"

commemoration.title: The Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today let us the assembled faithful triumph in spirit!
Let us reverently praise the child of God, Virgin and Theotokos
as she is offered in the Temple of the Lord:
She who was forechosen from all generations
to be the dwelling-place of Christ, the Master and God of all.
Virgins bearing lamps, go before her,
honoring the majestic advance of the ever-Virgin!
Mothers, set aside every sorrow to follow them in gladness,
singing the praises of her who became the Mother of God
and mediator of joy for the world!
With the angel, let us all joyfully cry: Rejoice! to her,
for she is the joyous one who ever intercedes for our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
The virgins bearing lamps,
who with their light accompany the ever-Virgin,
truly prophesy the future in spirit.
For the temple of God, the Theotokos
with virginal glory enters
as a little child into the Temple!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
The Theotokos, glorious fruit of a sacred promise,
is truly revealed to the world
as higher than all creation.
Faithfully led into the house of God,
she fulfills the vow of her parents
and is preserved by the Holy Spirit.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
O Virgin, fed in faith
by heavenly bread in the Temple of the Lord,
you brought forth to the world the Bread of Life Who is the Word:
And as His chosen and spotless temple,
you were betrothed mystically through the Spirit
to be the Bride of God the Father.

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today let heaven greatly rejoice
and let the clouds pour down gladness
at the great and mighty acts of our God!
For behold, the gate that faces the east,
born according to the promise from a barren and fruitless womb,
and dedicated to God as His dwelling,
is led today into the Temple as an unblemished sacrifice!
Let David greatly rejoice, striking upon his harp!
She is led to the King, with her virgin companions,
her escort, in her train!
Within the tabernacle of God, His place of atonement, shall she be raised
to become the dwelling of Him Who was begotten of the Father
without change before all ages
for the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today the unblemished Virgin is led to the Temple
to become the habitation of God the King of all, Who sustains our life.
Today as a three-year old victim of sacrifice,
the most pure sanctuary is led into the Holy of Holies.
Let us cry out to her with the angel:
Rejoice, only blessed among women!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Come, let all the faithful praise the only immaculate one,
foretold by the prophets and now offered in the Temple:
The Mother fore-ordained before the ages,
made manifest as the Theotokos in the last days!
By her prayers, Lord, grant us your peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today the city of Alexandria adorns itself with wisdom, Martyr,
having your childhood garments within your holy temple!
Therefore we also celebrate your honored memory in reverence, Catherine.
Pray for those who honor you!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Today let us celebrate the memory of Catherine,
for by great word and deed she truly trampled all the powers of the foe
and the opposition of the orators.
By her prayers, O God, deliver us from the godless enemy!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
Rejoice, most glorious and honored Martyr Catherine!
for the mountain of Sinai
where Moses beheld the bush that burned yet was not consumed
now keeps your God-pleasing body
translated there by the gracious mercy of Christ
waiting the time of His second coming!

commemoration.title: Afterfeast of the Entry of the Most Holy Mother of God into the Temple

value.text:
All who love the martyrs,
let us hasten joyfully to the feast of the divinely-wise Martyr Catherine!
Let us crown her with praises as with flowers,
crying out to her:
Rejoice, for you denounced the insolence of foolish orators
filled with ignorant thoughts,
leading them to the divine Faith!
Rejoice, for you gave your body over to torments for love of your Creator
and were not destroyed,
for you were an invincible woman!
Rejoice, for you have inherited the mansions on high
as the reward for your struggles!
Now you delight in eternal glory.
Desiring this glory, may we who hymn you not lose our hope in it!

commemoration.title: Leavetaking of the Entry of the Most Holy Theotokos Into the Temple

value.text:
You were a branch of the vine of life, most wise father and bishop:
through the Spirit you brought forth the beautiful fruits of teaching
which continue to produce the saving wine of divine knowledge,
gladdening the hearts of all the pious who truly honor you,
most blessed God-bearer Clement!

commemoration.title: Leavetaking of the Entry of the Most Holy Theotokos Into the Temple

value.text:
You shone forth from the lands of the West, O father,
like a light-giving sun.
You brilliantly illumined the earth with the radiance of your teaching and your wounds!
You reached the lands of the East, thrice-blessed one, where you set as you were slain,
but you splendidly shine for Christ with heavenly rays, Clement
for you are unceasingly enlightened through divine communion!

commemoration.title: Leavetaking of the Entry of the Most Holy Theotokos Into the Temple

value.text:
As a disciple of the preeminent Peter, most praised father,
you established yourself as a precious stone upon his rock.
You tore the fabric of idolatry with the strength of your words,
raising up divine temples for the worship of the Trinity
for Whom you struggled and received the crown of martyrdom, O blessed one!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Innocent, first Bishop of Irkutsk

value.text:
The truth of the Lord was established in you, Father,
as foretold by the prophet David who proclaimed in days of old:
The righteous shall flourish like a palm tree
and shall spread abroad like a cedar in Lebanon;
he shall be like a tree planted by streams of waters!
Therefore we beseech you, most wondrous Hierarch:
Enlighten with your prayers
all of us who now sing to you!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Innocent, first Bishop of Irkutsk

value.text:
Let us praise the new apostle of Christ
who came into a pagan land with the Gospel,
making the farthest reaches of Russia fragrant with the faith
that now blossoms like a lily in the Siberian east!
He rained words of heavenly wisdom in streams of grace
upon a thirsting people!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Innocent, first Bishop of Irkutsk

value.text:
Let us praise a man glorious in his being:
Our father, Bishop Innocent!
The Lord has worked great glory in permitting his body to remain incorrupt,
placing it as a lamp upon a stand,
enlightening the flock of Irkutsk with the rays of his miracles
that the memory of this righteous man should never depart
but that his name should live from generation to generation;
that the people should come to know his wisdom
and beholding the holy Church,
would ever proclaim his praise in hymns and spiritual songs!

commemoration.title: Repose of Saint Innocent, first Bishop of Irkutsk

value.text:
Holy hierarch, Father Innocent,
your life accorded with your name,
for your daily life was whitened with innocence.
Sojourning on earth as a pilgrim and wanderer,
you received the holy Trinity within yourself,
preparing a dwelling within your heart
for the Father, Son and Holy Spirit!
Therefore your holy body flourishes even in the grave;
not one of your all-saving bones is broken!
We venerate your precious relics with faith
for they have been glorified by abundant healing.
We pray to you, God-pleasing and zealous Pastor,
the adornment of hierarchs:
Make us also pleasing to the holy Trinity
Whom you glorified on earth in holiness and righteousness
and before Whom you now stand,
ever praying for your earthly flock and the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr James the Persian

value.text:
Possessing boldness before Christ, ever-memorable Martyr,
you fervently intercede for all
who celebrate your honored festival with faith,
delivering them from misfortunes
and freeing them from the passions,
rescuing them from the evils that surround them,
granting their souls salvation by your divine prayers,
that we may glorify your splendid struggles!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr James the Persian

value.text:
Having forsaken the beauties of the world,
the splendor of your birthright, wealth and honor,
you cast aside all sensuality,
breaking your body through the taming of the passions.
You rejoiced, James, as you followed after Christ,
for through your suffering
you have become a partaker of glory indeed,
and are an inheritor of the Kingdom!

commemoration.title: Greatmartyr James the Persian

value.text:
When the members of your flesh were cut off
you endured unbearable pain and wounds, truly glorious James!
You manfully trampled the savagery of the tormentors underfoot,
receiving a priceless crown of victory!
Now adorned with it, blessed one,
you stand with those who suffered with you,
before the throne of the Master!

commemoration.title: Monastic Martyr and Confessor Stephen the New

value.text:
Imprisoned in a dungeon,
you fasted for forty days like the Master,
preparing yourself for suffering, holy Stephen,
the confirmation of monks and adornment of martyrs!
Therefore, those who had no mercy,
fell upon you like wild beasts,
dragging you like an innocent lamb!
They unjustly tore your body to pieces
and cast you out with the evildoers!
You suffered mightily
and now you pray boldly on behalf of our souls!

commemoration.title: Monastic Martyr and Confessor Stephen the New

value.text:
Evil men, subject to the iniquity of the lawless emperor,
stoned you without pity, venerable one,
like the honored Protomartyr Stephen.
They crushed your holy head, Father,
dragging you most savagely through the streets,
causing your bowels to spill forth, most blessed one,
showing you no mercy even after you were dead!
How great was your courage!
How great were your bearing and endurance!
By them, Stephen, you have received an unfading crown!

commemoration.title: Monastic Martyr and Confessor Stephen the New

value.text:
Like the great prophet Samuel, Stephen,
you were dedicated to God while yet an infant.
Having ascended the mountain,
you were well-pleasing to Him in the monastic life.
You manfully stripped yourself for the contest,
enduring banishment and tribulation with patience!
You bore fetters and imprisonment for His image!
You were dragged and beaten;
you were stoned and your head was crushed.
Therefore you were crowned by Christ God!
Entreat Him that those who celebrate your honorable memory
may be delivered from sufferings, temptations and the tribulation to come,
and that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Monastic Martyr and Confessor Stephen the New

value.text:
You offered yourself wholly to the master from your youth,
transcending the flesh and worldly love.
You were an excellent monk, most holy Stephen,
and a vessel of the Spirit of God.
You were imprisoned in a narrow hut, blessed one,
but you gave your mind wings to fly to the heavens
to behold the ineffable beauty of Christ our King and God!
Worshipping His image, you suffered greatly!

commemoration.title: Martyr Paramon and 370 Martyrs in Bithynia

value.text:
Manifestly illumined by the brightness of the Spirit of God,
most blessed Paramon,
you despised the total darkness of idolatry.
When your time had come, most blessed one,
you approached the suffering before you with a courageous mind!
Revealed as victorious, you cast down the prideful enemy of all mortals,
as you magnified Christ!
Entreat Him to save and enlighten our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Sebastian Dabovich

value.text:
When He Who is called the Morning Star,
the Splendor of the glory of the eternal Father,
in His great mercy took up His abode on earth,
you, glorious Andrew, were the first to meet Him
for your heart was enlightened with the perfect brightness of His divinity.
We bless you as the herald of the apostles of Christ our God!
Pray that He may enlighten and save our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Sebastian Dabovich

value.text:
When He Who clothed Himself in human flesh,
taking our nature from the fruitful womb of the Virgin,
appeared on earth as the Teacher of Righteousness,
your heart was made glad, Andrew, lover of purity!
He raised you from earth to the ineffable glory of God!
Pray that He may enlighten and save our souls..

commemoration.title: Venerable Sebastian Dabovich

value.text:
When the Lamb of God, who takes away the sins of the world,
was incarnate bringing life and salvation to all the earth,
you hearkened to the voice of the Forerunner
and were the first to follow Him.
You were offered to Him as the first fruits of the human race!
You proclaimed to Peter, your brother: “We have found the Messiah.”
Holy Andrew, pray that He may enlighten and save our souls.

commemoration.title: Venerable Sebastian Dabovich

value.text:
Rejoice, O heaven!
Proclaim everywhere the Glory of God!
Today the first-called apostle stands in our midst.
He was the first to obey the Lord with fervor!
United to Him, he was enkindled by His love.
He is the reflection of the Savior's love for mankind,
for His rays enlighten those who dwell in darkness and the shadow of death!
We rejoice in his holy memory,
for through his prayers health and blessing are given to us!

commemoration.title: Venerable Sebastian Dabovich

value.text:
Apostle Andrew, we honor you in Songs,
brother of Peter and disciple of Christ,
fisherman and fisher of men,
you shaped all dogmas with the wisdom of Christ.
As fish are lured into a net,
so you caught transgressors with the bait of truth.
through his prayers, O Christ, grant us peace and great mercy.

commemoration.title: Prophet Nahum

value.text:
The grace of the Holy Spirit
dwelt within you, prophet of God,
making you a radiantly shining beacon with its light!
Through you, He preached to Nineveh the great things that were to come!

commemoration.title: Prophet Nahum

value.text:
You were a partaker of incorruptible glory and ineffable renown,
unutterable joy and divine sweetness!
Divinely inspired Nahum, prophet of God,
pray for us to the Master of all!

commemoration.title: Prophet Nahum

value.text:
Nahum, you were revealed to be a light-bearing cloud,
letting fall a shower of divine knowledge!
Prophet of God, you gave the city of Nineveh the judgment of God to drink,
for it was sick with impiety!

commemoration.title: Prophet Habakkuk

value.text:
Rejoicing in the Lord God, your Savior,
divinely eloquent and glorious one,
you were filled with gladness, receiving the outpouring of heavenly radiance;
spiritually illumined with deifying light!
By your prayers deliver from perils and misfortunes
those who celebrate your most glorious memory with faith!

commemoration.title: Prophet Habakkuk

value.text:
The wondrous Habakkuk became wholly divine,
receiving the outpouring of the Spirit!
Seeing the dishonesty of the judges and their unjust judgment
he was displeased,
exhibiting the rightness of the justice of Christ the Master,
with divine love and burning thoughts,
enflamed with righteous anger!

commemoration.title: Prophet Habakkuk

value.text:
The honored Habakkuk, standing on divine watch,
heard the ineffable mystery of your coming to us, O Christ!
He manifestly prophesied the preaching to come about You,
foreseeing the all-wise apostles as horses trampling the sea
of the many nations of the gentiles.

commemoration.title: Glorification of the Priestmartyr Alexander Hotovitzky

value.text:
What shall we call you, blessed one?
A shining lampstand? a faithful minister of divine mysteries?
A joyful star for the church, enlightening those who dwell in darkness?
A well-tuned organ and sweet-sounding harp?
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Glorification of the Priestmartyr Alexander Hotovitzky

value.text:
You abandoned your home, your people and earthly riches.
You fled the hatred of an evil father, Barbara;
you were wedded to God in a bond of love,
therefore He took you to Himself rejoicing.
Pray that He may save our souls.

commemoration.title: Glorification of the Priestmartyr Alexander Hotovitzky

value.text:
What shall we call you, holy theologian John?
Another David, for your hymns are as the psalms for us?
You are the temple of the spirit and the pipe of the good shepherd.
You sweeten our ears and gladden our minds.
You cause the ranks of the church to rejoice!
Your teachings are a river of honey, flowing to the ends of the earth.
Pray that our souls may be saved!
What shall we call you, father John, the messenger of God?
Shining star of the holy trinity?
You enlighten our eyes with delightful teaching.
You have entered into the cloud of divine knowledge.
Like Moses you behold mysteries beyond words or speech.
You proclaim the music of his wisdom.
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Glorification of the Priestmartyr Alexander Hotovitzky

value.text:
during her terrible trial suffering from her many wounds,
her body painfully torn in many places,
she cried out with tears of compassion:
Word of God and Lover of mankind
grant this day that I may be her companion in martyrdom!
Saints Barbara and Julianna,
you are of those who alone have a true vocation for righteous living,
for you attacked the enemy and gravely wounded him!
Thus you are worthy of glorification by Christ God
for you trampled under foot the destroying passions and their evil,
giving the means of healing to all the faithful!
Most pure martyr Barbara, when you were sentenced to die
you faced sweet death with joy!
You swiftly fulfilled the act of martyrdom
slain by the hand of your most evil parent.
You were offered up as fruit to God!
Therefore with the wise virgins you truly rejoice
as you behold the light of Christ, your Bridegroom!

commemoration.title: Venerable Savva the Sanctified

value.text:
You set your mind as master over the disturbing passions,
keeping the image unharmed through the ascetic life.
Thus you rose into the perfect likeness,
for bravely curbing nature,
you hastened to subject what is lower to that which is above:
You made the body servant to the Spirit.
Therefore you were revealed as the chief of those living the monastic life,
a citizen of the desert, a master teaching those who hasten to you,
a perfect example of virtue.
Now the shadows have been set aside, O Sabbas,
and in heaven you behold in purity the holy Trinity,
as you pray with boldness for those who honor you with faith and love!

commemoration.title: Venerable Savva the Sanctified

value.text:
Divinely wise Sabbas,
you are an unquenchable lamp of abstinence,
a radiant beacon for monastics illumined with rays of love!
You are the confirmation and strength of those who honor you with faith,
a treasury of healings and true dweller in the desert
which you showed to be the Paradise of God bearing the divine fruit of salvation!
Entreat Christ, O venerable one,
beseeching Him to grant unity to the Church, peace and great mercy!  (three times)

commemoration.title: Venerable Savva the Sanctified

value.text:
Divinely wise Sabbas,
you are a fiery pillar of the virtues,
a beacon guiding men from the sea of life to the harbor of God!
As a pure dwelling of the Holy Spirit, you disregarded spiritual deceptions.
You are an instructor of monastics,
a sure measure of abstinence,
a radiant height of humility and fountain pouring forth a depth of healing.
Entreat Christ, O venerable one,
beseeching Him to grant unity to the Church, peace and great mercy!  (three times)
St. Sabbas:  Lord I Call... (continued)				page two

commemoration.title: Venerable Savva the Sanctified

value.text:
Divinely wise Sabbas,
you stand together with the angels and dwell with the venerable ones,
you converse with the prophets
and are co-heir of the Kingdom with the martyrs and apostles!
You dwell in unfading Light
and shine with His Divine light and intense desire,
standing before Him with boldness and unceasing enlightenment,
delighting in His beauties!
Entreat Christ, O venerable Father,
beseeching Him to grant unity to the Church, peace and great mercy!  (three times)

commemoration.title: Venerable Savva the Sanctified

value.text:
We honor you, Sabbas our Father,
the instructor of a multitude of monks!
We have indeed learned to walk rightly in your footsteps!
You are blest, for having labored for Christ,
you denounced the power of the enemy!
Conversor with the angels!
Together with them, entreat the Lord that He may grant mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Savva the Sanctified

value.text:
Rejoice, for you are a sweet-scented example of the struggles of fasting,
as you took your cross upon your shoulder and offered yourself to Christ the Master.
Blessed one, you trampled the false understanding of the flesh,
enlightening your soul with the virtues
and taking flight towards desire for God.
Now as we stand around your most holy shrine, all-praised Sabbas,
we ask that by your prayers we may receive God’s love for mankind,
and great mercy for the world!

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
Glorious Nicholas, the holy preacher of Christ,
you are the great and fervent protector of those in danger:
Those on land and sea, far off or near,
for you are a most compassionate and mighty intercessor.
Therefore, as we assemble, we cry aloud:
Pray to the Lord that we may be delivered from all danger!

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
What crowns of praise shall we weave the bishop?
Although he lived in Myra,
he reaches out in spirit to all who sincerely love him.
He, the consolation of all in affliction,
the refuge of all in danger,
the tower of godliness,
the champion of the faithful,
for whose sake the greatly merciful Christ has laid low the arrogance of the enemy.

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
You that love the feasts,
let us gather and sing the praises of the fair ornament of the bishops,
the glory of the Fathers,
the fount of wonders and the great protector of the faithful.
Let us say: Rejoice, guardian of the people of Myra,
their chief and honored counselor and the pillar that cannot be moved!
Rejoice, light filled with brightness!
You make the ends of the world shine with wonders.
Rejoice, divine delight of the afflicted,
the fervent advocate of those who suffer from injustice!
And now, all-blessed Nicholas,
never cease praying to Christ our God
for those who honor the high feast of your memorial with faith and love.

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
With what songs of prophecy shall we praise the bishop?
He who foresaw things afar and clearly announced them before hand,
foretelling them as though they were taking place.
He looked round the whole world, making injustice cease;
he appeared in dreams to the emperor wise in God,
and delivered from an unjust execution those who had been in bonds,
for he is rich in God’s great mercy.

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
You appeared in a dream to the emperor Constantine and his counselor Avlabius,
speaking to them, and putting them in fear:
Set free at once those you hold unjustly bound in prison,
for they are not guilty of lawless murder.
And if you do not listen to my words, O King,
I will call on the Lord against you!

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
What songs shall we sing to praise the bishop?
who wrestled against godlessness
and was the champion of godliness:
A great leader, shield and teacher of the Church,
putting all inglorious heresy to shame,
the destroyer and fierce opponent of Arius,
whose arrogance Christ laid low on his account,
through His great mercy.

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
Nicholas, living in Myra,
you were manifested as myrrh, bishop of Christ,
anointed with the myrrh of the mind:
You make fragrant with myrrh those who keep your memorial with faith and love,
loosing them, Father, from misery, danger and affliction,
by your intercessions to Christ.

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
Nicholas, the servant of Christ,
you were shown as truly victorious to the faithful people,
strong in temptation, and worthy of your name!
Called from all places, you are swift to come
to those who turn with love to your protection.
Appearing by day and night to the faithful,
you save them from danger and temptation.

commemoration.title: Saint Nicholas the Wonderworker, Archbishop of Myra in Lycia

value.text:
Rejoice, saintly bishop,
pure abode of the virtues:
Holy example of the godly priesthood,
great shepherd and bright light named victory!
Those who call on you in prayer gain your compassion
and you bear the supplications of the weak;
you are a deliverer and protector
of those who honor your glorious memory in faith.
Pray that Christ may grant the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint Ambrose, Bishop of Milan

value.text:
Adorned with virtue, faithful steward,
you wisely governed both the city and the Church.
The faithful of Milan, inspired by the Holy Spirit,
chose you, their earthly judge, to be their shepherd.
Therefore you are glorified with a twofold crown!

commemoration.title: Saint Ambrose, Bishop of Milan

value.text:
Filled with boldness, fearless Ambrose,
you rebuked the emperor's violence.
As Nathan reproved David for his sin,
so you separated the king from the Church of Christ
until he should bear the fruits of repentance.

commemoration.title: Venerable Patapius of Thebes

value.text:
Father Patapius,
you enrolled yourself in the ranks of those who fast,
clothing yourself with dispassion!
Now you live in the mansions of the venerable ones,
where the light does not fade and the tree of life stands:
Pray now that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Patapius of Thebes

value.text:
Father Patapius,
you shone forth as a beacon from Egypt,
enlightening the world with the brightness of your miracles!
You dispel the gloom of soul-destroying infirmities,
driving off the darkness of demons!
Pray now that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Patapius of Thebes

value.text:
Father Patapius,
you quenched the fires of fleshly passion with abstinence!
Like Elijah of old you lived in the desert;
you purified your mind with incessant prayer to God!
Pray now that He may grant our souls peace and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Conception of the Most Holy Theotokos by Saint Anna

value.text:
Anna, named for divine grace,
cried out in her prayer,
beseeching the Creator and God of all:
Master, You perceive the shame of barrenness;
heal the pain of my heart!
Open my womb to make it fruitful,
that we may offer You the child as a gift,
and give glory and praise with hymns and songs
to Your love through which the world receives great mercy!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Menas, Hermogenes, and Eugraphus, of Alexandria

value.text:
Your limbs were broken, wise saints;
You were cast into the depths of the sea!
having drowned the malice of the serpent,
you were guided by the hands of the Most High
to the calm haven of sweetness!
Therefore pray that God may grant peace and great mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Menas, Hermogenes, and Eugraphus, of Alexandria

value.text:
The glorious Hermogenes
desired the severing of his hands and feet.
beholding the fire, he showed forth a greater burning of heart
as he clung to his God!
Now we pray to Him that He may grant peace and great mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyrs Menas, Hermogenes, and Eugraphus, of Alexandria

value.text:
All-glorious Martyr Mennas,
when your heels were struck,
your eyes put out and your God-speaking tongue removed,
you endured with steadfastness, looking for divine rewards.
Therefore pray that God may grant peace and great mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Venerable Daniel the Stylite of Constantinople

value.text:
What shall we now call you, Daniel?
A model for monastics and teacher of abstinence!
An adornment of the faithful and worker of healings!
A beacon shining on those in darkness!
A fellow citizen with the angels, equal in honor to them;
a dweller in paradise and a heavenly man!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Daniel the Stylite of Constantinople

value.text:
What shall we proclaim you to be, Daniel?
An uprooter of the passions and planter of the virtues!
A true wonderworker, an intercessor for sinners,
a most courageous exorcist of demons!
A beacon radiant with reverence,
a dwelling of the Spirit and champion of the Church!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Venerable Daniel the Stylite of Constantinople

value.text:
What shall we name you, Daniel?
An ascetic, for you subjected the passions to your mind!
A sufferer, for you endured all kinds of discomfort,
lifted high above the ground on your pillar!
A most diligent athlete and most skilled physician!
Pray that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Saint Mardarije (Uskokovic) of Libertyville

value.text:
Rejoice, rule of bishops,
the unshaken foundation of the Church!
The glory of the Orthodox,
a wellspring of miracles!
An unquenchable fountain of love,
a most radiant lamp and instrument of the Spirit!
A godly mind, meek and guileless,
adorned with true simplicity!
A heavenly man and earthly angel,
a worker in the vineyard and true friend of Christ!
Beseech Him to grant great mercy to those who honor you!

commemoration.title: Saint Mardarije (Uskokovic) of Libertyville

value.text:
You put to death the carnal passions, Father,
and raised the dead by the grace of God!
You transformed a serpent into gold
and by your prayer restrained the raging of the river!
You appeared to the afflicted emperor by night:
You healed him by coming close to his heart
as the Lord glorified you most gloriously!
Therefore, we honor your memory with a mighty voice!
We reverence the divine and sacred shrine of your relics
from which flows a divine stream of healing and great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint Mardarije (Uskokovic) of Libertyville

value.text:
Spiridon, glory of the fathers,
you were revealed as a meek inheritor of the earth!
By cords of wise and simple words
with divine grace you strangled the evil and demented teachings of the enemy!
You made clear divine teachings for all,
and by the Spirit you praised that which leads to salvation!
You openly enlightened all the Orthodox
teaching the faithful to glorify the one Word
as truly the Only Begotten of the Uoriginate Father
Who grants the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: Saint Mardarije (Uskokovic) of Libertyville

value.text:
Venerable Father Spiridon,
blessed and wise,
for the sake of the love of God
you questioned the dead woman as if she were alive.
You transformed a serpent into gold for a man beset by poverty.
You pitied the people and restrained the river's flow.
You stood before the emperor as a physician through God's providence,
and as His disciple, you raised the dead!
You clarified the faith among many fathers!
As you were enabled to do all things by Christ who strengthened you,
entreat Him now that our souls may be saved!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Forefathers

value.text:
Rejoice, O life-bearing Cross,
the invincible weapon of Godliness,
The gate of paradise,
the protection of the faithful!
Through which a new land is enlightened
and idolatry’s corruption is abolished,
through which the power of death is crushed!
The Cross raises us from earth to heaven!
Rejoice and be glad, O faithful,
for the glory of the Cross,
the hope of the new martyrs and Father Herman
is proclaimed in this land,
granting us the faithful great mercy!

commemoration.title: Sunday of the Forefathers

value.text:
Holy Father,
we remember today the great teachers and ascetics,
because of your deeds and example.
Your wondrous life confounded the enemy.
You conversed with angels!
Together with them, pray for the salvation of our souls!

commemoration.title: Prophet Haggai

value.text:
You became a tabernacle of God, glorious one;
a living temple!
By the splendor of your life and deeds, most honored one,
you raised up to Him Who reigns over all the world
the Temple that had fallen of old.
By your prayers, entreat Him to grant us great mercy!

commemoration.title: Prophet Haggai

value.text:
You were a vessel of the Spirit,
receiving the outpouring of light granted you from heaven.
Therefore you prophesied the redemption of all people by the Savior!
By your prayers, entreat Him to grant us great mercy!

commemoration.title: Prophet Haggai

value.text:
You are surrounded with the radiance of divine grace
and granted contemplation.
You are revealed to be filled with never-fading enlightenment.
Therefore, blessed one, protect those who sing your praises,
entreating the one Lord to grant us great mercy!

commemoration.title: Prophet Daniel
Prophet Daniel

value.text:
Come, let us faithfully celebrate in advance the birth of Christ,
and with our minds, offer a song like the star to the Magi!
Let us cry out with praises, together with the shepherds:
The deliverance of mankind has come forth from a Virgin's womb,
and He calls the faithful!

commemoration.title: Prophet Daniel

value.text:
You saw the incomprehensible One seated upon the throne;
the just Judge encircled by angels, wondrous prophet!
Amazed at the awesome and fearful sight,
you described it for all who would come after you,
writing down the second coming of our incarnate God!

commemoration.title: Prophet Daniel

value.text:
First strengthening your body with constant fasting,
you stopped the mouths of lions!
As you stood in their midst, inspired prophet,
you looked earnestly to the good God.
You remained unharmed through the ineffable might of Him
Who wondrously brings all things to pass:
the Redeemer of our souls!

commemoration.title: Prophet Daniel

value.text:
Cleaving to the laws given by God, all-blessed ones,
you were not defiled by polluted foods,
but you preserved the soul’s beauty without corruption,
and indeed kept unspoiled and unfading the flower of brightness
and the joyful beauty of the Master Who glorifies those who serve Him.

commemoration.title: Prophet Daniel

value.text:
The tyrants were astonished at the youths’ intelligence
and at the words of your wisdom, Daniel, deserving wonder.
They appointed you, holy ones, to rule and be masters of the Chaldean land;
for even the enemy knows most clearly
how to admire virtue and splendor of life,
for you conquered the passions and became sovereigns.

commemoration.title: Martyr Sebastian at Rome, and his companions

value.text:
Zoe, Mark, Marcellinus and the divinely-wise Tibertius
suffered together with Sebastian.
They endured triple waves of torments!
Now they dwell in the peace of God where there is no pain
and pray that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Sebastian at Rome, and his companions

value.text:
Blessed, invincible martyrs,
you forsook the things of this earth
and hastened to the heavens, adorned with your wounds
and splendidly clothed in your honored sufferings.
Therefore, pray that peace and great mercy may be granted to our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Sebastian at Rome, and his companions

value.text:
With the dye of your precious blood
you made a costly robe of purple for yourself.
Putting it on, you indeed dwell in the kingdom on high
where you stand before God, the King of all.
Pray to Him that He may grant peace and great mercy to our souls!

commemoration.title: Martyr Boniface at Tarsus in Cilicia, and Righteous Aglaϊa of Rome

value.text:
Aglais acquired a divine master, Boniface,
sending you, her manservant before her.
You tamed the passions and gained mastery over tyrants.
You cast down the enemy and were crowned with victory.
Therefore she built you a holy temple all-adorned.
She enshrined your relics there,
praising you in holiness.

commemoration.title: Martyr Boniface at Tarsus in Cilicia, and Righteous Aglaϊa of Rome

value.text:
You endured the most savage trials:
your nails were torn and you were cruelly pierced.
When you were beheaded, you rejoiced, greatly-suffering one,
and joined the choir of athletes.
Therefore we celebrate your annual memorial,
Boniface, the conversor with the angels!

commemoration.title: Martyr Boniface at Tarsus in Cilicia, and Righteous Aglaϊa of Rome

value.text:
You desired the godly name given to martyrs,
greatly suffering passion-bearer.
You endured torments with steadfast courage, most blessed one,
expecting translation to the rest where there is no pain.
You sought the honors of heaven and a dwelling in paradise,
the light that never fades and eternal life!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Listen, heaven, and give ear, O earth:
Behold the Son and Word of the Father
coming forth to be born of a maiden who has not known man
at the good pleasure of the Father Who begot Him before all ages.
He is conceived by the co-operation of the Holy Spirit;
Bethlehem, make ready; Eden, open your gates,
for He Who is comes to be that which He was not,
and He Who formed all creation takes the form of a man,
granting the world great mercy.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Let us celebrate, people,
the Prefeast of Christ's Nativity!
Let us raise our minds on high,
in Spirit going up to Bethlehem.
With the eyes of our soul, let us behold the Virgin
as she hastens to the cave to give birth to the Lord and God of all.
When Joseph first saw the mighty wonder,
he thought that he saw only a human Child wrapped in swaddling clothes,
but from all that came to pass he discovered the Child to be the true God
Who grants the world great mercy.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Let us celebrate, people,
the Prefeast of Christ's Nativity!
Let us raise our minds on high
in Spirit going up to Bethlehem.
Let us behold the great mystery in the cavern,
for Eden is opened once again,
when God comes forth from a pure Virgin,
remaining the same perfect God, and perfect Man.
Therefore, let us cry aloud to Him,
Holy God, Father without beginning,
Holy Mighty, incarnate Son,
Holy Immortal, the Spirit and Comforter,
Holy Trinity, glory to You!

commemoration.title: Hieromartyr Ignatius the God-Bearer, Bishop of Antioch

value.text:
By embracing Christ as your love, you received a reward,
God-bearer Ignatius.
With your blood you sealed the priestly work of the gospel of Christ,
becoming the wheat of the immortal sower,
ground by the teeth of wild beasts,
you offer yourself as a loaf of sweet bread to Christ.
Blessed passion-bearer, never cease to pray for us!

commemoration.title: Sunday before the Nativity

value.text:
Come, all you faithful,
begin the celebration:
Sing with the Magi and shepherds:
Salvation comes from the Virgin's womb,
recalling the faithful to life!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
The prophet cried in the Spirit:
This is our God.
There shall be no other like Him.
He has created the way of all knowledge,
making Himself in the last days like unto men,
for He comes to be born of the pure maiden of God,
wrapping Himself in human flesh.
Behold, the unapproachable One approaches me!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
In your womb, all-blameless Theotokos,
we behold the rich threshing-floor of which Solomon sang.
You bear the ear of grain that grew without being sown;
Your Child is the eternal Word:
In a wonderful manner you will give birth to Him in the cave of Bethlehem,
He will lovingly feed every creature with the knowledge of God,
freeing the human race from deadly hunger.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
A young heifer bearing a fatted calf in her womb
enters the holy cavern.
Wondrously will she give birth to Him!
As a man she will wrap Him in swaddling clothes;
as a babe she will lay Him in a manger of dumb beasts!
Universe, prepare to celebrate;
joyfully magnify Him who comes to perform on earth a mighty wonder!

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
The prophecy
of all the prophets is fulfilled:
Christ is being born
in the city of Bethlehem
from a pure handmaiden of God.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
The never-setting Sun presses forward to rise,
enlightening all things under heaven.
Let us hasten with clean hands and pure deeds to meet Him;
let us prepare to be borne on high with Him in spirit.
Let us beseech Him in His compassion,
that as He comes in His good pleasure to His own strange birth,
He may lead us who have become strangers to the path of life in Eden,
into Bethlehem where He comes to be born.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Word of God without beginning,
the Virgin lays You in the manger of dumb beasts:
You choose to begin in the flesh
in a manner beyond understanding!
You are come to loose me from the fetters of evil
with which the envious serpent bound me;
Lover of mankind, You are wrapped in swaddling clothes,
tearing to pieces the bonds of my countless sins.
Therefore I joyfully praise and worship your holy birth,
for You came to set me free.

commemoration.title: Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord
Forefeast of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Christ, Who is the infinite wisdom of God,
has wondrously built a house for Himself from the Virgin;
she comes into the cave and manger of dumb beasts:
There she will give birth in the flesh to Him
in a manner beyond all understanding.

commemoration.title: Eve of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
The Creator of righteousness
has magnificently adorned you with a double crown,
for you are a pure virgin and a glorious martyr!
He gave you a beautiful bridal-chamber, shining with radiance,
where you dwell, O bride of Christ,
in the manifest wealth of eternal blessedness!

commemoration.title: Eve of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
You adorned yourself with teaching,
with life and grace and patience of soul.
You led an army of athletes;
an assembly of virgins,
to Him Who alone has shone forth from the Virgin.
You openly revealed to all the entrance of martyrdom!
Together with them, most wise Eugenia,
entreat Him that He may save your flock!

commemoration.title: Eve of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Forsaking the beauty of the world and of your nobility,
you enlightened the nobility of your soul, all-praised Eugenia:
You preserved the grace of the image of God
in calmness throughout your life.
You are a divine mirror of virginity,
a noble blossom of nature
and an invincible martyr!

commemoration.title: Nun-Martyr Eugenia of Rome

value.text:
The pure handmaid became afraid
when she saw the wise men come.
She asked them:  whom are you seeking?
I see that you have come from afar.
You resemble Persians in wisdom and appearance.
You have made a strange and wonderful journey.
Now come and worship God who journeyed from on high
to come and take his abode in me
and Who grants the world great mercy!

commemoration.title: Eve of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
The kings of the east have come
to see You, the King, being born.
They have brought You gifts from afar,
and are standing outside the doors
bearing frankincense, gold and myrrh.
Command them to enter and see
the infant Whom I hold in my arms
Who is older than Adam.

commemoration.title: Eve of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
The Virgin said to the wise men:
Come and enter with haste!
Behold the invisible God, visible now as a man.
They entered with zeal and worshipped Him
thus fulfilling the divine prophecy.

commemoration.title: Eve of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Celebrate, Zion!
Rejoice, Jerusalem!
City of Christ our God,
exalt the Creator of all contained within your cave!
Open your gates to me, so that when I enter
I may see the eternal God wrapped in swaddling clothes as a babe.
The angels praise Him with unceasing voices:
The Lord and Giver of life who saves us!

commemoration.title: The Nativity of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ
The Nativity of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ
The Nativity of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Come, let us greatly rejoice in the Lord
as we tell of this present mystery!
The dividing wall has been destroyed;
the flaming sword turns back,
the cherubim withdraw from the tree of life,
and I partake of the delight of Paradise
from which I was cast out through disobedience.
For the express image of the Father, the imprint of His eternity,
takes the form of a servant,
and without undergoing change He comes forth from an unwedded Mother.
For what He was, He has remained: true God,
and what He was not, He has taken upon Himself,
becoming Man through love for mankind.
Unto Him, let us cry aloud:
O God born of a Virgin, have mercy on us!

commemoration.title: The Nativity of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
When the Lord Jesus was born of the holy Virgin,
all the world was enlightened.
The shepherds watched in the fields,
the Magi adored and the angels praised in song;
but Herod was troubled:
for God has appeared in the flesh, the Savior of our souls!

commemoration.title: The Nativity of our Lord God and Savior Jesus Christ

value.text:
Your kingdom, O Christ our God,
is a kingdom of all the ages,
and Your rule is from generation to generation!
Made flesh of the Holy Spirit
and made Man of the ever-Virgin Mary,
You have enlightened us by Your coming.
Light of light, brightness of the Father,
You have made the whole creation shine with joy.
All that has breath praises You, the image of the glory of the Father!
O God, You are and ever have been;
You have shone forth from a Virgin: have mercy on us!

commemoration.title: Second Day of the Nativity of our Lord
Second Day of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
Come, let us greatly rejoice in the Lord
as we tell of this present mystery!
The dividing wall has been destroyed;
the flaming sword turns back,
the cherubim withdraw from the tree of life,
and I partake of the delight of paradise
from which I was cast out through disobedience.
For the express image of the Father, the imprint of His eternity,
takes the form of a servant,
and without undergoing change He comes forth from an unwedded Mother.
For what He was, He has remained: true God,
and what He was not, He has taken upon Himself,
becoming Man through love for mankind.
Unto Him, let us cry aloud:
O God born of a Virgin, have mercy on us!

commemoration.title: Second Day of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
When the Lord Jesus was born of the holy Virgin,
all the world was enlightened.
The shepherds watched in the fields,
the Magi adored and the angels praised in song;
but Herod was troubled:
For God has appeared in the flesh, the Savior of our souls!

commemoration.title: Second Day of the Nativity of our Lord

value.text:
A great miracle has come to pass this day:
Nature is made new and God becomes Man!
That which He was, He has remained,
and that which He was not, He has taken on Himself
while suffering neither confusion nor division.

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Holy Righteous David the King, Joseph the Betrothed, and James the Brother of the Lord

value.text:
Renowned with signs, wonders, and heavenly preaching,
you destroyed the malice of the wicked council.
As they stoned you to death, you begged God to forgive them,
using the words of the Savior as He hung upon the cross,
commending your pure spirit into His hands, blessed Stephen.

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Holy Righteous David the King, Joseph the Betrothed, and James the Brother of the Lord

value.text:
Your soul was illumined with the grace of the Holy Spirit;
your face shone as an angel, Stephen.
Your body was made radiant by the brightness within you:
Contemplation of God's light was your only joy:
Therefore the heavens were wondrously opened to you,
leader and glory of the martyrs

commemoration.title: Commemoration of the Holy Righteous David the King, Joseph the Betrothed, and James the Brother of the Lord
Commemoration of the Holy Righteous David the King, Joseph the Betrothed, and James the Brother of the Lord

value.text:
Let us sing to the eternal Son
Who sprang from the bosom of the Father before all ages:
In the fullness of time, He rests on the throne of His Mother's arms:
Together with the angels, the shepherds, and the Magi,
let us worship Him!
